sections.body:
Source code editing with syntax highlighting, IntelliSense, validation, multiple models and a
diff view. Monaco runs in core `createCodeEditorController` / `createDiffEditorController`
(`@owlky/core/code-editor`), shared by React and the HTML runtimes; Owlky adds the frame, the
loading state, the no-JavaScript / failure fallback and themes built from the tokens.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
div[data-ok-code-editor][data-ok-status=loading|ready|error]?[data-ok-language]?[data-ok-path]?
   [data-ok-monaco-theme]?[data-ok-line]?[data-ok-width]?[data-ok-height]?[data-ok-options]?
   [data-ok-save-view-state="false"]?[data-ok-keep-current-model]?
  textarea[data-ok-code-editor-value][aria-label][spellcheck=false][autocomplete=off][autocapitalize=off][wrap=off]
  div[data-ok-code-editor-loading][role=status]       ("Loading..." or the `loading` content)
  div[data-ok-code-editor-content][class]?            (Monaco: div.monaco-editor …)
div[data-ok-diff-editor][data-ok-status]?[data-ok-language]?[data-ok-original-language]?[data-ok-modified-language]?
   [data-ok-original-model-path]?[data-ok-modified-model-path]?[data-ok-monaco-theme]?[data-ok-width]?[data-ok-height]?
   [data-ok-options]?[data-ok-keep-current-original-model]?[data-ok-keep-current-modified-model]?
  textarea[data-ok-diff-editor-original][aria-label] + textarea[data-ok-diff-editor-modified][aria-label]
  div[data-ok-diff-editor-loading][role=status]
  div[data-ok-diff-editor-content][class]?            (Monaco: div.monaco-diff-editor …)
```
`data-ok-status` is written by the owner (React state, HTML runtime), never in snippets.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `code-editor`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `diff-editor`: listed under "options".)

Language and theme attributes also accept names registered in `beforeMount` (letters, digits,
`. + # - _`, up to 64 characters); React passes any string. `data-ok-options`: Monaco options as
JSON (at most 16 kB; `JSON.parse` only, prototype keys dropped; React writes it from `options`).

API mapping (`@monaco-editor/react`): **kept** `defaultValue`, `defaultLanguage`, `defaultPath`,
`value`, `language`, `path`, `theme`, `line`, `loading`, `options`, `overrideServices`,
`saveViewState`, `keepCurrentModel`, `width`, `height`, `className` (on the content element, as
upstream), `wrapperProps` (on the root), `beforeMount`, `onMount`, `onChange(value, event)`,
`onValidate(markers)`; DiffEditor `original`, `modified`, `language`, `originalLanguage`,
`modifiedLanguage`, `originalModelPath`, `modifiedModelPath`, `keepCurrentOriginalModel`,
`keepCurrentModifiedModel`, `theme`, `loading`, `options`, `width`, `height`, `className`,
`wrapperProps`, `beforeMount`, `onMount`; `useMonaco()`; `loader.config({ paths: { vs },
monaco, "vs/nls" })`, `loader.init()` (cancelable). **Changed:** `theme` default `"auto"`
(upstream `"light"`: Owlky themes follow `data-ok-theme`); `loader` has no CDN default (`paths.vs`
is a folder of Owlky's build, self-hosted) and adds `import` and `getWorker`;
`loader.__getMonacoInstance` → `getMonaco()`. **Added:** `aria-label` (default "Code editor":
Monaco's `ariaLabel` and the textarea's name), `onError(error)`, a `ref` to the root. **Not
applicable:** none.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
- No `data-ok-status` (no JavaScript): the textarea is the editor; loading and content hidden.
- `loading`: the loading part covers the frame (`role=status`), content invisible.
- `ready`: Monaco shown; textareas hidden (still submitted with a form: their value follows).
- `error`: Monaco couldn't load; the textareas are shown and editable (React `onChange(value,
  undefined)`, HTML `ok:code-editor:change` with `event: null`).
sections.title: States

sections.body:
- Loading: `loader.init()` once per page; `beforeMount(monaco)` then the editor; `onMount(editor,
  monaco)`; status `ready`. Monaco is imported from the `monaco-editor` package (bundlers) or from
  `paths.vs` (`owlky-code-editor.js`: the `monaco/` folder next to it, or the script's
  `data-ok-monaco-path`).
- Models (`@monaco-editor/react`'s rules): the first model is `path ?? defaultPath` (created with
  `value ?? defaultValue` and `defaultLanguage ?? language` if it doesn't exist). A new `path`
  switches to that model (created on first use), saving the old view state and restoring the
  new one (`saveViewState`). `value` replaces the content as one undoable edit (`setValue` when
  read only) and fires no `onChange`; `language` sets the current model's language; `line`
  reveals a line; `options` → `updateOptions`. Unmount disposes the model unless
  `keepCurrentModel`.
- Diff: original and modified models from `original` / `modified` with `originalLanguage ??
  language` / `modifiedLanguage ?? language` (default `text`) and their model paths; new values
  update them (modified as an undoable edit); unmount disposes both models unless kept.
- Validation: `onValidate(markers)` / `ok:code-editor:validate` whenever the current model's
  markers change (languages with workers: JSON, CSS, HTML, TypeScript / JavaScript).
- Themes: `auto` → `owlky-light` / `owlky-dark` built from the scope's tokens (`--ok-bg-paper`,
  `--ok-text-*`, palette `-text` tones for syntax, `primary-main` cursor and focus); Monaco has one
  theme per page: the editor focused, mounted or re-themed last picks it. `data-ok-theme`,
  `data-ok-preset` and system scheme changes re-apply it. Default font `--ok-font-family-mono`.
- Size: `width` / `height` (default 100%; at least 300px when no height) through
  `--_ok-code-editor-width|height`; Monaco follows its container (`automaticLayout`).
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body:
Monaco's keyboard map (VS Code). Tab inserts a tab: **Ctrl+M** (macOS: **Ctrl+Shift+M**) toggles
"Tab moves focus" so Tab and Shift+Tab leave the editor; **Alt+F1** (Windows / Linux) or
**Option+F1** opens Monaco's accessibility help; **F1** the command palette. Fallback textareas:
native.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
Monaco's input is a `textbox` (`aria-multiline`, `aria-roledescription="editor"`) named by
`ariaLabel` (React `aria-label`, HTML the textarea's `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` /
`<label>`); `accessibilitySupport` and `tabFocusMode` stay reachable through `options`. Loading
is a polite `status`. The textareas are named. Syntax colors are AA `-text` tones on
`--ok-bg-paper`; line numbers `--ok-text-secondary`.
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML `ok:code-editor:beforemount` (`{ monaco }`), `:mount` (`{ editor, monaco }`), `:change`
(`{ value, event }`), `:validate` (`{ markers }`), `:error` (`{ error }`); instance `{ status,
value, setValue(value), updateOptions(options), focus(), editor, monaco, controller }`. Diff
editor: `ok:diff-editor:beforemount | mount | error`; instance `{ status, original, modified,
setOriginal, setModified, updateOptions, editor, monaco, controller }`. Registration is opt-in:
`@owlky/html/code-editor` (exports `loader`), `owlky-code-editor.js`, or
`createCodeEditor({ beforeMount, onMount, overrideServices })` / `createDiffEditor(…)`.
React: `CodeEditor`, `DiffEditor`, `useMonaco()`, `loader`.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
The frame is fluid (`width` 100%, never wider than its container); Monaco relayouts on resize.
The story settings sit beside the editor from 900px and above it below (the reference hides the
editor on phones; Owlky keeps both).
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
React renders `data-ok-runtime="off"` and the status from state. Monaco's DOM (instance ids,
measured layout) is compared by the code editor e2e spec, not by the anatomy parity test.
Monaco's theme is page-wide (ADR-0034).
sections.title: Parity notes

components.name: collapse

options.description: `vertical` animates the height, `horizontal` the width.
options.name: orientation

options.description: Size kept while closed (height, or width when horizontal): a number in px, or a CSS length.
options.name: collapsedSize

options.description: Duration in ms (default `--ok-duration-standard`), or `auto`: from the distance travelled.
options.name: timeout

options.description: Animates even when the user prefers reduced motion.
options.name: disablePrefersReducedMotion

options.description: Open while the element has no `hidden` (React `in`; HTML: `hidden`, a trigger or `show()` / `hide()`).
options.name: in

sections.body:
Shows or hides content by animating its height (or width) between a collapsed size (0 by
default) and the content's natural size. The element is closed while it carries `hidden`, so
content is shown or hidden exactly as the markup says before (or without) JavaScript. It can be
any element (React `component`, HTML an extra attribute): List nested lists, Tree view groups and
Stepper `StepContent` are Collapses.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
[data-ok-collapse][id]?[hidden]?[data-ok-orientation="horizontal"]?[data-ok-collapsed-size]?
  [data-ok-timeout]?[data-ok-timeout-exit]?[data-ok-easing]?[data-ok-easing-exit]?
  [data-ok-disable-prefers-reduced-motion]?
  › content
(HTML trigger) button | input[type=checkbox] [data-ok-collapse-toggle="<id> <id>…"]
```
`data-ok-state="entering" | "exiting"` exists only while it animates (written by the controller).
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `collapse`: listed under "options".)

Outside the schema: `timeout="auto"` (`data-ok-timeout="auto"`) and `{ enter, exit }` (React) →
`data-ok-timeout` + `data-ok-timeout-exit`; `easing` (`data-ok-easing`, `{ enter, exit }` →
`data-ok-easing-exit`): keywords and functions only (`cubic-bezier(…)`, `steps(…)`, `linear(…)`,
`var(--ok-easing-*)`), anything else is dropped, and an easing the browser rejects falls back to
`--ok-easing-standard`. A collapsed size of 0 isn't written. React only: `component` (element
type, default `div`, props of that component pass through), `mountOnEnter`, `unmountOnExit`,
`onEnter` / `onEntering` / `onEntered` / `onExit` / `onExiting` / `onExited` (`(node) => void`),
`ref` (the element).

API mapping (MUI): kept `in`, `orientation`, `collapsedSize`, `timeout` (number, `"auto"`,
`{ enter, exit }`; `appear` is ignored), `easing`, `component`, `disablePrefersReducedMotion`,
`mountOnEnter`, `unmountOnExit`, the six callbacks (they get the element; no `isAppearing`).
Not applicable: `appear` (the first render is the markup's state), `addEndListener` (the
controller ends on the animation's `finished`), `slots` / `slotProps` / `classes` (one element,
no wrappers), `sx`, `TransitionComponent` props of react-transition-group (`nodeRef`, `enter`,
`exit`).
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
- Root: `--_ok-collapse-duration: var(--ok-duration-standard)` (300ms, MUI `duration.standard`),
  `--_ok-collapse-easing: var(--ok-easing-standard)` (MUI `easeInOut`), `--_ok-collapse-reduce: 0`;
  `--_ok-collapsed-size` / `--_ok-collapse-closed-display` reset to `initial` (no inheritance).
- Closed (`[hidden]`): `display: var(--_ok-collapse-closed-display, none)`, `overflow: hidden`,
  height (horizontal: width) `var(--_ok-collapsed-size, 0)` while not animating.
- Horizontal: `display: flex; width: fit-content`, children `flex-shrink: 0` (they keep their
  width while the root's width animates).
- Animating (`[data-ok-state]`): `overflow: hidden`.
- `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` → `--_ok-collapse-reduce: 1` (instant) unless
  `data-ok-disable-prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Padding and borders on the root stay at size 0: put them on a child.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
Core `createCollapseController(element, options)` (React layout effect, HTML runtime
`collapse`) watches `hidden` with a MutationObserver (runs before the next paint):
- **Enter** (`hidden` removed): `onEnter`, `data-ok-state="entering"`, measure the natural size,
  animate (Web Animations API) from the collapsed size (or the current size when interrupted) to
  it, `onEntering`; when it finishes, drop the state, `onEntered`. At rest the size is `auto`.
- **Exit** (`hidden` added): `onExit`, `data-ok-state="exiting"`; if author CSS hides it already
  (`display: none`), an inline `display: … !important` (the value it had while open, CSSOM; important
  because Tailwind's preflight hides `[hidden]` with `!important`) keeps it rendered;
  animate from the current size to the collapsed size, `onExiting`; when it finishes, drop the
  state and the inline display, `onExited`.
- Duration: `timeout` (ms), `"auto"` (Material's formula on the distance, ≤ 3s) or the
  stylesheet's `--_ok-collapse-duration`. Duration 0, reduced motion or no `element.animate`:
  instant, the six callbacks still run in order.
- An interruption cancels the running animation and starts from its current size.
- React `unmountOnExit`: children removed after `onExited`, rendered again when `in`; with
  `mountOnEnter` alone they stay after the first opening.
- HTML runtime: reads the options (re-read on attribute changes), writes `collapseStyle` through
  CSSOM. Triggers: `[data-ok-collapse-toggle="<ids>"]` on a checkbox (`change`: open while
  checked) or a button (`click`: toggles every named collapse to the opposite of the first one's
  state, writes `aria-expanded`). Ids are space-separated; unknown ids and `data-ok-runtime="off"`
  elements are skipped.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body:
No breakpoints: the root takes its container's width (vertical) or its content's (horizontal).
The story's rows are capped at 250px and shrink on phones; nothing overflows at 375px. Each
collapse holds a Paper (`elevation={4}`) around the triangle, as the reference; story CSS keeps
only its margin.
sections.title: Responsive behavior

sections.body: None: the trigger (button, switch) handles keys.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
- Closed = `hidden`: out of the accessibility tree and the tab order. With a collapsed size the
  visible slice stays in both (as MUI): don't put controls there.
- Buttons that open a collapse carry `aria-expanded` + `aria-controls` (the HTML button trigger
  writes `aria-expanded`).
- Reduced motion honored by default.
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML: `ok:collapse:enter`, `entering`, `entered`, `exit`, `exiting`, `exited` (bubbling,
`detail: { in }`). Instance: `{ in, status, show(), hide(), toggle(force?) }`. React: the six
callbacks.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
React adds `data-ok-runtime="off"` (and `style` for a collapsed size, ignored by parity). The story
snippet adds the HTML-only trigger `data-ok-collapse-toggle` on the switch input (ignored by
parity).
sections.title: Parity notes

sections.body:
Rows of data in columns that people sort, search, filter, page, select, show / hide and export.
An ARIA grid on `div`s laid out with CSS grid. Core `data-grid.ts` holds the data model (sort,
filter, quick filter, selection, column template, CSV); core `createGridNavigation` the keyboard.
React keeps the state in props / state; the HTML runtime `data-grid` keeps it in the DOM (rows
moved and `hidden`).

sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `data-grid`: listed under "options".)

React props (MUI X names): `rows`, `columns` (`GridColDef`: `field`, `headerName`, `type`
string | number | date | dateTime | boolean | singleSelect | actions, `width` (100), `minWidth`
(50), `flex`, `align`, `headerAlign`, `sortable`, `filterable`, `hideable`, `valueOptions`,
`valueGetter(row)`, `valueFormatter(value, row)`, `renderCell(params)`), `getRowId` (`row.id`),
`rowSelectionModel` / `onRowSelectionModelChange(ids)`, `sortModel` / `onSortModelChange`,
`filterModel` / `onFilterModelChange` (`items` (one), `quickFilterValues`), `paginationModel` /
`onPaginationModelChange`, `pageSizeOptions` ([5, 10, 25]), `columnVisibilityModel` /
`onColumnVisibilityModelChange`, `density` / `onDensityChange`, `initialState`, `showToolbar`,
`disableColumnSorting`, `disableColumnFilter`, `disableColumnSelector`, `disableDensitySelector`,
`hideFooter`, `localeText`, `exportFileName`. Phase 2: `filterModel.logicOperator`,
`disableMultipleColumnsFiltering`, `resizable` (column), `disableColumnResize`,
`onColumnWidthChange(field, width)`, `initialState.columns.dimensions`, `columnOrder` /
`onColumnOrderChange(fields)` / `initialState.columns.orderedFields`, `disableColumnReorder`,
`pinnedColumns` / `onPinnedColumnsChange` / `initialState.pinnedColumns`, `disableColumnPinning`,
`editable` (column; not with `valueGetter` or `actions`), `editMode` (cell | row),
`processRowUpdate(newRow, oldRow)` (value or promise; rejection keeps the row),
`onProcessRowUpdateError`. Phase 3: `disableVirtualization`, `sortingMode` / `filterMode` /
`paginationMode` (client | server), `rowCount`, `loading`, `loadingVariant` (`slotProps.loadingOverlay.variant`),
`onRowsScrollEnd({ visibleRowsCount })`, `scrollEndThreshold` (80), `dataSource` (`getRows(params)`
→ `{ rows, rowCount? }`; implies every server mode), `dataSourceCache` (default: 50 requests per
source; `null` disables), `onDataSourceError(error)`. Phase 4: `disableMultipleRowSelection`, `isRowSelectable`,
`keepNonExistentRowsSelected`, `checkboxSelectionVisibleOnly`, `autosizeOnMount`, `autosizeOptions`
(`columns`, `includeHeaders`), column `colSpan` (number or per cell), `rowSpanning`, column
`description`, `renderHeader`, `maxWidth`, `rowHeight`, `getRowHeight` (px, `"auto"`, null),
`getEstimatedRowHeight`, `getRowClassName`, `getCellClassName`, `getRowSpacing`, `onRowClick`,
`onRowDoubleClick`, `onCellClick`, `onCellDoubleClick`, `onCellKeyDown`, `onColumnHeaderClick`,
`apiRef` / `useGridApiRef()` (`GridApi`: get/set models, `autosizeColumns`, `scrollToIndexes`,
`exportState`, `restoreState`, `getDataAsCsv`, `exportDataAsCsv`, `exportDataAsPrint`),
`isCellEditable`, column `valueParser` / `valueSetter` / `preProcessEditCellProps` (`{ error }`),
`onCellEditStart` / `onCellEditStop` / `onRowEditStart` / `onRowEditStop` (reasons), `isAnyOf`,
column `filterOperators`, `getApplyQuickFilterFn: null`, `quickFilterLogicOperator`,
`quickFilterExcludeHiddenColumns`, `ignoreDiacritics`, `csvOptions`, `printOptions`, locale packs
(`enUS`, `viVN`, `frFR`, `deDE`, `esES`, `jaJP`, `zhCN` from core), right-to-left layout. Beyond MUI
X: `toolbarVariant` (labeled | icon: the reference's icon-only toolbar). Phase 5: `treeData`,
`getTreeDataPath`, `groupingColDef` (`headerName`, `width`, `hideDescendantCount`),
`defaultGroupingExpansionDepth`, `isGroupExpandedByDefault`, `apiRef.setRowChildrenExpansion`;
server tree data (`dataSource.getChildrenCount`, `getGroupKey`, params `groupKeys`);
`getDetailPanelContent`, `getDetailPanelHeight`, `detailPanelExpandedRowIds` /
`onDetailPanelExpandedRowIdsChange`, `apiRef.toggleDetailPanel`; `rowReordering`,
`onRowOrderChange`; `pinnedRows`; `columnGroupingModel`; `listView`, `listViewColumn`;
`rowBufferPx`, `columnBufferPx`; `lazyLoading`, `lazyLoadingRequestThrottleMs` (params `start` /
`end`); `dataSource.updateRow`; `createGridDataSourceCache({ ttl, limit })`; `isAnyOf` values as
Autocomplete chips. Phase 6: `rowGroupingModel` / `onRowGroupingModelChange` /
`initialState.rowGrouping.model`, `disableRowGrouping`, column `groupable`; `aggregationModel` /
`onAggregationModelChange` / `initialState.aggregation.model`, `disableAggregation`,
`aggregationFunctions` (`{ apply(values, column), columnTypes? }`), `aggregationRowsScope`,
`getAggregationPosition` (groups `inline` | null, root `footer` | null), column `aggregable`,
`availableAggregationFunctions`; `pivotModel` / `onPivotModelChange`, `pivotActive` /
`onPivotActiveChange`, `initialState.pivoting` (`model`, `active`), `disablePivoting`, column
`pivotable`; `excelOptions` (`fileName`, `sheetName`, `fields`, `allColumns`, `includeHeaders`),
`apiRef.getDataAsExcel` / `exportDataAsExcel`; `cellSelection`, `cellSelectionModel` /
`onCellSelectionModelChange`; `disableClipboardPaste`, `onClipboardCopy`, `onClipboardPasteStart` /
`onClipboardPasteEnd`, `splitClipboardPastedText`, `clipboardCopyCellDelimiter`,
`ignoreValueFormatterDuringExport`; `headerFilters`; `chartsIntegration`, `chartModel` /
`onChartModelChange` / `initialState.chartsIntegration.model`; data source `groupFields`; `apiRef`
row grouping, aggregation, pivot, cell selection and chart setters. Beyond MUI X: Alt + Up / Down on a reorder handle (WCAG 2.5.7). Beyond MUI X (accessibility): Alt + Left / Right resizes, column menu
Move left / Move right. Renamed: `rowSelectionModel` is an id array (MUI v8:
`{ type, ids }`). Later phases: see ADR-0021 (tree data, master-detail, row reordering / pinning,
column groups, row grouping, aggregation, pivoting, Excel, clipboard, cell selection, header
filters, column virtualization, lazy loading of row chunks). Not applicable: `slots`, `slotProps`, `sx`, `classes`, license keys.
Deferred (roadmap): `rowGroupingColumnMode="multiple"`, `groupingValueGetter`, group footers
(`getAggregationPosition` → `footer` for groups), server-side aggregation, `getPivotDerivedColumns`
(year / quarter of dates), the pivot panel's drag and drop (selects instead), header filter operator
menus, the AI assistant (needs a language model service).
Renamed: the charts integration is one `chartModel` and a chart inside the grid (MUI X: a renderer
proxy and a context provider around the grid). Its configuration is flat in the model (MUI X:
`configuration`): kept `stacked`, `itemLabel` (`none` | `value`), `colors` (palette names, not MUI
palettes), `height`, `showMark`, `seriesAxisLabel`, `showToolbar`; renamed `interpolation` → `curve`
(`smooth` | `straight` | `stepline`), `legendPosition…` / `legendDirection` → `legend` (`top` |
`right` | `bottom` | `none`), `skipAnimation` → `animations` (opt-in), `innerRadius` → type `donut`
+ `donutSize` (%), pie `startAngle` / `endAngle` kept. Not applicable (fixed by the Chart's design):
`grid`, axis positions, `tickPlacement`, `tickLabelPlacement`, `seriesAxisReverse`,
`categoriesAxisLabel`, `borderRadius`, gap ratios, `paddingAngle`, `cornerRadius`, `seriesGap`,
`outerRadius`, `width`, tooltip placement / trigger, `onRender`. One dimension (MUI X: several, a
grouped axis), one chart per grid (multiple renderer proxies: deferred). Beyond MUI X: `radar` and
`scatter` types. While pivoting, a value field of the pivot stands for its pivot columns (MUI X sets
them with `updateChartValuesData` once the columns exist).
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Rows 52px (`--ok-spacing` × 13; compact 36px, comfortable 68px), header 56px (× 14) on
`--ok-bg-neutral`, `--ok-text-secondary`, subtitle2 weight; cells padding 10px, body2; rows
separated by a 1px dashed `--ok-divider`; hover `--ok-action-hover`; selected primary channel / 0.08
(hover 0.12); focused cell: 2px primary inset outline; header separators 1px `--ok-divider` (40%
height). Text cells truncate with an ellipsis; cells with elements lay them out in a row (8px gap).
Numbers align right. Toolbar padding 16px, quick filter up to 240px, wraps. Footer: dashed top
border, TablePagination at the end. Sort arrow 18px (descending turned); menu button shows on
header hover / focus / open, always with `hover: none`.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
Header click / Enter / Space sorts (none → asc → desc → none; Shift adds the column, unless
`disableMultipleColumnsSorting`). Quick filter: every typed word must be in some filterable
column's text. Filter panel: one item; operators per type; `isEmpty` / `isNotEmpty` need no value;
filters and search reset the page. Pagination: TablePagination; rows of other pages are `hidden`.
Selection (checkboxSelection): row checkboxes, the header checkbox (all filtered rows; mixed state),
row click (not on controls; off with `disableRowSelectionOnClick`), Space, Ctrl / Cmd + A. Column
menu: sort asc / desc, unsort, filter (opens the filter panel on that column), hide, manage
columns (the last two need the toolbar). Columns panel: one switch per hideable column. Density
menu. Export: CSV (BOM, CRLF, header names, shown non-action columns, filtered and sorted rows;
`=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, tab and CR prefixed with `'`) and Print (core `printGridContent`: a hidden
iframe with copies of the page's style sheets and of the grid as shown; no markup strings).
Filters: rows combine with and (default) or or; removing the last row clears the filter.
Resizing: drag the end edge of a header (core `createGridColumnControls`) or Alt + arrows
(10px); widths at least `minWidth`; the release doesn't sort. Reordering: drag a header onto
another, or Move left / right. Pinning: Pin to left / right, Unpin; pinned cells are sticky
(`syncGridPinning` measures header widths into `--_ok-data-grid-pin`), the checkbox column joins
the left side. Editing: double click, Enter or F2 on an editable cell; text / number / date /
datetime-local inputs, a select for `singleSelect`, a checkbox for `boolean`; Enter commits, Escape
cancels, leaving the cell (row mode: the row) commits; focus returns to the cell. HTML shows the
committed value as text (no formatters) and fires `ok:data-grid:edit` (cancelable).
Virtualization (on unless `disableVirtualization`): once the main area is measured and scrolls
(bounded height), only the rows within the visible area ± 150px (`GRID_ROW_BUFFER`) are in the DOM;
padding on the body stands for the rest. The first render and SSR show every row. Grids that grow
with their rows don't virtualize. Server modes: the grid reports the model and shows the rows as
given; `rowCount` (HTML `data-ok-row-count`) is the pagination total. Loading: `loading` (HTML
`data-ok-loading`) shows the overlay and sets `aria-busy`. Infinite loading: within
`scrollEndThreshold` px of the end, `onRowsScrollEnd` / `ok:data-grid:scrollend` fire once per row
count. Data source: asked on mount and on every sort, filter and page change (`{ sortModel,
filterModel, paginationModel }`); responses are cached per request; a stale response is dropped;
loading shows meanwhile. HTML rows from data: `setRows(rows)` copies the row template and sets each
cell's text (or fills the cell template's value slots); never markup.
Phase 4. Selection: `disableMultipleRowSelection` selects one row at a time (no select all,
`aria-multiselectable` off; the header checkbox cell is named "Checkbox selection"); unselectable
rows have a disabled checkbox and ignore clicks; `checkboxSelectionVisibleOnly` limits select all to
the page; new rows drop the ids that went away unless `keepNonExistentRowsSelected` (not on mount).
Autosize: each rendered cell (and header, + 64px for its icons) measured at `width: max-content`,
clamped to min / max width; on mount again after `document.fonts.ready`; double click on a resize
handle. Spans: `colSpan` hides the covered cells (`grid-column: span`); `rowSpanning` merges
neighbouring cells of a column with the same text on the page (the first cell overflows the rows
below; the row keeps its height; the window starts at a span's first row); arrows up / down keep the
column and pass covered cells. Row heights: per-row px or `auto` (text wraps, measured after
render; the window uses per-row offsets), spacing as margins; `rowHeight` × density factor (0.7, 1,
1.3). Editing: `isCellEditable` / `data-ok-editable="false"`; a printable key on a focused editable
cell opens it with that character; `preProcessEditCellProps` (HTML: `ok:data-grid:validate`, a
listener sets `detail.error`) marks the field `aria-invalid` and shows the message; Enter and
leaving keep the cell open while it has an error, Escape cancels. Filters: `isAnyOf` takes a list
(the panel's field takes values separated by commas); custom operators replace the type's;
`ignoreDiacritics` folds accents (and đ). Export: CSV options; Print prints every filtered, sorted
row of every page (the toolbar, footer and checkboxes only when asked). Right to left: from
`direction`; left pins sit at the start (inline-start), Left / Right and Alt + Left / Right follow
the reading order, dragging a resize handle left widens.
Phase 5. Tree data: every row renders (children of closed rows `hidden`); Right / Left on a
parent's group cell opens / closes it (Left on a child goes to its parent); filters keep the
ancestors of matching rows; sorting orders siblings; HTML `ok:data-grid:expand` (cancelable,
`{ id, expanded }`). A path whose parents have no row gets generated parent rows (`auto-generated-row-<path>`). Detail panels: a
toggle column; the panel row follows its row (measured with it by virtualization); HTML builds it
from the row's template (`ok:data-grid:detailpanel`, cancelable). Row reordering: off while
sorted, filtered, tree or lazy; drag a handle (a line marks the drop) or Alt + Up / Down;
announced in the live region; HTML `ok:data-grid:roworder` (cancelable, `{ id, oldIndex,
targetIndex }`). Pinned rows: sticky rowgroups (under the header height the owner measures),
counted in `aria-rowindex` / `aria-rowcount`, not sorted, filtered, paged or selectable. Column
groups: one header row per level; neighbouring shown columns of a group share a cell (hidden or
moved columns split it); moves across groups are refused. List view: headers and column cells
`hidden`, the list cell shown. Column virtualization (fixed widths only; no spans, groups or list
view): template = specials + left pins + spacer + visible tracks + spacer + right pins; React
omits the other cells, HTML hides them. Lazy loading: rows are placeholders until their chunk (50
rows) loads; before the first measure only the first chunk renders. `updateRow` runs after an
accepted edit; its answer is shown, a failure brings the old values back.
Phase 6. Row grouping: one group per distinct cell text of each grouped field (nested in the model's
order); groups count their filtered rows; the column menu groups and ungroups; data rows keep the
group column empty. Sorting orders groups by key (sort on a grouped field or the group column), by
aggregated value (sort on an aggregated field), else by their first row. Aggregation: `sum` /
`avg` (2 decimals) / `min` / `max` (numbers and dates) / `size`; values left out when a row has
none (pivot buckets); groups show theirs inline, the footer row the filtered rows' (`all`: every
row); a function that doesn't fit the column type is ignored. Pivot: groups of the `rows` fields,
one column per distinct key tuple of the `columns` fields (sorted, `desc` per field) × value; column
groups name the keys; leaves never show; filters run on the data first; exports keep the data
columns and rows. Excel: core `gridToXlsx` (stored ZIP, inline strings, typed numbers, booleans and
dates, bold header, column widths); text never becomes a formula. Clipboard: Ctrl / Cmd + C copies
the selected cells (else selected rows, else the focused cell) as TSV; Ctrl / Cmd + V pastes into
editable cells from the selection's corner or the focused cell; one value fills the selection; each
row goes through `processRowUpdate` (HTML: `ok:data-grid:edit`, cancelable); the browser's own copy
/ paste runs on a short-lived text area (core `createGridClipboard`), no permission asked. Cell
selection: press, drag, Shift + press, Ctrl / Cmd + press (toggle) or drag (add), Shift + arrows,
Ctrl / Cmd + A (every cell of the page); core `createGridCellSelection` reports intent. Header
filters: one field per column (the type's first operator; booleans and singleSelect a select, dates
a DatePicker, date times a DateTimePicker) sharing the filter model; Up / Down leave a field. Filter
panel: `date` columns pick their value with a DatePicker, `dateTime` columns with a DateTimePicker
(value `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss`, local time). Charts: categories are the top-level groups (their values aggregated
over the rows that pass the filters, with the model's function, else `sum`) or the page's rows
(`dimension` texts); series are number fields (core `gridChartFields`; pivoted: the pivot columns of
each value field, named by their keys, plus the value column when several are drawn); types
`column` / `bar` (horizontal bars) / `line` / `area` / `pie` / `donut` (the first series, one slice
per category, `colors` per slice) / `radar` / `scatter` (rows with a number dimension: `[x, y]`
points on a numeric axis; otherwise one point per category). Core `gridChartOptions` maps the model
to the Chart's options for both implementations; `stacked` needs a column, bar, line or area chart
with two series (the panel's switch is disabled otherwise). Every change (rows, edits, filters,
sorting, paging, grouping, aggregation, pivoting, the model) redraws through the Chart's update
path: React passes new `series`, HTML calls `updateSeries` (the data table follows in place). Navigation ignores grids inside cells
(a date picker's calendar) and leaves their tab stops alone.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body:
| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| Tab | Into / out of the grid (one stop) |
| Arrow keys | Move between cells (header included); controls inside cells take the focus |
| Home / End | First / last cell of the row (Ctrl: of the grid) |
| Page Up / Page Down | One screen of rows |
| Enter / Space (header) | Sort (Shift: add) |
| Ctrl / Cmd + Enter (header) | Column menu |
| Space (cell) | Toggle the row's selection |
| Ctrl / Cmd + A | Select / clear every row |
| Alt + ← / → (header) | Narrower / wider by 10px |
| Enter / F2 (editable cell) | Edit; in the field: Enter commits, Escape cancels |
| A character (editable cell) | Edit, starting with that character |
| Right to left | Left / Right and Alt + Left / Right follow the reading order |
| Shift + arrows (cellSelection) | Extend the cell range from the anchor |
| Ctrl / Cmd + C, Ctrl / Cmd + V (cell) | Copy (cells, rows or the focused cell) / paste into editable cells |
| Up / Down (header filter field) | Move to the cell above / below |
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
`role=grid` named by `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` (never the root), counts and indexes,
`aria-sort` on sortable headers (`none` until sorted), `aria-selected` on rows with selection,
`aria-multiselectable`. Checkboxes named "Select all rows" / "Select row"; menu buttons
"<header> column menu". The overlay is a `status`.
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML: `ok:data-grid:sort | filter | selection | columns | density | order | pinned` (cancelable,
`{ model }`), `ok:data-grid:resize` (`{ field, width }`), `ok:data-grid:edit` (cancelable,
`{ id, row }`: the edited fields); instance `{ sortModel, filterModel, selection,
columnVisibilityModel, columnOrder, pinnedColumns, columnWidths, setSortModel, setFilterModel,
setSelection, setColumnVisibilityModel, setColumnOrder, setPinnedColumns, setColumnWidth,
toCsv(), exportCsv() }`.
`ok:data-grid:scrollend` (`{ visibleRowsCount }`), `ok:data-grid:datasourceerror` (`{ error }`);
instance `setRows(rows)`, `setDataSource(source | null)`. Phase 4: `ok:data-grid:rowclick` /
`rowdoubleclick` (`{ id }`), `cellclick` / `celldoubleclick` (`{ id, field, value }`),
`columnheaderclick` (`{ field }`), `editstart` / `editstop` (`{ id, field?, reason }`), `validate`
(`{ id, field, value, error? }`: set `error`); instance `print(options)`, `autosizeColumns(options)`,
`scrollToIndexes({ rowIndex, colIndex })`, `exportState()`, `restoreState(state)`,
`setFilterOperators(field, operators)`, `setValueFormatter(field, fn | null)`,
`setLocaleText(labels)` (the text the runtime writes; the markup is written in the page's
language), `toCsv(options)` / `exportCsv(options)`. Phase 5: `ok:data-grid:expand`,
`ok:data-grid:detailpanel`, `ok:data-grid:roworder`; instance `setRowChildrenExpansion(id,
open)`, `toggleDetailPanel(id)`; attributes `data-ok-csv-options` / `data-ok-print-options` (JSON,
known keys only; React writes them from `csvOptions` / `printOptions`).
Phase 6: `ok:data-grid:rowgrouping | aggregation | cellselection | chart` (cancelable, `{ model }`),
`ok:data-grid:pivot` (cancelable, `{ model, active }`), `ok:data-grid:clipboardcopy` (`{ data }`),
`ok:data-grid:clipboardpaste` (cancelable, `{ data }`: the pasted cells); instance
`rowGroupingModel`, `aggregationModel`, `pivotModel`, `pivotActive`, `cellSelectionModel`,
`chartModel` with `set…` (no events; the chart panel's fields follow the model),
`toExcel(options)`, `exportExcel(options)`.
Attributes: `data-ok-label-no-rows`, `data-ok-label-no-results`, `data-ok-export-file-name`.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
The grid scrolls horizontally inside its main area (header sticky); the toolbar wraps; panels fit
the viewport (filter fields wrap to one column). Stacking while scrolling, lowest first: cell content
(each body cell isolates it), row-span cells, pinned cells, pinned rows and the aggregation footer,
the cell being edited, the header (column groups, header filters); the loading layer sits above.
`e2e/tests/data-grid.scroll.spec.ts` checks it for every story.
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
React renders every filtered row (other pages `hidden`) and writes the template through `style`;
the HTML runtime writes it through CSSOM and keeps filtered-out rows `hidden` (parity skips hidden
rows and `style`). `data-ok-count` on the pagination is HTML-only (ignored). With virtualization
both render the same window (same measure). Row templates are HTML-only (`<template>` is skipped).
Phase 4: functions (`getRowHeight`, `isRowSelectable`, `colSpan`, `isCellEditable`, class names)
are React-only; React writes their result as attributes that HTML reads (`data-ok-row-height`,
`data-ok-selectable`, `aria-colspan`, `data-ok-editable`, `class`). HTML computes row spans itself.
`data-ok-format` and `setValueFormatter` are HTML-only (React has `valueFormatter`). `isAnyOf`
shows Autocomplete chips in both (HTML from the panel's template, with no suggestions).
Phase 5: React renders a detail panel only when open (HTML keeps templates); collapsed tree rows
render `hidden`; column-virtualized cells are left out in React and `hidden` in HTML (parity skips
both).
Phase 6: HTML builds group rows, the footer row and the pivot's headers itself from the rows in the
markup (the markup's generated group rows are dropped and built again; tree data keeps its
generated parents). The pivot story's HTML is the grid's data with `data-ok-pivot-active` (so is the
Charts integration story's "Pivot chart", whose chart table and panel hold the pivoted chart).
React-only: `aggregationFunctions` (custom functions), `getAggregationPosition`,
`splitClipboardPastedText`, `clipboardCopyCellDelimiter`, `ignoreValueFormatterDuringExport`
(HTML: tab-separated, formatted text). The chart's SVG is the Chart runtime's (parity skips `<svg>`).

components.summary: Rows of data in columns that people sort, search, filter, page, select, show / hide and export. An ARIA grid on `div`s laid out with CSS grid. Core `data-grid.ts` holds the data model (sort, filter, quick filter, selection, column template, CSV); core `createGridNavigation` the keyboard. React keeps the state in props / state; the HTML runtime `data-grid` keeps it in the DOM (rows moved and `hidden`).

sections.body:
Type a date, a time or both in a sectioned field, or pick them from a calendar and clocks: in a
popover (pointer devices), a dialog (touch) or inline. One engine in core (`core/src/pickers/`):
dates in local time, ISO 8601, formats split into sections, locale data from `Intl`, validation,
the month grid, the time model (`time.ts`), and controllers that report intent
(`createFieldController`, `createCalendarController`, `createTimeClockController`,
`createDigitalClockController`, `createRangeDragController`; the range model in `range.ts`). React
keeps state in props / hooks; the HTML runtimes (`date-field`, `date-calendar`, `month-calendar`,
`year-calendar`, `time-clock`, `digital-clock`, `multi-section-digital-clock`, `date-picker`,
`date-range-calendar`, `multi-input-range-field`, `date-range-picker`) keep it in the DOM. Range
values are `[start, end]` pairs (React) and ISO 8601 intervals `start/end` (HTML, ADR-0028). Every MUI X tier is free
(ADR-0022). Time and date time fields and pickers are the same anatomy with
`data-ok-value-type="time" | "date-time"` (ADR-0026).

```
        | div[role=radiogroup][data-ok-year-calendar] › button[role=radio][data-ok-picker-year][data-ok-value][aria-checked]
    div[data-ok-picker-actions][hidden]? › button[data-ok-button][data-ok-picker-action][hidden]?…
```
MonthCalendar / YearCalendar on their own are the radio group above as the root. React renders
`data-ok-runtime="off"` on every root.

Time views (ADR-0026) — in `div[data-ok-picker-content]`, or on their own:
```
div[id][data-ok-time-clock][data-ok-ampm][data-ok-view][data-ok-views][data-ok-value]?[data-ok-ampm-in-clock]?
    [data-ok-minutes-step]?[data-ok-min-time]?[data-ok-max-time]?[data-ok-read-only]?[data-ok-disabled]?[hidden]?
  div[data-ok-time-clock-dial]
    span[data-ok-time-clock-pin]
    span[data-ok-time-clock-pointer][data-ok-inner]?[data-ok-between]?[hidden]?          (--_ok-clock-angle)
    div[role=listbox][data-ok-time-clock-options][tabindex][aria-label][aria-activedescendant]?
      span[role=option][id][data-ok-time-clock-number][data-ok-position=0…11][data-ok-inner]?[data-ok-value]
          [aria-label][aria-selected]?[aria-disabled]?
  div[data-ok-time-clock-meridiems]? › button[data-ok-time-clock-meridiem=am|pm][aria-pressed]   (ampmInClock)
  div[data-ok-time-clock-nav] › button[data-ok-icon-button][data-ok-time-clock-prev] + button[…-next]
div[data-ok-digital-clock][data-ok-ampm][data-ok-time-step][data-ok-value]?[data-ok-skip-disabled]?…
  ul[role=listbox][data-ok-digital-clock-list][aria-label]
    li[role=option][data-ok-digital-clock-item][data-ok-value=HH:mm:ss][tabindex][aria-selected][aria-disabled]?
div[role=group][data-ok-multi-section-digital-clock][data-ok-ampm][data-ok-views][data-ok-time-steps][data-ok-value]?…
  ul[role=listbox][data-ok-digital-clock-section=hours|minutes|seconds|meridiem][aria-label]
    li[role=option][data-ok-digital-clock-item][data-ok-value][tabindex][aria-selected][aria-disabled]?
```
Range components (ADR-0028):
```
div[id][data-ok-date-range-calendar][data-ok-calendars][data-ok-current-month-calendar-position]
    [data-ok-range-position][data-ok-month][data-ok-value=start/end]?[data-ok-disable-drag-editing]?…
  div[data-ok-date-range-calendar-month]                                   (1–3)
    div[data-ok-date-range-calendar-header]
      button[data-ok-icon-button][data-ok-date-calendar-prev]?             (first month)
      div[data-ok-date-calendar-label][id=<id>-label-<n>][aria-live=polite]
      button[data-ok-icon-button][data-ok-date-calendar-next]?             (last month)
    div[role=grid][data-ok-day-calendar][aria-labelledby][aria-multiselectable=true]   (the day grid above)
      … button[data-ok-picker-day][aria-selected][data-ok-range-start]?[data-ok-range-end]?[data-ok-in-range]?
          [data-ok-preview-start]?[data-ok-preview-end]?[data-ok-in-preview]?
div[data-ok-text-field][data-ok-date-field][data-ok-range][data-ok-value=start/end]?…   (single input range field:
    the sections of both dates, " – " between them; input[type=hidden] carries the interval)
div[role=group][data-ok-multi-input-range-field][data-ok-value-type]?[data-ok-value]?[data-ok-full-width]?
  div[data-ok-date-field] (start) + span[data-ok-multi-input-range-field-separator][aria-hidden] + div[data-ok-date-field] (end)
  div[data-ok-text-field-helper][data-ok-multi-input-range-field-helper]?
div[data-ok-date-range-picker][data-ok-picker-variant][data-ok-calendars]?[data-ok-value-type]?[data-ok-open]?…
  single input range field | multi input range field   (open buttons: button[data-ok-date-picker-open][data-ok-range-position]? )
  popover / dialog / inline as the date picker, holding div[data-ok-picker-layout]:
    div[data-ok-picker-toolbar][data-ok-range-toolbar]? › overline + div[data-ok-picker-toolbar-content] ›
        span[data-ok-picker-toolbar-part] › (span[data-ok-picker-toolbar-separator])? button[data-ok-picker-toolbar-button][data-ok-range-position][aria-pressed]
    div[data-ok-tabs][data-ok-picker-tabs][data-ok-picker-range-tabs]?     (time and date time ranges: Start / End)
    ul[data-ok-picker-shortcuts]? › … span[data-ok-chip][data-ok-picker-shortcut][data-ok-value=start/end]
    div[data-ok-picker-content] › date range calendar? + digital clock (desktop)? + time clock (mobile / static)?
    div[data-ok-picker-actions]?
```

Phase 4 (ADR-0030) adds no part: `data-ok-timezone` (`UTC` or an IANA name) and
`data-ok-calendar` (`persian`, `islamic-umalqura`, `islamic-civil`, `islamic-tbla`, `buddhist`,
`indian`) sit on any root or ancestor, as `data-ok-locale` does (the locale's `-u-ca-` extension
names the calendar too). A view from a custom renderer is wrapped in `div[data-ok-picker-view]`
(`hidden` in the other tab); the built-in renderers render their view directly. A picker whose
views are all `null` has no open button, popover or dialog. Custom slots keep the hooks:
`[data-ok-picker-actions] › [data-ok-picker-action]`, `[data-ok-picker-toolbar-title]`,
`[data-ok-picker-shortcut][data-ok-value]`.

Time and date time pickers: `div[data-ok-date-picker][data-ok-value-type][data-ok-open-to]?` with a
field `[data-ok-value-type]`; the toolbar is `span[data-ok-picker-toolbar-overline]` +
`div[data-ok-picker-toolbar-content] › div[data-ok-picker-toolbar-date]? ›
button[data-ok-picker-toolbar-button][data-ok-view=year|day…][data-ok-selected]?` +
`div[data-ok-picker-toolbar-time] › span[data-ok-picker-toolbar-part] › (span[data-ok-picker-toolbar-separator])?
button[data-ok-picker-toolbar-button][data-ok-view=hours|minutes|seconds]` +
`div[data-ok-picker-toolbar-ampm]? › button[data-ok-picker-toolbar-meridiem=am|pm][aria-pressed]`;
date time pickers add `div[data-ok-tabs][data-ok-picker-tabs]` (the Tabs component, `fullWidth`,
icon tabs `value="date" | "time"`). The content holds the calendar (date views), the desktop
digital clock (`DigitalClock` or `MultiSectionDigitalClock`, desktop and responsive) and the
`TimeClock` (mobile, static and responsive); the views of the other form are `hidden`.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `date-picker`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `date-calendar`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `date-field`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `time-clock`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `digital-clock`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `multi-section-digital-clock`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `date-range-picker`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `date-range-calendar`: listed under "options".)

Time attributes (strings, ADR-0026): `data-ok-value` on clocks (`HH:mm:ss`), `data-ok-min-time`,
`data-ok-max-time` (ISO times), `data-ok-min-date-time`, `data-ok-max-date-time` (ISO date
times), `data-ok-disable-ignoring-date-part-for-time-validation`, `data-ok-views` (`hours minutes
seconds`), `data-ok-view`, `data-ok-time-steps` (`"1 5 5"`: hours minutes seconds),
`data-ok-open-to` (time and date time pickers). Fields and pickers also take `data-ok-minutes-step`.

Phase 4 attributes (strings, not in the schema): `data-ok-timezone` (closest ancestor; values in
the markup are that zone's wall times, ISO input may carry an offset), `data-ok-calendar`
(closest ancestor; ignored when the locale names a calendar). `data-ok-month` is `YYYY-MM` in the
Gregorian calendar, else the ISO date of the shown month's first day; month buttons' and year
buttons' `data-ok-value` are the calendar's month index and year.

Other attributes (strings, not in the schema): `data-ok-value`, `data-ok-min-date`,
`data-ok-max-date` (ISO 8601), `data-ok-format` (Day.js tokens), `data-ok-views` (`year month
day`), `data-ok-month` (`YYYY-MM`, the shown month), `data-ok-actions` (`clear today cancel
accept nextOrAccept`), `data-ok-desktop-mode-media-query`, `data-ok-locale` (on the element or an
ancestor), `data-ok-disabled` (calendar). Invalid values fall back to the default.

### API mapping (MUI X, ADR-0015)
- **Kept:** `value` / `defaultValue`, `onChange` (`(value, { validationError })`), `onAccept`,
  `onError`, `open`, `views`, `openTo`, `view` / `onViewChange`, `format`, `formatDensity`,
  `minDate`, `maxDate`, `disablePast`, `disableFuture`, `shouldDisableDate` / `Month` / `Year`,
  `closeOnSelect`, `desktopModeMediaQuery`, `keepOpenDuringFieldFocus`, `reduceAnimations`,
  `displayWeekNumber`, `fixedWeekNumber`, `showDaysOutsideCurrentMonth`,
  `disableHighlightToday`, `dayOfWeekFormatter`, `monthsPerRow`, `yearsPerRow`, `yearsOrder`,
  `orientation`, `loading`, `renderLoading`, `onMonthChange`, `onYearChange`, `referenceDate`,
  `autoFocus`, `selectedSections` / `onSelectedSectionsChange` (section index), `readOnly`,
  `disabled`, `label`, `name`, `inputRef` (the hidden input), `localeText`;
  `LocalizationProvider` `adapterLocale`, `localeText`.
- **Renamed:** `onOpen` / `onClose` / `onCancel` → `onOpenChange(open, reason)` (reasons `button`,
  `escape`, `clickaway`, `accept`, `cancel`, `select`, `clear`, `today`, `shortcut`, `api`);
  `slotProps.actionBar.actions` → `actions`; `slotProps.shortcuts.items` → `shortcuts`;
  `slotProps.field.clearable` / `onClear` → `clearable` / `onClear`; `slotProps.textField` →
  the TextField props (`helperText`, `error`, `variant`, `size`, `fullWidth`, `required`).
- **Beyond MUI:** `today` (React: pins "today" for demos and tests); `aria-current="date"` on
  today; HTML `data-ok-locale`; a hidden ISO input for forms.
- **Kept (phase 2):** `ampm`, `ampmInClock`, `minTime`, `maxTime`, `minDateTime`,
  `maxDateTime`, `minutesStep`, `shouldDisableTime`, `disableIgnoringDatePartForTimeValidation`,
  `timeSteps`, `timeStep` (DigitalClock), `thresholdToRenderTimeInASingleColumn`, `skipDisabled`,
  time `views` / `openTo` / `view` / `onViewChange`; `onChange(value, selectionState)` of the
  clocks (`"shallow"` while dragging, `"partial"`, `"finish"`); `localeText` keys
  `timePickerToolbarTitle`, `dateTimePickerToolbarTitle`, `openTimePickerDialogue`,
  `openPreviousView`, `openNextView`, `clockLabelText`, `hours/minutes/secondsClockNumberText`,
  `selectViewText`, `dateTableLabel`, `timeTableLabel`.
- **Defaults (MUI v9, as the reference shows):** time and date time pickers don't close on a
  pick; their action bar is Cancel + OK (mobile and static date time: Cancel + Next / OK).
- **Kept (phase 3, Pro):** `value` / `defaultValue` as `[start, end]`, `onChange(value, {
  validationError: [start, end] })`, `onError`, `onAccept`, `calendars`,
  `currentMonthCalendarPosition`, `rangePosition` / `defaultRangePosition` /
  `onRangePositionChange`, `availableRangePositions` (DateRangeCalendar), `disableDragEditing`,
  `disableAutoMonthSwitching`, range `shortcuts` (`getValue({ isValid })` returns a range); the
  validation error `invalidRange`; `localeText` keys `start`, `end`, `startDate`, `startTime`,
  `endDate`, `endTime`, `dateRangePickerToolbarTitle`, `timeRangePickerToolbarTitle`,
  `dateTimeRangePickerToolbarTitle`.
- **Renamed (phase 3):** `slots.field: MultiInput…RangeField` → `multiInput`;
  `slotProps.textField` per end → `startLabel` / `endLabel`.
- **Beyond MUI (phase 3):** ISO 8601 intervals in HTML (`data-ok-value`, the hidden input of a
  single input field, shortcut chips); open buttons on range fields (MUI v8+ has them on single
  input fields; multi input fields get one per end, each opening on its end); `openRangePickerDialogue`
  names them; Start / End tabs on every form of time and date time ranges (MUI shows them on
  touch screens; with one field, they choose the edited end on desktop too).
- **Kept (phase 4, ADR-0030):** `timezone` (`"default" | "system" | "UTC" |` IANA) on every
  picker, field, calendar and clock; `LocalizationProvider` `dateAdapter`; `PickerValidDate`
  (declaration merging); `viewRenderers` (`renderDateViewCalendar`, `renderTimeViewClock`,
  `renderDigitalClockTimeView`, `renderMultiSectionDigitalClockTimeView`, `null`); `slots`
  `layout`, `toolbar`, `actionBar`, `shortcuts`, `day`, `openPickerIcon`, `leftArrowIcon`,
  `rightArrowIcon`, `switchViewIcon`; `slotProps` `toolbar.hidden`, `tabs.hidden`, `day` (object
  or function of the owner state), `layout`; `usePickerContext()` (value, `setValue`, `open`,
  `setOpen`, views, `acceptValueChanges`, `cancelValueChanges`, `clearValue`,
  `setValueToToday`, `goToNextStep`; ranges add `rangePosition` / `setRangePosition`);
  `PickersDay` → `PickerDay`, `PickersLayout` → `PickerLayout` (+ `PickerLayoutRoot`,
  `PickerLayoutContent`), `PickersActionBar` → `PickerActionBar`, `PickersShortcuts` →
  `PickerShortcuts`; locale packs (MUI X `xxXX` objects) as `pickersFrFR`, `pickersDeDE`,
  `pickersEsES`, `pickersJaJP`, `pickersZhCN`, `pickersFaIR`, `pickersArSD`.
- **Renamed (phase 4):** MUI X's adapter classes (`AdapterDayjs`…) → factories that take the
  library (`createDayjsAdapter(dayjs)`, `createDateFnsAdapter({ TZDate })`,
  `createLuxonAdapter(DateTime)`, `createMomentAdapter(moment)`); Jalali / Hijri adapters →
  an adapter's `calendar` option, `LocalizationProvider calendar` or the locale's `-u-ca-`.
- **Beyond MUI (phase 4):** calendar systems through `Intl` for any adapter (also Buddhist and
  Indian); HTML `data-ok-timezone`, `data-ok-calendar`, instance `date` / `setDate` /
  `setDateAdapter`, `setDayRenderer`; ISO input with offsets.
- **Not applicable:** other `slots` (`textField`, `field`, `popper`, `dialog`, `desktopPaper`,
  transitions: the TextField props, Popover and Dialog are ours), `sx`, `className` of parts,
  `disableOpenPicker` (deprecated: `viewRenderers` with `null`), `enableAccessibleFieldDOMStructure`
  (always on), `dateFormats` (`format` per picker). Range pickers take `viewRenderers` with
  `null` only.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Field: a TextField (outlined 56px); sections are `inline-flex`, tabular numbers, the focused one
on `rgb(primary / 0.24)`; empty sections show the placeholder in `--ok-text-disabled`; all
sections hide while the label rests in the box. Calendar: 320px (`--ok-spacing * 80`) × 336px,
header 12px / 4px margins, 24px / 12px padding, label `--ok-font-size-xl` medium; days 36px
(`--ok-spacing * 9`) with 2px gaps (rows 40px), six rows high (240px); weekday headers caption in
`--ok-text-secondary`; days caption `--ok-text-primary` (outside days `--ok-text-secondary`);
selected `--ok-palette-primary-main` / contrast text, medium weight, hover / focus
`--ok-palette-primary-dark`; today a 1px `--ok-text-secondary` ring; hover `--ok-action-hover`;
focus ring 2px primary. Month / year buttons 72 × 36px, `--ok-radius-full`, semibold
`--ok-font-size-xl`; year view scrolls at 280px. Popover paper: `--ok-radius-lg`, opaque paper,
no padding. Toolbar: 16px / 24px padding, overline + h4. Actions: 16px padding, 12px gap.
Time clock (ADR-0026): a 320px view, 220px face (`--ok-spacing * 55`) on `--ok-bg-neutral`,
numbers 36px on a 91px ring (24-hour clocks: an inner ring at 65 %, body2), a 6px pin and a 2px
pointer in `--ok-palette-primary-main` with a 36px thumb under the selected number (a 12px ring
between two numbers), arrows 12px from the top right. Digital clocks: lists scroll at 232px
(`--ok-spacing * 58`; 336px beside a calendar), columns 56px with `--ok-divider` between them,
options 48 × 38px pills (8px padding, `--ok-radius-sm`, body2), the selected one primary with
semibold contrast text. Time toolbar: 16px padding, h3 time buttons and separators in
`--ok-text-secondary` (the open view in `--ok-text-primary`), subtitle1 AM / PM; date time
toolbars add the year (subtitle1) and the day (h4). A divider sits above the action bar when a
digital clock shows.

Range calendar (ADR-0028): months 320px wide side by side, `--ok-divider` between them, the
month centered between the outer arrows; the range is a band behind the days in
`rgb(primary / 0.12)` (the days' `::before`, rounded at the ends of each week and month), the
start and the end filled like a selected day, a 1px dashed `--ok-text-disabled` outline over the
hovered or dragged preview. Range toolbar: h5 ends with an en dash. Multi input field: the two
TextFields stacked with a 16px gap, in a row with a dash from 600px.

Phase 4 tokens: none new (the RTL arrows mirror with `scale: -1 1`; logical insets).
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
Mobile first. Below 600px the layout is one column (toolbar, shortcuts as a wrapping row,
calendar, actions); from 600px shortcuts sit in a column beside the calendar, and
`orientation="landscape"` puts the toolbar on the left. Responsive pickers pick desktop or
mobile when they open (`(pointer: fine)` by default). The dialog paper never exceeds the screen
minus 32px; the calendar keeps 320px (fits 375px screens). Time pickers: from 600px a landscape
toolbar stacks the date, the time and a row of AM / PM; date time pickers put the tabs above the
content beside it. The desktop date time popover is the calendar plus the clock columns (about
490px wide). Range calendars wrap their months below each other when the space is narrower than
the months (a popover is at most the screen minus 32px); the dialog shows one month. Multi input
fields stack below 600px and never clip their text (the row wraps).
sections.title: Responsive behavior

sections.body:
`data-ok-shrink` (field has text), `data-ok-error` / `aria-invalid` (validation),
`data-ok-all-selected` (Ctrl / ⌘ + A), `data-ok-open` (picker), `aria-selected`,
`aria-checked`, `data-ok-today`, `data-ok-outside`, `disabled`, `:focus-visible`. Clocks:
`aria-selected` / `aria-disabled` on options, `aria-pressed` on AM / PM, `data-ok-selected` on the
toolbar's open view, `data-ok-inner` / `data-ok-between` on the pointer, `data-ok-view`. Ranges:
`data-ok-range-start`, `data-ok-range-end`, `data-ok-in-range`, `data-ok-preview-*`,
`data-ok-range-position`, `aria-pressed` on the toolbar ends, `data-ok-error` on both fields of an
`invalidRange`.
sections.title: States

sections.body:
- **Field:** sections from the format; ←/→ move, ↑/↓ ±1 (empty: today's part), Page ±5, Home /
  End min / max, digits and letters type (a complete section moves on; queries last 5s), Backspace
  / Delete empty the section (or all after select-all), paste fills every section when it matches
  the format. Partly filled = an invalid date (`validationError: "invalidDate"`). The browser never
  edits the text (`beforeinput` is canceled; IME text is restored).
- **Calendar:** picking a day reports `"finish"`; picking a year or month reports `"partial"` and
  moves to the next view (the value keeps its day when the month has it, else the closest enabled
  day). The header switch toggles the year view; arrows step months (disabled past the limits).
- **Pickers:** the open button opens; desktop closes on a pick (`closeOnSelect`), mobile and static
  don't. Dismiss (Escape, outside press, focus in the field unless `keepOpenDuringFieldFocus`):
  desktop accepts, mobile restores the value from opening. Actions: accept, cancel (restore),
  clear, today, nextOrAccept. Shortcuts set, accept and close.
- **Time clock:** a press or a drag picks the number under the pointer (`"shallow"` while
  dragging); the release finishes the view and moves to the next one (`"partial"`), the last view
  reports `"finish"`. Minutes and seconds snap to `minutesStep`; 24-hour clocks pick the inner
  ring under 74 / 220 of the face. Numbers outside the limits are `aria-disabled` and skipped.
- **Digital clocks:** a pick in a column moves focus to the next column; the last column (or the
  one list) reports `"finish"`. Lists scroll their selected option to the top when they appear.
- **Time and date time pickers:** desktop shows a DigitalClock when a day holds at most
  `thresholdToRenderTimeInASingleColumn` options (`24 × 60 / (hours step × minutes step)`, views
  hours and minutes only), else a MultiSectionDigitalClock (plus AM / PM); desktop date time shows
  the calendar beside the columns, and a picked day keeps the time. Mobile and static show the
  toolbar (its time buttons open their view, AM / PM change the meridiem) and the TimeClock; date
  time adds the date / time tabs and moves to the hours after the day. They don't close on a pick
  unless `closeOnSelect`.

- **Range calendar (ADR-0028):** the start position sets the start (a day after the end starts a
  new range) and moves to the end; the end position sets the end (a day before the start starts a
  new range) and reports `"finish"`. A hovered day (mouse) previews the range; pressing and
  dragging the start or the end (mouse or touch, `touch-action: none` on the ends) moves it, past
  the other end too (the ends swap); the click that ends a drag isn't a pick. After a new start,
  the end's month shows unless `disableAutoMonthSwitching`. Keys move across the months.
- **Range pickers:** desktop date ranges close when the end is picked (`closeOnSelect`); mobile
  and static show the toolbar (its ends choose the edited end) and Cancel / OK. Time and date time
  ranges show Start / End tabs; finishing the start's last view moves to the end, the end's last
  view finishes (they never close on a pick by default). Date time ranges pick the day (keeping
  the end's time) and then the time of the same end. Multi input fields open on the end of the
  pressed button. Range shortcuts set, accept and close; an empty interval resets.
- **Range validation:** each side's own error, or `invalidRange` on both when the end comes
  before the start (dates by day, times and date times by the instant). Partly typed sides are
  invalid dates.
- **Time zones (ADR-0030):** values are converted at the component's edge: the field, the
  calendar and the clocks show and edit the zone's wall time; callbacks get instants (in the
  value's zone with an adapter). "Today" and "now" (`disablePast`, highlights) are the zone's.
  `"default"` reads the value's zone, else the system's. A wall time the system zone skips moves
  by the gap.
- **Calendar systems:** months, years, day numbers and field sections follow the calendar;
  values stay ISO (Gregorian). Without a calendar the pickers are Gregorian, also for locales
  whose default isn't (`ar-SA`).
- **Right to left:** ← / → follow the reading direction in fields (sections) and calendars
  (days); month and clock arrows mirror; the clock face doesn't.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body:
| Key | Field | Calendar |
|---|---|---|
| ← / → | Previous / next section | Previous / next day |
| ↑ / ↓ | ±1 | Same day of the previous / next week |
| Page Up / Down | ±5 | Previous / next month (Shift: year) |
| Home / End | Smallest / largest value | First / last day of the week |
| Digits / letters | Type | — |
| Backspace / Delete | Empty the section (all after Ctrl / ⌘ + A) | — |
| Enter / Space | — | Pick |
| Escape | — | Close the picker |

| Key | Time clock (listbox) | Digital clocks |
|---|---|---|
| ↑ / ↓ | ±1 (minutes: ±`minutesStep`), skipping disabled numbers | Previous / next option (wraps) |
| Page Up / Down | ±5 | 5 options up / down |
| Home / End | Smallest / largest number | First / last option |
| Enter | Finish the view (next view) | Pick |
| Space | — | Pick |
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
Sections are spin buttons named by their part ("Month"), valued as text ("May"); the group is
named by the label and marked `aria-invalid`. The open button names the selected date. The grid is
named by its month; today has `aria-current="date"`; disabled days are `disabled`. Popover and
dialog are named "Select date"; focus goes to the current day on open and back to the button on
close. Brand-colored selections are exempt from `color-contrast` only (ADR-0014). Range grids are
`aria-multiselectable`: every day of the range is `aria-selected`; the band keeps the neutral text
(AA). The single range field's open button names the range ("Choose range, selected range is May
20, 2025 – May 25, 2025"); multi input buttons name their date; range dialogs are named "Select
date range" / "Select time range" / "Select date time range". Dragging has a keyboard
alternative (Enter on the start and on the end; the toolbar ends or the tabs pick the edited end). The time clock
is a listbox named "Select hours. Selected time is 09:30 AM" whose options are named "9 hours";
focus stays on the listbox (`aria-activedescendant`). Digital clock columns are listboxes named
"Select hours"; the multi-section clock is a named group. Time pickers' open button names the
time ("Choose time, selected time is 09:30 AM"); dialogs are named "Select time" / "Select date &
time"; the date time tabs are named "pick date" / "pick time".
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML: `ok:date-picker:change` (`{ value, validationError }`), `:accept` (`{ value }`), `:open` /
`:close` (`{ reason }`); `ok:date-field:change` (cancelable), `:clear`; `ok:date-calendar:change`
(cancelable, `{ value, selectionState }`), `:viewchange`, `:monthchange`, `:yearchange`;
`ok:month-calendar:change`, `ok:year-calendar:change` (cancelable). Instances: date-picker `{ value,
setValue, isOpen, open, close, setShortcuts, setShouldDisableDate / Month / Year, setLocaleText }`;
date-field `{ value, validationError, setValue, focus, setShouldDisable…, setLocaleText }`;
date-calendar `{ value, setValue, view, setView, month, focus, setShouldDisable…,
setDayOfWeekFormatter, setLocaleText }`. React: callbacks above.
Phase 2: `ok:time-clock:change` (cancelable, `{ value: "HH:mm:ss", selectionState }`),
`:viewchange` (`{ view }`); `ok:digital-clock:change`, `ok:multi-section-digital-clock:change`
(cancelable, `{ value, selectionState }`). Instances: time-clock `{ value, setValue, view,
setView, setShouldDisableTime, setLocaleText }`; digital clocks `{ value, setValue,
setShouldDisableTime, setLocaleText }`; date-field and date-picker add `setShouldDisableTime`.
Values are ISO by type (`HH:mm:ss`, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss`).
Phase 4 (ADR-0030): every picker, field, calendar and clock instance adds `date` (the adapter's
dates, or `Date` instants; ranges `[start, end]`), `setDate(value)` and
`setDateAdapter(adapter | null)`; date-calendar, date-range-calendar, date-picker and
date-range-picker add `setDayRenderer((button, date) => void | null)` (runs on each built day,
errors ignored); `setLocaleText` also relabels the action bar. `setValue` takes ISO text with an
offset. React: `usePickerContext()` in custom slots, `usePickerDateConverter()`.
Phase 3 (ADR-0028): `ok:date-range-picker:change` (`{ value: "start/end" | null, validationError:
[start, end] }`), `:accept`, `:open` / `:close` (`{ reason }`), `:rangepositionchange`
(`{ rangePosition }`); `ok:date-range-calendar:change` (cancelable, `{ value, selectionState }`),
`:rangepositionchange`, `:monthchange`; `ok:multi-input-range-field:change` (cancelable; canceling
cancels the field's change); range `ok:date-field:change` reports `validationError: [start, end]`.
Instances: date-range-picker `{ value, setValue, rangePosition, setRangePosition, isOpen,
open(position?), close, setShortcuts, setShouldDisableDate, setShouldDisableTime, setLocaleText }`;
date-range-calendar `{ value, setValue, rangePosition, setRangePosition,
setAvailableRangePositions, calendars, setCalendars, month, focus, setShouldDisable…,
setDayOfWeekFormatter, setLocaleText }`; multi-input-range-field `{ value, validationError,
setValue }`; date-field adds `setError(error | null)`. React: `onChange(range, { validationError
})`, `onError(errors, range)`, `onRangePositionChange(position)`.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
React renders `data-ok-runtime="off"`. The HTML runtime rebuilds other months with DOM methods and
patches the same month in place; snippets are generated from the React examples. A responsive
picker renders the mobile actions and toolbar hidden while it is in its desktop form; responsive
time and date time pickers also render both forms' views (digital clock, tabs, time clock) and
hide the other form's. The clock pointer's angle is a private property (parity ignores `style`).
Range snippets are generated from the React examples too; the HTML range calendar rebuilds its
months with DOM methods and patches the same months in place. Phase 4 snippets too (custom days
get their dots from the story's page script, `setDayRenderer`); React writes `data-ok-timezone`
on zoned roots.

components.summary: Type a date, a time or both in a sectioned field, or pick them from a calendar and clocks: in a popover (pointer devices), a dialog (touch) or inline. One engine in core (`core/src/pickers/`): dates in local time, ISO 8601, formats split into sections, locale data from `Intl`, validation, the month grid, the time model (`time.ts`), and controllers that report intent (`createFieldController`, `createCalendarController`, `createTimeClockController`, `createDigitalClockController`, `createRangeDragController`; the range model in `range.ts`). React keeps state in props / hooks; the HTML runtimes (`date-field`, `date-calendar`, `month-calendar`, `year-calendar`, `time-clock`, `digital-clock`, `multi-section-digital-clock`, `date-picker`, `date-range-calendar`, `multi-input-range-field`, `date-range-picker`) keep it in the DOM. Range values are `[start, end]` pairs (React) and ISO 8601 intervals `start/end` (HTML, ADR-0028). Every MUI X tier is free (ADR-0022). Time and date time fields and pickers are the same anatomy with `data-ok-value-type="time" | "date-time"` (ADR-0026).

A modal surface. Runtime behavior: core `createModalController` (shared with Drawer: native
`showModal()`, fallback with inert siblings, focus trap and return, scroll lock, layer stack).
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
button[data-ok-dialog-open="id"][aria-haspopup=dialog]
dialog[data-ok-dialog][id][aria-labelledby][data-ok-max-width][data-ok-scroll]…
  › div[data-ok-dialog-paper]
      › h2[data-ok-dialog-title][id]
      › div[data-ok-dialog-content][data-ok-dividers]? › p[data-ok-dialog-content-text]?
      › div[data-ok-dialog-actions][data-ok-disable-spacing]? › … [data-ok-dialog-close]
```
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `dialog`: listed under "options".)

React: `open` / `onOpenChange(open, reason)` (escape | backdrop | close), `paperProps`; the title
names the dialog automatically (`aria-labelledby`, unless `aria-label` is given). Parts:
`DialogContent dividers`, `DialogActions disableSpacing`. Renamed: `onClose(event, reason)` →
`onOpenChange`; `PaperProps` → `paperProps`; `maxWidth={false}` → `"none"`;
`TransitionComponent` → `transition` (a Motion entrance on the paper: `data-ok-motion`,
`data-ok-variant`, `data-ok-trigger="mount"`; without it, the paper's own fade and scale).
Deferred: `keepMounted` (always mounted), exit transitions. Not applicable: `slots`, `slotProps`, `sx`, `BackdropComponent` (native `::backdrop`,
`--ok-backdrop`, the Backdrop component's token: a DOM Backdrop can't sit between a top-layer
`<dialog>` and its `::backdrop`), `disablePortal` (top layer).
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Paper: radius `--ok-radius-xl`, `--ok-shadow-dialog`, `--ok-bg-paper`, margin 16px (32px from
600px), max height viewport − 2 × margin; widths xs 444px, sm 600px, md/lg/xl the breakpoint
tokens. Title h6 (600) padding 24px; content padding 0 24px (dividers: 16px + 1px lines); content
text `--ok-text-secondary` body1; actions padding 24px, gap 12px. Full screen: no margin, radius,
shadow. Backdrop `--ok-backdrop`. Opening: fade + scale 0.96 (`--ok-duration-short`).
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body: Mobile-first margin (16px → 32px at 600px); the paper never exceeds the viewport.
sections.title: Responsive behavior

sections.body:
Native modal: inert page, Tab trapped, Escape → `onOpenChange(false, "escape")` (unless
`disableEscapeKeyDown`), backdrop click (press and release outside the paper). Focus: first tabbable
or `[autofocus]`, else the paper; returns to the trigger. Scrollable content gets
`tabindex="0"` + a name in the stories.
sections.title: Keyboard / Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML: `ok:dialog:beforeopen` (cancelable), `ok:dialog:open`, `ok:dialog:beforeclose` (cancelable,
`detail.reason`: escape | backdrop | trigger | api), `ok:dialog:close` (also `native`). Instance:
`{ isOpen, open(trigger?), close(reason?) }`. `data-ok-open` opens on load.

options.description: `temporary`: modal `<dialog>`; `persistent`: docked `<aside>` that opens and closes; `permanent`: docked, always shown.
options.name: variant

options.description: Temporary only: transparent backdrop (still modal).
options.name: hideBackdrop

options.name: open

sections.body: A modal panel that slides in from an edge of the screen (navigation, filters, details).
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
[trigger] button[data-ok-button][aria-haspopup="dialog"]     HTML: [data-ok-drawer-open="<id>"]
dialog[data-ok-drawer][data-ok-anchor][aria-label | aria-labelledby]   React: + data-ok-runtime="off"
  div[data-ok-drawer-content]                                the paper; any content
    … HTML close: [data-ok-drawer-close] (inside) or [data-ok-drawer-close="<id>"]
```
Scrolling content: put it in a Scrollbar inside the content — `[data-ok-drawer-content] ›
section[data-ok-scrollbar]`; the Scrollbar fills the panel and scrolls (the panel stops scrolling).
The dialog then focuses the Scrollbar first on open (it is the first focusable element).
The `<dialog>` is a transparent full-viewport container; the content is the paper. A click whose
target is the `<dialog>` itself is a backdrop click.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `drawer`: listed under "options".)

React: `<Drawer variant open | defaultOpen onOpenChange(open, reason)>` holds the state (reason:
`"escape"` · `"backdrop"` · `"close"`; refuse by not changing `open`); `anchor`, `hideBackdrop` and
`disableEscapeKeyDown` are props of `DrawerContent`. HTML initial state: `data-ok-open` (temporary)
or no `hidden` attribute (persistent); refuse a close with `ok:drawer:beforeclose`.

Docked variants (`persistent`, `permanent`) render `<aside>` in the page flow — no backdrop, no focus
trap, no scroll lock; their trigger toggles and carries `aria-expanded` + `aria-controls`. Put the
drawer and the page area in a flex row (left / right) or column (top / bottom).
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
- Paper `--ok-bg-paper`, text `--ok-text-primary`; backdrop: native `::backdrop` with `--ok-backdrop` (shared with the Backdrop component, which can't
  sit in the top layer; `hideBackdrop` matches its `invisible`); stacking `--ok-z-modal`
  (fallback path).
- `left` / `right`: full height, width from the content, at most `100% - 56px`; shadow
  `--ok-shadow-dialog-start` (left) / `--ok-shadow-dialog` (right).
- `top` / `bottom`: full width, height from the content, at most `100% - 56px`; shadow
  `--ok-shadow-z16`. Taller content scrolls inside the Scrollbar placed in the paper (without one,
  the paper itself scrolls).
- Opening slides the paper in from its edge and fades the backdrop (`--ok-duration-short`,
  `--ok-easing-decelerate`) where `@starting-style` is supported; closing is immediate.
  `prefers-reduced-motion` disables both.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
- **Open:** `showModal()` (fallback: `open` + `data-ok-fallback`, siblings inert, ADR-0006); push onto
  the layer stack; lock page scroll; focus `[autofocus]` → first tabbable → content.
- **Dismiss requests** (Escape, backdrop) are reported, not acted on: React updates state (controlled
  drawers may refuse); HTML emits cancelable `beforeclose`. Only the topmost layer reacts.
- **Close:** release lock and stack; focus returns to the trigger if focus was lost.
- **External close** (`<form method="dialog">`): state syncs. **Removal / unmount while open:**
  cleanup without focus restoration.
sections.title: Behavior (`core` `createModalController`)

sections.body:
`Tab` / `Shift+Tab` stay inside the drawer (native modals may hand focus to browser UI); `Escape`
requests close.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
Role `dialog`, modal. A name is required (`aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`). Background inert.
Focus returns to the trigger. Triggers carry `aria-haspopup="dialog"`.
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML: `ok:drawer:beforeopen` (cancelable) · `ok:drawer:open` · `ok:drawer:beforeclose`
(cancelable, `detail.reason`) · `ok:drawer:close` (`reason`: `escape` `backdrop` `trigger` `api`
`native`). Instance (`runtime.get(el, "drawer")`): `open(trigger?)`, `close(reason?)`, `toggle()`,
`isOpen`. React: `<Drawer open defaultOpen onOpenChange>`, `DrawerTrigger`, `DrawerContent`,
`DrawerClose`.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body: Same anchors at every breakpoint. The `56px` gap keeps the backdrop reachable on small screens.
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
Behavior hooks (`data-ok-drawer-open/close`, `data-ok-*-close` options, `data-ok-open`) exist only in
HTML; React expresses them as props and handlers.
sections.title: Parity notes
