sections.body:
Rich text editing: headings, marks, lists, alignment, code, quotes, links and images, with
HTML in and out. Tiptap (framework-free) runs in core `createEditorController`
(`@owlky/core/editor`), shared by React and the HTML runtime; the toolbar is Owlky markup.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
div[data-ok-editor][data-ok-full-item]?[data-ok-error]?[data-ok-editable="false"]?[data-ok-fullscreen]?[data-ok-placeholder]?
  div[data-ok-backdrop][data-ok-open]?                              (Backdrop, composed; open while fullscreen; optional in HTML)
  div[data-ok-editor-toolbar][role=toolbar][aria-label="Formatting"][aria-controls=<content id>]
    button[data-ok-editor-heading][aria-haspopup=menu][aria-expanded][aria-controls=<menu id>]   (HTML: data-ok-popover-open)
      span[data-ok-editor-heading-label] ("Paragraph", "Heading 1" … "Heading 6") + svg
    div[data-ok-editor-group][data-ok-full]?                       (9 groups; data-ok-full = only with fullItem)
      button[data-ok-editor-action=<action>][aria-label][aria-keyshortcuts]?[aria-pressed]?[disabled]?
        svg[aria-hidden]                                           (fullscreen: svg[data-ok-editor-icon=enter|exit])
  div[data-ok-editor-body]                                         (scrolls; grey 8% tint)
    div[data-ok-editor-content][id][role=textbox][aria-multiline=true][aria-label|aria-labelledby][aria-describedby]?[aria-invalid]?
      …content (Tiptap: contenteditable, class "tiptap ProseMirror", translate=no, aria-readonly when read only)
      div[data-ok-editor-code-block] › select[data-ok-editor-language][aria-label=Language]? + pre › code.language-<x>
        (select: "auto" (value ""), a disabled "—" rule, then the highlighter's languages)
      span[style="text-transform: uppercase|lowercase|capitalize"]  (text transform mark; input also data-ok-text-transform)
  p[data-ok-editor-helper][id]?
  Menu: div[data-ok-popover][id] › ul[data-ok-menu][role=menu][aria-labelledby=<heading>] › li[data-ok-menu-item][data-ok-editor-block=paragraph|h1…h6][data-ok-selected]?
        (each item in its block's type: Paragraph body2, Heading 1 17px … Heading 6 12px, bold)
  Popover (link): div[data-ok-popover][role=dialog][aria-labelledby] › form[data-ok-editor-form=link][novalidate]
    › p[data-ok-editor-form-title] + div[data-ok-editor-form-row] › TextField (input[data-ok-editor-field=href]) + Button[type=submit]
  Popover (image): same › form[data-ok-editor-form=image] › title + TextField (src) + TextField (alt) + Button[type=submit]
```
Actions: `bold italic underline strike | bulletList orderedList | alignLeft alignCenter alignRight
alignJustify | code codeBlock (full) | blockquote horizontalRule (full) | link unlink image |
hardBreak clearFormat | undo redo (full) | fullscreen`. Labels and keys: `editorToolbar` in core.
Action without a button: `textTransform` (`run("textTransform", { textTransform })`, as the
reference's TextTransform extension).
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `editor`: listed under "options".)

Other props: `value` / `defaultValue` / `onChange(html)` (`""` when empty), `placeholder`
(default "Write something awesome..."; HTML `data-ok-placeholder`), `helperText`, `highlighter`
(lowlight-compatible; HTML `createEditor({ highlighter })`), `onFullscreenChange(fullscreen)`,
`aria-label` (default "Editor") / `aria-labelledby` (go to the textbox).

API mapping (Minimals `Editor`): kept `value`, `onChange`, `editable`, `fullItem`, `error`,
`helperText`, `placeholder`. Added `defaultValue` (uncontrolled), `highlighter`,
`onFullscreenChange`, `aria-*`. Not applicable: `resetValue` (`value=""` resets), `slotProps`,
`sx`, `className` of the wrapper (root `className`). Deferred: Tiptap `extensions` /
`editorProps` pass-through, bubble menus, tables, mentions, a form `name` (hidden input) — none of
them is in the reference or the Minimals wrapper. Minimals' Tiptap extensions are all covered:
StarterKit, Placeholder, Image, TextAlign, CodeBlockLowlight (our code block + `highlighter`),
TextTransform, ClearFormat.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Root: 1px `rgb(grey-500 / 0.2)` border (error: `error-main`), radius `--ok-radius-md`, min height
240px, max height 720px. Toolbar: padding 10px, gap 8px, wraps; groups gap 4px, each preceded by a
1 × 16px rule. Buttons 28 × 28px, radius `--ok-radius-sm`, icons 18px; heading trigger 32px high,
min 120px, 1px border, body2 medium. Hover `--ok-action-hover` (hover devices), pressed /
expanded `--ok-action-selected`, disabled `--ok-text-disabled`, focus 2px inner outline. Body:
`rgb(grey-500 / 0.08)`, content padding 0 16px 16px, typography h1–h6 / body1, paragraphs 20px
apart, links `primary-main` (brand, ADR-0014), inline code `rgb(grey-500 / 0.2)` + text primary,
code blocks `grey-900` / white mono, padding 40px 24px 24px, lines wrap; syntax colors are palette
`*-light` tones (≥ 4.5:1 on grey-900). Fullscreen: fixed, inset 16px, `--ok-z-modal`, no shadow,
over the composed Backdrop (`--ok-backdrop`, `z-index: -1` inside the root's stacking context, so
the toolbar, body and helper carry the paper themselves). Heading menu items: Paragraph body2,
Heading 1 `font-size-xl × 17/16`, Heading 2–6 `font-size-xl / lg / md / sm / xs`, bold. Read
only: toolbar hidden.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
- Initial content: React `value ?? defaultValue` (HTML string); HTML: the markup inside the content
  element, parsed from the DOM (no string, no Trusted Types sink). Content keeps only what the
  schema knows (no scripts, handlers or unknown elements); links and images are checked with
  `safeEditorUrl` (http(s), mailto, tel, relative; images http(s) / relative; no `data:`).
- Tiptap's trailing node keeps an empty paragraph after a final block that isn't one.
- Controlled (`value`): a new `value` replaces the content; late echoes of values the editor
  reported itself are skipped (fast typing, batched renders). Edits the owner ignores are not
  undone (as Tiptap): rich text can't be held back key by key.
- Toolbar state (`aria-pressed`, `disabled`, heading label, selected menu item) follows every
  transaction (`onStateChange`). Undo / Redo / Remove link are disabled when they can't run.
- Link / image: the button opens its form popover (link prefilled with the current `href`); Apply
  is disabled until the URL is valid; submit (button or Enter) runs the action and closes it.
  A link with an empty selection inserts the URL as text.
- Fullscreen: the button toggles `data-ok-fullscreen` and opens the root's Backdrop
  (`data-ok-open`); Escape (outside popovers) leaves it. While fullscreen (core
  `holdEditorFullscreen`): page scroll locked (shared `lockScroll`), and focus leaving for the page
  wraps to the first tab stop (Tab) or the last one (Shift+Tab; links and the language menu inside
  the content aren't stops of their own). Focus leaving for the browser UI is let go. HTML markup
  that starts with `data-ok-fullscreen` is held at setup.
- Text transform: `span` with an allowed `text-transform` style or `data-ok-text-transform` is kept
  (other spans and values are dropped); output is always the `style` form (portable HTML).
- `editable=false`: `contenteditable=false`, `aria-readonly`, toolbar disabled and hidden.
- Tiptap's injected `<style>` is off (`injectCSS: false`, CSP); editor.css carries ProseMirror's rules.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body:
Toolbar: one tab stop (roving tabindex, `createToolbarNavigation`): ArrowLeft / ArrowRight
(wrap), Home, End. Text box: Tiptap defaults (Mod+B / I / U, Mod+Shift+S, Mod+Shift+7 / 8,
Mod+Shift+L / E / R / J, Mod+E, Mod+Alt+C, Mod+Shift+B, Shift+Enter, Mod+Z, Mod+Shift+Z) and
Mod+Shift+X (clear formatting, Owlky). Escape leaves fullscreen; Tab / Shift+Tab stay inside the
editor while fullscreen.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
Textbox named by `aria-label` (default "Editor") or `aria-labelledby`, described by the helper,
`aria-invalid` with `error`. Toolbar buttons named, `aria-pressed` for toggles,
`aria-keyshortcuts` for shortcuts; popover triggers `aria-haspopup` / `aria-expanded` /
`aria-controls`. Forms are dialogs named by their title; Escape closes them and focus returns to the
button. Fullscreen keeps Tab inside the editor (WCAG 2.4.11: no focus on controls hidden behind it). Content links use the brand color (contrast exempt, ADR-0014).
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML `ok:editor:change` (`{ value }`), `ok:editor:fullscreen` (`{ fullscreen }`). Instance
`{ value, setValue(html), fullscreen, setFullscreen(on), setEditable(on), focus(), controller }`.
Core: `EditorState.textTransform` (value at the selection), `run("textTransform", { textTransform:
"uppercase" | "lowercase" | "capitalize" | null })`, `TextTransform` (the mark),
`editorTextTransforms`, `readTextTransform`, `holdEditorFullscreen(root)`.
Registration is opt-in: `@owlky/html/editor`, `owlky-editor.js`, or `createEditor({ highlighter })`.
React: `onChange(html)`, `onFullscreenChange(fullscreen)`.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
The toolbar wraps at every width (mobile: three to four rows); the body scrolls inside the 720px
cap; forms are `min(320px, 100vw − 48px)` wide. The story puts editor and preview side by side from
900px, stacked below; the preview renders the editor's HTML with Markdown (`rawHtml`, ADR-0035),
as the reference does, in an outlined Card (`component="section"`) under a Typography `h6`
title (`component="h3"`).
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
React renders `data-ok-runtime="off"` (root and Backdrop); popover triggers carry
`data-ok-popover-open` in HTML only. Snippets write text transforms as `data-ok-text-transform`
(no `style` in snippets); the content DOM after mount is the same `style` form on both sides.
Both mount the same controller, so the content DOM matches after mount (React fills it from
`value`, HTML from the markup).
sections.title: Parity notes

sections.body:
Groups a control (or a group of controls) with its label and helper text and shares their states:
`disabled`, `error`, `required`, `focused`, plus `size`, `color`, `variant`, `fullWidth`,
`margin` for a composed input. CSS only: in HTML the states are attributes on the root that the
parts' CSS reads; in React a context (`useFormControl()`) carries them to the parts.

FormControl composes **around** selection controls (Checkbox, Radio, Switch with
FormControlLabel, RadioGroup, FormGroup) and standalone controls (Switch, Slider, Rating…). It
never goes inside TextField, which keeps its own label and helper parts. The controls' DOM and API
don't change: their ARIA (`aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid`, `aria-required`, `disabled`) is
written by the author on them, as in MUI.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
(div | fieldset)[data-ok-form-control][data-ok-color]?[data-ok-size]?[data-ok-variant]?[data-ok-margin]?
                [data-ok-full-width]?[data-ok-disabled]?[data-ok-error]?[data-ok-required]?[data-ok-focused]?
                [disabled]?                                          (fieldset: native disabled)
  (label | legend | span)[data-ok-form-label][data-ok-color]?[data-ok-disabled]?[data-ok-error]?
                         [data-ok-required]?[data-ok-focused]?[data-ok-filled]?[id]?[for]?
    …text
    span[data-ok-form-label-asterisk][aria-hidden="true"]?           (required: own or the root's)
  div[data-ok-form-group][data-ok-row]?                              › FormControlLabels
  | div[role=radiogroup][data-ok-radio-group][aria-labelledby][aria-describedby]?
  | a standalone control (its input has id, aria-describedby)
  p[data-ok-form-helper-text][data-ok-margin]?[data-ok-variant]?[data-ok-disabled]?[data-ok-error]?
                             [data-ok-required]?[data-ok-focused]?[data-ok-filled]?[id]?
```
Groups of controls: `fieldset` + `legend` (native group name), or a `div` root with a FormLabel
`id` referenced by the group's `aria-labelledby`. Standalone input: `label[for]`.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `form-control`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `form-label`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `form-group`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `form-helper-text`: listed under "options".)

Style options are written only when given (a plain group stays `data-ok-form-control` alone).

React: `component` on FormControl (default `div`), FormLabel (`label`), FormHelperText (`p`);
FormGroup `row`. A part's own state props add a state to it (`data-ok-*` on the part); the
FormControl's states reach the parts through CSS in both frameworks, so React writes the root's
states only on the root. FormLabel renders the asterisk when its own `required` or the
FormControl's is on (`required={false}` on the label hides it). `disabled` on a `fieldset`
FormControl is also written as the native `disabled`, which disables every control inside; on a
`div` root, pass `disabled` to each control. `useFormControl()` returns the shared state (or
`undefined` outside a FormControl).

API mapping (MUI → Owlky): every FormControl prop kept (`hiddenLabel` since the Select: a filled
Select without a label) except `sx` / `classes` (not applicable).
FormLabel / FormHelperText: every prop kept. FormGroup: `row` kept. MUI tracks `focused` and
`filled` from its InputBase; with no InputBase they are props here (see "Contract for Select").
MUI's selection controls take `disabled` from the FormControl context; here they don't (no change
to their API): a `fieldset` root disables them natively.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
- Root: `inline-flex` column, `min-width: 0`, no margin / padding / border (a `fieldset` too),
  `vertical-align: top`. `fullWidth` → `width: 100%`. `margin`: dense 8 / 4px, normal 16 / 8px
  (`--ok-spacing` × 2 / 1, × 4 / 2), like TextField.
- FormLabel: body2 (`--ok-typography-body2-*`), `--ok-text-secondary`, no padding; `legend` has
  no float or padding. Focused: `--ok-text-primary` (`color` default) or `--ok-palette-<c>-text`
  (through `--ok-c-text`, read on the root into `--_ok-form-focus`, since `--ok-c-*` don't
  inherit). Error: `--ok-palette-error-text`. Disabled: `--ok-text-disabled` (inactive; exempt
  from contrast like disabled controls). Error wins over focused, disabled over both. Asterisk:
  0.25ch before it.
- FormGroup: flex column, wrap; `row` → row. Same as RadioGroup.
- FormHelperText: caption (`--ok-typography-caption-*`), `--ok-text-secondary`, margin-top 6px
  (`--ok-spacing` × 1.5; dense 4px), inline 0; `outlined` / `filled` variant (own or the root's)
  indent 12px (× 3) like TextField's helper. Error: `--ok-palette-error-text`. Disabled keeps
  `--ok-text-secondary` (AA, as TextField's helper).
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
Intrinsic: the root shrinks (`min-width: 0`), groups wrap, label and helper text wrap
(`overflow-wrap: anywhere`).
sections.title: Responsive behavior

sections.body: None at runtime. States are attributes (and native `:disabled` on a fieldset root).
sections.title: States / Behavior

sections.body: The controls' own keyboard behavior. A `legend` / label doesn't take focus.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
- Groups: `fieldset` + `legend` name the group natively; a `div` root needs the group's
  `aria-labelledby` pointing at the FormLabel's `id`.
- Helper text: give it an `id` and reference it from the control or the group
  (`aria-describedby`).
- Error: `aria-invalid="true"` on the radio group or on each checkbox / input; required:
  `aria-required="true"` on a radio group, `required` on an input. The asterisk is `aria-hidden`.
- Label and helper text colors meet AA (4.5:1) except disabled labels (inactive).
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body: None. React `useFormControl()`.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Select composes FormControl + an InputLabel without changing this DOM:
- InputLabel = FormLabel (`label[data-ok-form-label][for]` + Select's own part attribute, such as
  `data-ok-input-label`, `data-ok-shrink`) inside the root; its float / shrink styles live in
  Select's CSS (`[data-ok-form-control]:has(> [data-ok-select])`).
- Select reads `useFormControl()` for `disabled`, `error`, `required`, `size`, `color`, `variant`,
  `fullWidth` and writes the resolved values on its own field box and trigger (as MUI's InputBase
  takes them from the context); the FormControl's attributes style the label and helper text.
- Focus and value: the root's CSS uses `:focus-within` / `:has()` on Select's parts in both
  frameworks (no React-only focus state, for parity): the hidden input's `:placeholder-shown`
  tells whether there is a value. No `data-ok-filled` and no context setters were needed.
- `hiddenLabel` (`data-ok-hidden-label`) arrived with Select's filled variant.
sections.title: Contract for Select (batch C; implemented, see select.md and ADR-0045)

sections.body:
None: both frameworks write the same attributes; snippets are generated from the React stories
(`apps/storybook/scripts/form-control-snippets.mjs`).

sections.body:
A `<label>` around a control (Checkbox, Switch; Radio later) and its text: the text names the
control and clicking it toggles the control.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
label[data-ok-form-control-label][data-ok-label-placement][data-ok-required]?
  (control: span[data-ok-checkbox] | span[data-ok-switch])
  span[data-ok-form-control-label-text]
    …label
    span[data-ok-form-control-label-asterisk][aria-hidden="true"]?   (required)
```
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `form-control-label`: listed under "options".)

React: `control` (element), `label` (node); `disabled`, `required`, `checked`, `onChange`,
`value` are cloned onto the control when set and the control doesn't set them (server-safe
`cloneElement`). Upstream `disableTypography`, `slots`, `slotProps`, `sx`, `classes` don't apply.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:

sections.body: An action shown only as an icon (toolbar, card actions). For text actions use Button.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
button[type="button"][data-ok-icon-button][data-ok-color][data-ok-size][data-ok-animate]?[aria-label]
  svg[aria-hidden="true"]            (any decorative SVG or img)
  span[data-ok-icon-button-loader][aria-hidden="true"]   only while loading (data-ok-loading)
    span[data-ok-circular-progress][data-ok-color="inherit"][data-ok-button-spinner]   default loader: a CircularProgress (React: `loadingIndicator` replaces it)
```
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `icon-button`: listed under "options".)

Also required: an accessible name (`aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`).

`default` = secondary text color, `inherit` = primary text color, palette colors = `main`.
Unknown values fall back to the defaults (`iconButtonAttributes()` and CSS).

React only: `loadingIndicator?: ReactNode` (default: the spinner) replaces the loader while
`loading`; in HTML, put your own loader inside `[data-ok-icon-button-loader]`.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
`:hover` (hover-capable devices: background `channel` 8 %, `--ok-action-hover` for default /
inherit), `:focus-visible` (2px outline), `:disabled` (`--ok-action-disabled`), `:active` (animate).
sections.title: States

sections.body:
Native `<button>` — CSS only, no runtime. Circular (`--ok-radius-full`), transparent background.
`data-ok-animate` transitions `transform`; `prefers-reduced-motion` disables the scale.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body: Native: `Enter` / `Space` activate.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
Name from `aria-label` (or `aria-labelledby`); the icon is `aria-hidden`. Every size is
≥ 24×24 CSS px (WCAG 2.5.8).
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body: None: CSS only, no runtime. React forwards `ref` (`HTMLButtonElement`) and every native button prop.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body: Same size at every breakpoint.
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
Visible focus outline (the reference has none). The reference's "With animate" uses an
animation library; here it is plain CSS.

components.title: Icon button

components.name: illustration

options.description: Palette of the brand tones (the accent and neutral tones stay).
options.name: color

options.description: Width: a number in px, or a CSS length. The height follows the 4:3 picture. Default 480px, never wider than the container.
options.name: size

sections.body:
A theme-aware illustration set. Each illustration is data (a tree of SVG nodes) whose shapes name
a tone instead of a color; the stylesheet maps tones to `--ok-*` tokens, so pictures follow the
color scheme, nested themes, `data-ok-preset` and the `color` option. One export per picture in
the opt-in entry `@owlky/core/illustrations` (tree-shaken). Components that show decorative art
compose it (Upload's drop zone).
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
Every scene follows `docs/illustrations-style.md` (canvas, composition, tones, strokes, people,
detail) and composes the parts of `@owlky/core/illustrations` (`backdrop`, `groundShadow`,
`sparkle`, `dot`, `cloud`, `plant`, `lines`, `paper`, `screen`, `person`;
`core/src/illustrations/parts.ts`). Parts set `part` on their first node (data only, never
rendered); `core/src/illustrations/style.test.ts` enforces the guide. New pictures: `/illustration`.
sections.title: Style

sections.body:
```
svg[data-ok-illustration="<name>"][data-ok-color][data-ok-size]?[viewBox][focusable="false"]
   [aria-hidden="true"] | [role="img"][aria-label | aria-labelledby]
  title?                                   (React `title`)
  (g[transform]? › …) | path | circle | ellipse | rect | polygon | polyline | line
    [data-ok-tone="<tone>"][data-ok-stroke][stroke-width]?  geometry attributes only
```
- Elements: `g path circle ellipse rect polygon polyline line` (`illustrationTags`); attributes:
  geometry, `transform`, `opacity`, `fill-rule`, `stroke-dasharray` (`illustrationAttributeNames`).
  Never `href`, `use`, `image`, `foreignObject`, `script`, `style`, ids or colors.
- Every shape has a tone; groups never do. `data-ok-stroke` paints the tone as the outline
  (`stroke-width` from the data), with round caps and joins.
- Tones (`illustrationTones`): brand `lighter light main dark darker` (the `color` palette),
  accent `accent-light accent-main accent-dark` (warning palette), scheme-aware `paper neutral
  outline line shadow shade ink`, fixed `grey-300 grey-500 grey-600 white`, skin `skin-light
  skin-medium skin-deep` (`--ok-illustration-skin-*` tokens).
- Scenes use `viewBox="0 0 480 360"`; shapes (`avatar-shape`) their own.
- React renders `data-ok-runtime="off"` and the private `--_ok-illustration-size` in `style`.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `illustration`: listed under "options".)

Other props: `illustration` (required: the data, an export of `@owlky/core/illustrations` or your
own `Illustration` object), `title` (accessible name: `role="img"`, `aria-label` and a `<title>`),
`aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` (also make it `role="img"`), `ref`, `className`, `style` and other
SVG attributes (go to the `svg`). HTML: a `width` attribute sizes the picture without the runtime.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
`display: block`, `max-width: 100%`, `height: auto` (the viewBox keeps the ratio). Width: the
`width` attribute, else `--_ok-illustration-size` (size option), else 480px
(`calc(var(--ok-spacing) * 120)`). Brand tones read `--_ok-illustration-<shade>` declared on the
root from `--ok-palette-<color>-<shade>`, so a root inside a `[data-ok-preset]` / `[data-ok-theme]`
scope takes that scope's values. `ink` is `light-dark(grey 800, grey 600)` inside
`@supports (color: light-dark(#000, #fff))` (grey 800 otherwise). Translucent tones use
`rgb(var(--…-channel) / α)`.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
- React: renders the tree as elements (attribute names camelCased); invalid nodes / attributes /
  tones are dropped (`illustrationNodeAttributes`, `illustrationChildren`).
- HTML snippets: the full inline SVG (generated from React,
  `node apps/storybook/scripts/illustration-snippets.mjs`); CSS only, no JavaScript.
- HTML runtime (opt-in: `owlky-illustrations.js`, `@owlky/html/illustrations`, or
  `createIllustration([…])`): on `svg[data-ok-illustration]` without artwork, builds the named
  picture with `createElementNS` and sets `viewBox`; artwork already there (snippets, custom art)
  stays. Writes `aria-hidden="true"` unless the author named it (then `role="img"`), and
  `focusable="false"`. Turns `data-ok-size` into `--_ok-illustration-size` (CSSOM) and follows
  changes of `data-ok-size` and of the name (redrawing what it drew). Unknown names: nothing drawn.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body: None: illustrations never take focus.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
Decorative by default (`aria-hidden="true"`, `focusable="false"`). Meaningful pictures get a name
(`title` / `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` → `role="img"`). No text inside the art. Decorative
art has no contrast requirement (axe passes in light and dark).
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML instance: `runtime.get(svg, "illustration").illustration` (the data drawn, or `undefined`).
Core: `illustrationAttributes(name, options)`, `illustrationNodeAttributes(node)`,
`illustrationChildren(nodes)`, `illustrationStyle(size)`, `illustrationAria(named, title?)`.
`@owlky/core/illustrations`: the pictures, `illustrations`, the parts (pure functions returning
nodes; numbers and tones only) and `illustrationParts` (the `part` names).
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Snippets carry the shapes; the runtime draws the same markup for named placeholders (tested).
`style` is ignored by parity (React's private size property; the runtime's CSSOM).
sections.title: Parity notes

sections.body: A picture that loads lazily behind a placeholder and appears with an effect, cropped to an aspect ratio, with an optional overlay. Native first: a plain `` with `loading="lazy"`.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
span[data-ok-image][data-ok-fit][data-ok-position][data-ok-effect][data-ok-ratio]?[data-ok-overlay]?[data-ok-overlay-from]?[data-ok-disable-placeholder]?[data-ok-visible-by-default]?[data-ok-state]?
  span[data-ok-image-placeholder][aria-hidden="true"]   (› img[alt=""] preview | custom content)?
  span[data-ok-image-overlay][aria-hidden="true"]?      (with `overlay`)
  img[src][alt][loading][decoding][srcset]?[sizes]?[width]?[height]?[fetchpriority]?
  svg[data-ok-image-icon][aria-hidden="true"]?          (after an error: React renders it, the HTML runtime builds it)
```
React renders `data-ok-runtime="off"` and the placeholder span always (CSS hides it with
`disablePlaceholder` / `visibleByDefault`). `data-ok-state` is written by the owner only, never
in snippets.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `image`: listed under "options".)

Other props (go to the `img`): `src`, `srcSet`, `sizes`, `alt` (required; `""` = decorative),
`width`, `height`, `loading` (`lazy` default; `eager` with `visibleByDefault`), `decoding`
(`async` default), `fetchPriority`, `crossOrigin`, `referrerPolicy`, `imgProps`, `imgRef` (`ref`
is the root). `placeholderSrc` (a preview in the placeholder, blurred), `placeholder` (custom
content), `onLoad(event)`, `onError(event)`. Root `className` / `style` / other attributes go to
the `span`.

API mapping (Minimals `Image` / react-lazy-load-image-component): kept `ratio`,
`disablePlaceholder`, `visibleByDefault`, `effect` (+ `none`), `placeholderSrc`, `placeholder`,
`onLoad` (upstream `afterLoad`), `src`, `alt`, `srcSet`, `sizes`, `width`, `height`;
`slotProps.img` → `imgProps`; `slotProps.overlay` → `overlay` / `overlayFrom` (allowlists);
`slotProps.placeholder` → `placeholder`. Not applicable (native `loading="lazy"`, ADR-0038):
`threshold`, `delayTime`, `delayMethod`, `scrollPosition`, `useIntersectionObserver`,
`beforeLoad`, `wrapperClassName`, `wrapperProps`, `sx`. Beyond the reference: `fit`, `position`,
`onError` + the error state, `decoding`, `fetchPriority` (native image features).
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Root `display: block`, `position: relative`, `overflow: hidden`, `max-width: 100%`. The `img`
fills the root (`width` / `height` 100%, `object-fit` / `object-position` from `fit` /
`position`); with `ratio` the root takes `aspect-ratio` and the `img` is absolute. Without
`ratio` the picture keeps its own ratio (`width` / `height` attributes reserve it).
Placeholder: radial gradient, transparent white center → `grey-500 / 0.48` (the reference's SVG).
Overlay: `dark` = `grey-900 / 0.48`; a color = `linear-gradient(transparent, <main> / 0.8)`; with
`overlayFrom`: `linear-gradient(to top, <from main> / 0.24, <main> / 0.8)`. Error icon: 40% of
the box, at most 48px, `text-disabled`. Effects: `opacity` `--ok-duration-shortest`, `filter`
`--ok-duration-standard`, `--ok-easing-standard`; `blur(12px)` / `grayscale(1)` while loading.
Corners are the consumer's (stories: `--ok-radius-xl`).
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
- No `data-ok-state` (no JavaScript, snippets): the picture shows; placeholder transparent.
- `loading`: picture `opacity: 0` (+ the effect's filter), placeholder visible.
- `loaded`: picture visible (transition), placeholder fades out.
- `error`: picture `opacity: 0` (keeps its `alt` in the accessibility tree), placeholder visible,
  icon shown.
- `visibleByDefault`: no placeholder, no effect, `loading="eager"`.
- `@media (scripting: none)`: the picture always shows (React's server markup says `loading`).
- `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`: no transitions.
sections.title: States

sections.body:
React: state `loading` until the `img` fires `load` / `error`; after mount (hydration) it reads
`complete` / `naturalWidth` (core `imageLoadState`) for pictures that settled before React. A new
`src` / `srcSet` starts at `loading` again. HTML runtime `image`: the same from `complete` at
setup, `load` / `error` listeners on the `img`, and a MutationObserver on `src` / `srcset` /
`sizes`. Lazy loading is the browser's (`loading="lazy"`).
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body:
The root is fluid (its container's width, `max-width: 100%`); a ratio keeps the shape at every
width. Stories: grids of 2 columns below 600px, 3 from 600px, 4 from 900px.
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
Not focusable. Put it in an `a` / `button` to make it interactive (the `span` root is phrasing
content).
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
`alt` required (React type); decorative pictures use `alt=""`. Placeholder, overlay and icon are
`aria-hidden`. A broken picture stays in the tree with its `alt`. Overlays help white text on
pictures reach AA (docs).
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML: `ok:image:load` (`detail.src` = `currentSrc`), `ok:image:error` (`detail.src`); instance
`runtime.get(el, "image")` → `{ state }`. React: `onLoad(event)`, `onError(event)` (and
`imgProps.onLoad` / `onError`).
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
HTML authors may leave the placeholder span out (no placeholder). React always renders it. Both
write `data-ok-state`; parity compares settled pictures.
sections.title: Parity notes

sections.body:
Show images and videos over the page, one at a time: open from a gallery, swipe or step between
slides, zoom and pan, rotate, play a slideshow, go fullscreen, download or share, read captions,
jump with thumbnails. A modal `<dialog>` (or an inline `div`) around a Carousel (ADR-0033) that
moves the slides; core `createLightboxController` adds the lightbox behavior and writes its state
for React and the HTML runtime alike.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
button[type="button"][data-ok-lightbox-trigger][data-ok-lightbox-open="<id>"][data-ok-index][aria-haspopup="dialog"]
  › img[alt]                                        (any number; React: LightboxTrigger, no -open)
dialog#<id>[data-ok-lightbox][data-ok-theme="dark"][aria-label="Lightbox"]  …options
       (inline: div[data-ok-lightbox][data-ok-inline][data-ok-theme="dark"], no aria-label)
       (+ controller flags: data-ok-ready, data-ok-zoomed, data-ok-zooming, data-ok-pulling,
        data-ok-fullscreen; state: data-ok-captions-hidden, data-ok-thumbnails-hidden)
  section[data-ok-carousel][data-ok-lightbox-carousel][aria-roledescription="carousel"][aria-label="Photo gallery"]
         …carousel attributes implied by the options (loop, duration, autoplay delay, …)
    div[data-ok-carousel-stage]
      div[data-ok-carousel-viewport][tabindex="0"]
        div[data-ok-carousel-container]
          div[role="group"][aria-roledescription="slide"][aria-label="1 of 5"][data-ok-carousel-slide]
             [data-ok-lightbox-slide][data-ok-snapped]?[data-ok-rotation]?[data-ok-image-fit]?
             [data-ok-download="false|<url>"]?[data-ok-download-filename]?[data-ok-share="false"]?
             [data-ok-share-url|-title|-text]?               (inert unless current: controller)
            div[data-ok-lightbox-zoom]                       (the zoom and pan frame)
              img[data-ok-lightbox-image][src][alt][width][height][srcset]?[sizes]?[loading="lazy"][draggable="false"]
              | video[data-ok-lightbox-video][poster][width][height][controls][playsinline][data-ok-autoplay]?

        button[data-ok-icon-button][data-ok-lightbox-download][aria-label]

```
Every toolbar button is always in the markup; the options show or hide them with CSS (so Controls
and parity only change attributes). React parts: `Lightbox`, `LightboxTrigger`.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `lightbox`: listed under "options".)

Outside the schema (React props; HTML writes them as markup or listens to events):
- `slides`: image slides `{ src, alt, width, height, srcSet, imageFit, rotation, title,
  description, thumbnail, download, share }`, video slides `{ type: "video", sources, poster,
  width, height, tracks, autoPlay, controls, controlsList, crossOrigin, preload, loop, muted,
  playsInline, disablePictureInPicture, disableRemotePlayback, … }` and custom slides (any other
  `type`, rendered by `render.slide`, `zoomable` opts into zoom).
- `open` / `defaultOpen` / `onOpenChange(open, reason)`; `index` / `defaultIndex` /
  `onIndexChange(index)`; `LightboxTrigger index`.
- `labels` (every text; `Slide` and `Zoom level` take `{index}`, `{total}`, `{zoom}`); HTML: the
  text in the markup, and `data-ok-labels` (JSON) for the live region's messages.
- `counterSeparator` (default `" / "`), `video` (defaults of every video, default
  `{ controls: true, playsInline: true }`), `imageProps` (object or `(slide) => props`),
  `toolbarButtons`, `render` (`slide`, `slideHeader`, `slideFooter`, `controls`, `thumbnail`,
  `icon…`), `apiRef`, `customDownload(slide, index)`, `customShare(slide, index)`.
- Callbacks: `onSlideClick`, `onZoomChange`, `onRotate`, `onFullscreenChange`,
  `onSlideshowChange`, `onCaptionsChange`, `onThumbnailsChange`, `onDownload`, `onShare`.

### API mapping (yet-another-react-lightbox → Owlky)
| Upstream | Owlky | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `open`, `index`, `slides`, `labels`, `className`, `render.*` | kept | |
| `close` | `onOpenChange(false, reason)` | project callback shape; reasons `escape`, `backdrop`, `pull`, `close` |
| `on.view` / `on.click` | `onIndexChange` / `onSlideClick` | value-first callbacks |
| `on.entering/entered/exiting/exited` | `onOpenChange` | no exit animation (native dialog) |
| `toolbar.buttons` | `toolbarButtons` (before the counter) | built-in buttons are options |
| `carousel.finite`, `.padding`, `.spacing`, `.imageFit`, `.imageProps` | `finite`, `padding`, `spacing`, `imageFit`, `imageProps` | flattened (ADR-0015) |
| `carousel.preload` | not applicable | native `loading="lazy"` |
| `animation.fade`, `.swipe`, `.zoom` | `animationFade`, `animationSwipe`, `animationZoom` | |
| `animation.navigation`, `animation.easing` | not applicable | the carousel's eased scroll |
| `controller.closeOnPullDown/Up`, `.closeOnBackdropClick`, `.closeOnEscape`, `.disableSwipeNavigation` | kept, flattened | |
| `controller.ref` and plugin refs | `apiRef` (HTML: the instance) | one API |
| `controller.aria`, `.focus`, `.touchAction` | not applicable | always accessible; deprecated upstream |
| `portal`, `noScroll`, `styles` | not applicable | top layer; the modal locks scroll; CSS |
| Captions `hidden`, `showToggle`, `descriptionTextAlign`, `descriptionMaxLines` | `captionsHidden`, `captionsShowToggle`, `descriptionTextAlign`, `descriptionMaxLines` | |
| Counter `separator` / `container` | `counterSeparator` / not applicable | |
| Download `download.download`, slide `download` | `customDownload`, slide `download` | HTML: cancel `ok:lightbox:download` |
| Fullscreen `auto` | `fullscreenAuto` | |
| Inline `inline` | `inline` | |
| Rotate `buttons`, slide `rotation` | `rotateButtons`, slide `rotation` | rotation kept per slide element |
| Share `share.share`, slide `share` | `customShare`, slide `share` | |
| Slideshow `autoplay`, `delay` | `slideshowAutoplay`, `slideshowDelay` | the carousel's autoplay |
| Thumbnails `position`, `width`, `height`, `border`, `borderRadius`, `padding`, `gap`, `imageFit`, `vignette`, `hidden`, `showToggle` | `thumbnails…` | `borderStyle` / `borderColor` not applicable (tokens, CSS) |
| Video slide props and lightbox `video` | kept | + `tracks` (captions, WCAG 1.2) |
| Zoom `maxZoomPixelRatio`, `zoomInMultiplier`, `doubleClickMaxStops`, `keyboardMoveDistance`, `wheelZoomDistanceFactor`, `scrollToZoom`, `maxZoom`, `supports` | kept; `supports` = `zoomable` on custom slides | |
| Zoom `minZoom`, `doubleTapDelay`, `doubleClickDelay`, `pinchZoomDistanceFactor`, `pinchZoomV4` | not applicable | minimum is 1; native `dblclick`; deprecated upstream |
| Minimals `disableZoom`, `disableTotal`, `disableCaptions`, `disableSlideshow`, `disableThumbnails`, `disableFullscreen` | kept | plugins on by default, like the reference |
| Minimals `disableVideo` | not applicable | leave video slides out of `slides` |

Beyond the reference and upstream (accessibility, security, HTML parity): `tracks` on video
slides, a polite live region for zoom levels and failures, `aria-disabled` buttons that keep
focus, URLs checked before downloading or sharing (http, https, blob, image and video `data:`),
`data-ok-labels`.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Written by the controller in both implementations: `inert` on every slide but the current one,
`aria-disabled="true"` on zoom, rotate, download and share buttons that can't act, `hidden` on the
fullscreen and share buttons where the browser can't, and on the navigation with one slide, the
counter's numbers, `data-ok-rotation` on slides and thumbnails, root flags (anatomy), the
carousel's attributes and the thumbnails' `data-ok-orientation` from the options, and private
custom properties: `--_ok-lightbox-scale`, `-x`, `-y` (zoom frame), `-pull`, `-toolbar-width`
(root). The runtime (HTML) and `style` (React) write the numeric options' sizes:
`--_ok-lightbox-padding`, `-spacing`, `-thumb-width|height|border|radius|padding|gap`, `-lines`,
`-fade`, `-zoom-duration`.
sections.title: States

sections.body:
- Opening: a trigger (or `open(index)`) opens the modal at its slide without animation, focuses
  the slides, and starts the slideshow (`slideshowAutoplay`, never with reduced motion) and
  fullscreen (`fullscreenAuto`). Closing stops the slideshow, leaves fullscreen, resets the zoom,
  pauses videos and returns focus to the trigger.
- Slides move with the Carousel: swipes, mouse drags, the arrow buttons, thumbnails, keys;
  `finite` stops at the ends; `animationSwipe` sets the duration.
- Zoom (images; custom slides with `zoomable`): toolbar, `+` / `-`, Ctrl / Command + `0`, double
  click and double tap (`doubleClickMaxStops` steps, then back), pinch, Ctrl + wheel (`scrollToZoom`:
  the wheel alone). The largest zoom is the image's natural size × `maxZoomPixelRatio` per device
  pixel; images not larger than their frame don't zoom. Zoomed: drag, arrow keys
  (`keyboardMoveDistance`) and the wheel pan within the image; swiping is off. Changing slides,
  rotating and closing reset it.
- Rotate: quarter turns of the current image (and its thumbnail); the image fits the frame with
  its sides swapped.
- Slideshow: the play button toggles the carousel's autoplay every `slideshowDelay` ms; it keeps
  playing under the pointer and focus, stops at the last slide when `finite`.
- Captions: the title over the top (it ends before the toolbar), the description over the bottom
  (`descriptionMaxLines`); the toggle hides them.
- Download: the slide's `data-ok-download` URL (or its source) under `data-ok-download-filename`
  (or the URL's file name); other origins are fetched (CORS) and saved from a blob; failures are
  announced. Share: `navigator.share({ url, title, text })`; canceling is silent, failures are
  announced.
- Videos: the current video plays when it has `data-ok-autoplay`; others pause.
- Pull to close: a vertical drag of more than 15% of the height (at least 60px) closes.
- `closeOnBackdropClick`: a click on the slide outside its media and captions closes.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body:
| Key | Action (anywhere in the lightbox, except fields and videos) |
|---|---|
| Right / Left arrow | next / previous slide (mirrored right to left); zoomed: pan |
| Up / Down arrow | zoomed: pan |
| Home / End | first / last slide (not while zoomed) |
| `+` or `=` / `-` | zoom in / out |
| Ctrl or Command + `0` | reset the zoom |
| Escape | close (`closeOnEscape`); the browser leaves fullscreen first |
| Tab | toolbar, navigation and thumbnails (focus stays in the modal) |
sections.title: Keyboard
Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML events on the root: `ok:lightbox:beforeopen` (cancelable, `{ index, trigger }`), `open`,
`beforeclose` (cancelable, `{ reason }`), `close` (`reason`: `escape`, `backdrop`, `pull`, `close`,
`api`, `native`), `view` `{ index }`, `click` `{ index }`, `zoom` `{ zoom }`, `rotate`
`{ index, rotation }`, `fullscreen` `{ fullscreen }`, `slideshow` `{ playing }`, `captions` /
`thumbnails` `{ visible }`, `download` / `share` (cancelable, `{ index }`: cancel to replace).
Instance (`runtime.get(root, "lightbox")`) and React `apiRef`: `isOpen`, `index`, `open(index?)`,
`close()`, `prev()`, `next()`, `goTo(index, jump?)`, `zoom`, `maxZoom`, `offsetX`, `offsetY`,
`zoomDisabled`, `zoomIn()`, `zoomOut()`, `changeZoom(zoom, rapid?, dx?, dy?)`, `rotation`,
`rotateClockwise()`, `rotateCounterClockwise()`, `fullscreen`, `fullscreenDisabled`,
`enterFullscreen()`, `exitFullscreen()`, `playing`, `play()`, `pause()`, `captionsVisible`,
`showCaptions()`, `hideCaptions()`, `thumbnailsVisible`, `showThumbnails()`, `hideThumbnails()`,
`download()`, `share()`.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Mobile first: the lightbox covers the viewport; navigation buttons are 40px below 600px and 48px
from 600px; the thumbnails row scrolls (8px padding below 600px, 16px from 600px); the toolbar wraps
and the title shortens with an ellipsis. Inline lightboxes are 3:2 and as wide as their container.
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
React renders the initial state (first slide current, counter); the controller writes the rest in
both implementations. HTML triggers carry `data-ok-lightbox-open` (parity ignores it). Load
`lightbox.css` after `carousel.css` (same zero specificity).

sections.body:
A thin bar for work of unknown length (indeterminate, query) or that shows how far a task has got
(determinate) and how far loading has got (buffer).
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
span[data-ok-linear-progress][role=progressbar][aria-label|aria-labelledby]
    [data-ok-variant][data-ok-color]
    [aria-valuenow][aria-valuemin][aria-valuemax]   (determinate, buffer)
    [data-ok-value-buffer]?                         (buffer)
  span[data-ok-linear-progress-dashed]              buffer only
  span[data-ok-linear-progress-bar="1"]
  span[data-ok-linear-progress-bar="2"]             indeterminate, query, buffer
```
The track is the root's `::before`. React renders `data-ok-runtime="off"` on the root.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `linear-progress`: listed under "options".)

Upstream `color` lists inherit / primary / secondary (+ theme colors); every palette color is
offered, as on the reference. `sx` / `classes` don't apply. Numbers are validated as for Circular
progress; the buffer is clamped to the range.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
- Height 4px (`--ok-spacing`), width 100% of the container (`min-width: 0`), radius
  `--ok-radius-full`, `overflow: hidden`.
- Color: `--ok-c-main` (fallback primary), `inherit` = text color; parts paint with
  `currentColor`: track opacity 0.24, buffer bar 0.24, dots 0.48 (radial gradient, 10px tile =
  `--ok-spacing` × 2.5). Opacity instead of channels, so `inherit` works.
- Private properties (React `style`, HTML runtime CSSOM): `--_ok-progress-value`,
  `--_ok-progress-buffer` (0–1). Bars: `translateX((fraction − 1) × 100%)`, transition
  `--ok-duration-standard` linear.
- Indeterminate: bar 1 / bar 2 sweep with `left` / `right` keyframes, 2.1s, bar 2 delayed 1.15s.
  Query = indeterminate rotated 180°. Buffer dots drift (3s). Choreography constants, not tokens.
- Reduced motion: sweeps at 4.2s (delay 2.3s), dots still, no value transition.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
Fills its container at every breakpoint; no breakpoint rules. Stories stack the bars in a column.
"With label" (MUI's demo) composes a Typography (`body2`, `textSecondary`) beside the bar; there
is no label part.
sections.title: Responsive behavior

sections.body: `data-ok-variant` only. Not focusable.
sections.title: States

sections.body:
CSS only in React. HTML runtime (`linear-progress`): on mount and whenever `data-ok-variant`,
`aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax` or `data-ok-value-buffer` change, writes the
private properties; `destroy` removes them. Changing the variant doesn't add or remove parts:
the markup must match the variant (see Anatomy).

sections.body: None (not focusable).

sections.body:
`role="progressbar"`, named by the author. Determinate / buffer: `aria-valuenow` (clamped),

Brand colors follow the reference (ADR-0014). Left to right only (right-to-left: backlog).

sections.body:
A link in the theme's colors and type scale. Built on Typography: one element carries
Typography's attributes plus `data-ok-link`, and Typography's options are spread into Link's
schema (MUI's defaults differ: `variant` `inherit`, `color` `primary`). CSS only.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
a[href][data-ok-typography][data-ok-link][data-ok-variant][data-ok-color][data-ok-underline]
  [data-ok-align]?[data-ok-gutter-bottom]?[data-ok-no-wrap]?[target][rel]?
button[type="button"][data-ok-typography][data-ok-link]…        (an action: no destination)
```
React: `a` with `href`; `<button type="button">` without `href` and `component` (MUI renders an
`a` without `href`, which can't take focus); `component` renders anything else (a router link,
`button`, `span`). HTML authors write the element.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `link`: listed under "options".)

React: `children`, `href` (passed through untouched), `target`, `rel`, `component`, `ref`, every
attribute of the element. `target="_blank"` → `rel` always holds `noopener noreferrer` (core
`linkRel`: the consumer's tokens kept, missing ones appended). HTML snippets write the `rel`.
Not applicable: `sx`, `classes`, `TypographyClasses`, `variantMapping` (a link's element is `a` /
`button` / `component`), arbitrary color strings (consumer CSS), theme default props.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Typography's rules (font, color) plus `link.css` (loaded right after `typography.css`):
`cursor: pointer`; `inherit` → `color: inherit`. `always`: underline in `rgb(--ok-c-channel / 0.4)`
for palette colors, `currentColor` for text tones and `inherit`; hover (hover-capable devices):
`currentColor`. `hover`: underline on hover only. `none`: never. Button links lose the button's
box (no padding, border, background; `vertical-align: middle`). Focus ring: 2px
`--ok-text-primary`, offset 2px, `--ok-radius-xs`.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body: Inline text; wraps with the text around it (except `noWrap`). Same at every breakpoint.
sections.title: Responsive behavior

sections.body:
Native: Tab focuses, Enter follows a link or activates a button link, Space activates a button
link.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
Default `underline="always"`: links in text are distinguishable without color (axe
`link-in-text-block`). Palette colors use `main` (ADR-0014, exempt from `color-contrast` like
Typography); `textPrimary` / `textSecondary` / `inherit` on neutral text meet AA. Actions without a
destination render a `button`. New-tab links: say so in the name (`aria-label`).

sections.body: None (native element events).

Breadcrumbs items are Links (`color="inherit" underline="hover"`, as in MUI's breadcrumbs demos);
`breadcrumbs.css` loads after `link.css` and keeps its own item rules (no DOM or API change).

```
      › (button[type=button] | a)[data-ok-list-item-button][data-ok-selected]?[…]?
          › span[data-ok-list-item-icon] | span[data-ok-list-item-avatar]
          › span[data-ok-list-item-text][data-ok-inset]?
              › span[data-ok-list-item-text-primary] + span[data-ok-list-item-text-secondary]?
          › span[data-ok-list-item-expand-icon][aria-hidden=true]?    (button with aria-expanded)
      › span[data-ok-list-item-secondary-action]?                     (end action)
      › ul[data-ok-list][id][hidden]?                                 (nested list)
```
A divider between rows sits in a plain `li` (a `ul` may only hold `li`); between lists it sits
outside them. Controls (checkbox, switch) are never inside a `ListItemButton`: a checkbox at the
start is labelled by a `<label for>` in the text, a switch at the end by `aria-labelledby`.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `list`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `list-item`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `list-item-button`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `list-item-text`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `list-subheader`: listed under "options".)

React content: `List subheader`, `ListItem secondaryAction`, `ListItemButton href` (renders `a`;
`disabled` → no `href` + `aria-disabled`), `ListItemText primary` / `secondary` /
`disableTypography` (children = primary), `ListItemExpandIcon` (beyond upstream: the chevron
turns with `aria-expanded`, so HTML needs no icon swap).
Not applicable: `component` / `ListItemText` `*TypographyProps` / `slotProps` / `sx` /
`classes` (markup is fixed; restyle with CSS), `autoFocus` (native `autofocus`),
`focusVisibleClassName` (`:focus-visible`), `ListItemSecondaryAction` (deprecated upstream:
`secondaryAction`), `ListItem button` (removed upstream). Dense propagates through CSS (descendant
selector), not context.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
List padding 8px block (0 with `disablePadding` or a subheader first). Item / button padding
8px 16px (`dense` 4px block, `disableGutters` 0 inline); 40px rows with a 24px icon, 38px with
text only. Icon / avatar `margin-inline-end` 16px, `flex-start` → `margin-top` 8px. Primary text
subtitle2 (14px 600 / 22px), secondary body2 `--ok-text-secondary` (grey-700 on a selected row in
the light scheme: AA on the tint). Subheader 48px line, 14px 500, `--ok-text-secondary` on
`--ok-bg-paper`, `inset` 56px. Secondary action 16px from the end, the item (or its button)
keeps 48px for it. Nested rows start 32px in. Hover `--ok-action-hover`; selected primary
channel / 0.08 (hover 0.16, focus 0.2); focus-visible 2px `--ok-text-primary` outline inside the
row + `--ok-action-focus`; disabled opacity 0.48.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
Fluid: rows take the container's width; text wraps inside `ListItemText` (`min-width: 0`). Stories put
each list in a Card (360px wide), as the reference shows its demos in cards.
sections.title: Responsive behavior

sections.body:
Native buttons and links. A button with `aria-expanded` + `aria-controls` opens / closes the
nested list (Enter / Space). `selected` is visual only: add `aria-current`. Brand-colored
`primary` subheader is exempt from `color-contrast` (ADR-0014).
sections.title: Keyboard / Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML: `ok:list:toggle` (cancelable, `detail: { open, list }`) on the button's list, then
`aria-expanded` and the nested list's `hidden` flip. `runtime.get(list, "list").toggle(button,
open?)`. React: app state (`aria-expanded`, `hidden`).
Animated nested lists (MUI composes `Collapse`): the nested `ul` is a Collapse (collapse.md,
ADR-0044) — React `<Collapse component={List} in={open} timeout="auto" disablePadding>`, HTML
`data-ok-collapse data-ok-timeout="auto"` on the `ul`; the list runtime still writes `hidden`.
sections.title: Events / API

import {
  Card,
  Collapse,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemButton,
  ListItemExpandIcon,
  ListItemIcon,
  ListItemText,
  ListSubheader,
} from "@owlky/react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { DemoIcon } from "../shared/demo-icon.js";

/** A nested list that the Inbox button opens and closes (open at first). */
export function NestedDemo() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(true);
  return (
    <Card>
      <List
        aria-labelledby="list-nested-subheader"
        subheader={<ListSubheader id="list-nested-subheader">Nested list items</ListSubheader>}
      >
        <ListItem disablePadding>
          <ListItemButton>
            <ListItemIcon>
              <DemoIcon name="send" />
            </ListItemIcon>
            <ListItemText primary="Sent mail" />
          </ListItemButton>
        </ListItem>
        <ListItem disablePadding>
          <ListItemButton>
            <ListItemIcon>
              <DemoIcon name="mail" />
            </ListItemIcon>
            <ListItemText primary="Drafts" />
          </ListItemButton>
        </ListItem>
        <ListItem disablePadding>
          <ListItemButton
            aria-expanded={open ? "true" : "false"}
            aria-controls="list-nested-inbox"
            onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}
          >
            <ListItemIcon>
              <DemoIcon name="inbox" />
            </ListItemIcon>
            <ListItemText primary="Inbox" />
            <ListItemExpandIcon />
          </ListItemButton>
          <Collapse component={List} id="list-nested-inbox" in={open} timeout="auto" disablePadding>
            <ListItem disablePadding>
              <ListItemButton>
                <ListItemIcon>
                  <DemoIcon name="star" />
                </ListItemIcon>
                <ListItemText primary="Starred" />
              </ListItemButton>
            </ListItem>
          </Collapse>
        </ListItem>
      </List>
    </Card>
  );
}

sections.body:
Interactive vector maps: styles that follow the theme, markers, popups, data layers (GeoJSON,
clusters, heatmaps, highlights), camera control and the usual map controls. MapLibre GL JS runs in
core `createMapController` (`@owlky/core/map`), shared by React and the HTML runtime; everything
around the canvas (controls, markers, popups, panels, credits, scale) is Owlky markup.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
div[data-ok-map][data-ok-longitude|latitude|zoom|pitch|bearing]?[data-ok-min-zoom|max-zoom|min-pitch|max-pitch]?
   [data-ok-projection][data-ok-<handler>="false"]?[data-ok-cooperative-gestures]?[data-ok-render-world-copies="false"]?
   [data-ok-map-style][data-ok-map-style-dark]?[data-ok-bounds="w,s,e,n"]?[data-ok-max-bounds]?
   [data-ok-interactive-layer-ids="a b"]?[data-ok-label]?
   [data-ok-ready]? (style in) [data-ok-loaded]? (first full render) [data-ok-fallback]? [data-ok-fullscreen]?
  div[data-ok-map-view]                       MapLibre: div.maplibregl-canvas-container › canvas[role=region][tabindex=0]
                                                [aria-label][aria-describedby][aria-roledescription=map]; div[data-ok-map-user-location]?
  div[data-ok-map-fallback]                   text (default from labels.fallback when empty)
  p[data-ok-map-description][id]?             text alternative (visually hidden; shown with the fallback)
  div[data-ok-map-status][role=status]        location announcements (visually hidden)
  div[data-ok-map-marker][data-ok-longitude][data-ok-latitude][data-ok-anchor][data-ok-color][data-ok-offset]?
     [data-ok-draggable]?[data-ok-rotation]?[data-ok-rotation-alignment]?[data-ok-pitch-alignment]?
     [role=button][tabindex=0][aria-label]? (interactive) [data-ok-dragging]? (state)
    svg[data-ok-map-pin] | content
  div[data-ok-map-popup][role=dialog|tooltip][tabindex=-1][aria-label]?[data-ok-longitude][data-ok-latitude]
     [data-ok-anchor]?[data-ok-offset]?[data-ok-max-width]?[data-ok-close-on-click="false"]?[data-ok-close-on-move]?
     [data-ok-focus-after-open="false"]?[data-ok-current-anchor] (controller) [hidden]? (HTML: closed)
    span[data-ok-map-popup-tip][aria-hidden] + div[data-ok-map-popup-content] + button[data-ok-map-popup-close][aria-label]?
  div[data-ok-map-source][data-ok-id][data-ok-type][hidden] › div[data-ok-map-layer][data-ok-id][data-ok-type][hidden]   (HTML only)
  div[data-ok-map-panel][data-ok-position][data-ok-theme=dark]
  div[data-ok-map-corner=top-left|top-right|bottom-left|bottom-right]   (always the four, in this order)
    div[data-ok-map-control][data-ok-map-navigation][data-ok-visualize-pitch]?
      button[data-ok-map-action=zoom-in|zoom-out][aria-label][aria-disabled]
      button[data-ok-map-action=compass] › svg[data-ok-map-compass-icon] › path[data-ok-map-compass-north|south]
    div[data-ok-map-control][data-ok-map-geolocate][data-ok-track-user-location]?[data-ok-show-user-location="false"]?[data-ok-show-accuracy-circle="false"]?
      button[data-ok-map-action=geolocate][data-ok-state=off|waiting|active|error][aria-pressed]? (tracking)
    div[data-ok-map-control] › button[data-ok-map-action=fullscreen][aria-pressed] › svg[data-ok-map-icon=enter] + svg[data-ok-map-icon=exit]
    div[data-ok-map-control] › button[data-ok-map-action=globe|terrain][aria-pressed] (terrain: data-ok-source, data-ok-exaggeration)
    div[data-ok-map-scale][data-ok-unit][data-ok-max-width]?   text and width from the controller
    details[data-ok-map-attribution][data-ok-compact]?[data-ok-narrow]? (controller) › summary[aria-label] › svg + div[data-ok-map-attribution-text]
  div[data-ok-map-control] (MapControl: author content)
```
Sources and layers: `data-ok-data` (URL or inline JSON), `data-ok-url`, `data-ok-tiles` (URLs
separated by spaces), `data-ok-tile-size`, `data-ok-min-zoom`, `data-ok-max-zoom`, `data-ok-bounds`
(JSON), `data-ok-scheme`, `data-ok-attribution`, `data-ok-cluster`, `data-ok-cluster-radius`,
`data-ok-cluster-max-zoom`, `data-ok-cluster-min-points`, `data-ok-cluster-properties` (JSON),
`data-ok-promote-id`, `data-ok-generate-id`, `data-ok-buffer`, `data-ok-tolerance`,
`data-ok-line-metrics`, `data-ok-encoding`, `data-ok-coordinates` (JSON); layers `data-ok-paint`,
`data-ok-layout`, `data-ok-filter` (JSON), `data-ok-source-layer`, `data-ok-min-zoom`,
`data-ok-max-zoom`, `data-ok-before-id`, and `data-ok-source` when not inside a source. Anything
else is ignored (allowlist). Paint and layout strings `"var(--ok-…)"` resolve to the token's value
(again when the color scheme changes).
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `map`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `map-marker`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `map-popup`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `map-navigation`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `map-geolocate`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `map-scale`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `map-attribution`: listed under "options".)

Other props (React) ↔ HTML: `mapStyle` / `mapStyleDark` (URL or style object; HTML URLs only:
`data-ok-map-style` / `data-ok-map-style-dark`), `initialViewState` (`longitude`, `latitude`,
`zoom`, `pitch`, `bearing`, `bounds`, `fitBoundsOptions`; HTML root numbers and `data-ok-bounds`),
`viewState` / `longitude` … `bearing` (controlled; HTML: change the root numbers), `maxBounds`
(`data-ok-max-bounds`), `interactiveLayerIds` (`data-ok-interactive-layer-ids`), `cursor`,
`terrain`, `mapOptions` (any other MapLibre option, read once), `labels` (control names and
messages), `aria-label` (`data-ok-label`, the canvas name, default "Map"), `description`
(`p[data-ok-map-description]`), `fallback` (content of `[data-ok-map-fallback]`),
`attributionControl` (default `true`; HTML writes the attribution in the bottom-right corner).
Event props: `onLoad`, `onError`, `onIdle`, `onResize`, `onRemove`, `onRender`, `onData`,
`onStyleData`, `onSourceData`, `onMoveStart|Move|MoveEnd`, `onZoom…`, `onRotate…`, `onPitch…`,
`onDrag…`, `onBoxZoom…`, `onClick`, `onDblClick`, `onContextMenu`, `onMouseDown|Up|Move|Over|Out|
Enter|Leave`, `onWheel`, `onTouch…` (event: `{ type, viewState, lngLat?, point?, features?,
originalEvent?, error?, sourceId? }`), `onFullscreenChange`, `onFallback`.
Parts: `Marker` (`longitude`, `latitude`, `anchor`, `offset`, `color`, `draggable`, `rotation`,
`rotationAlignment`, `pitchAlignment`, `onDragStart|Drag|DragEnd({ lngLat })`, `onClick`,
children), `Popup` (`longitude`, `latitude`, `anchor`, `offset`, `closeButton`, `closeOnClick`,
`closeOnMove`, `focusAfterOpen`, `maxWidth`, `onClose(reason)`, `onOpen`), `Source` (MapLibre source
spec + `id`), `Layer` (MapLibre layer spec + `id`, `source`, `beforeId`), controls
`NavigationControl` (`showZoom`, `showCompass`, `visualizePitch`), `GeolocateControl`
(`trackUserLocation`, `showUserLocation`, `showAccuracyCircle`, `onGeolocate`, `onError`,
`onTrackUserLocationStart|End`), `FullscreenControl`, `ScaleControl` (`maxWidth`, `unit`),
`AttributionControl` (`compact`), `GlobeControl`, `TerrainControl` (`source`, `exaggeration`),
`MapControl` (custom), each with `position`; `MapPanel` (`position`); `MapProvider` + `useMap()`;
ref `MapRef` (`getMap()`, `controller`, `getViewState()`, `flyTo`, `easeTo`, `jumpTo`, `fitBounds`).

API mapping (react-map-gl): renamed `Map` → `MapView` (a component named `Map` shadows the global `Map` in consumer modules, Biome `noShadowRestrictedNames`). Kept `mapStyle`, `initialViewState`, `viewState` and the view props,
`minZoom` … `maxPitch`, `maxBounds`, `projection`, `renderWorldCopies`, `cooperativeGestures`, the
eight handler props, `interactiveLayerIds`, `cursor`, `terrain`, `attributionControl`, every event
prop, `Marker` / `Popup` / `Source` / `Layer` props, the controls and their options, `MapProvider`,
`useMap`, `MapRef.getMap()`. Added `mapStyleDark` (theme), `description`, `fallback`, `labels`,
`onFullscreenChange`, `onFallback`, `MapPanel`, `Popup.onClose(reason)`. Renamed: other MapLibre
options go through `mapOptions` (`transformRequest`, `hash`, `fadeDuration`, `locale`,
`pixelRatio`…). Not applicable: `mapLib` (MapLibre is built in), `reuseMaps`, `RTLTextPlugin` (call
MapLibre's `setRTLTextPlugin` from `@owlky/core/map`'s MapLibre), `Marker.popup` (compose a
`Popup`; HTML `data-ok-map-popup-open`), `Marker.color` as any CSS color (palette names), `style`
props of parts (class names / CSS), `useControl` (use `MapControl`), `LogoControl` (MapLibre logo
is off; the attribution credits the data).
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Root: 480px high (`--ok-spacing` × 120), `--ok-radius-md`, `overflow: hidden`; fullscreen fallback is
fixed and fills the window at `--ok-z-modal`. Corners: 10px from the edges, column of controls with
8px gaps. Controls: paper, `--ok-radius-md`, `--ok-shadow-z1`, 32px buttons, 20px icons, dividers
between buttons, hover `--ok-action-hover`, focus ring `--ok-text-primary`, disabled
`--ok-action-disabled`, pressed `--ok-palette-primary-main`; compass north `--ok-palette-error-main`.
Pin: 26px, `--ok-c-main` of `data-ok-color`. Popup: paper, `--ok-radius-lg`, `--ok-shadow-dropdown`,
10px tip, 240px max width, close button 28px. Panel: grey 900 at 80% with a 6px blur,
`--ok-radius-lg`, white text, a nested dark theme for its controls. Scale: gradient
`--ok-palette-secondary-dark` → `--ok-palette-error-dark`, white caption text. Attribution: white at
84%, grey 800 caption text, a 24px info button when folded (narrower than 640px or `compact`).
Responsive: the root is fluid (`min-width: 0`); panels cap at the map's size and scroll; the
attribution folds below 640px of map width.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
`data-ok-ready` (first style loaded, overlays placed), `data-ok-loaded` (MapLibre `load`),
`data-ok-fallback`, `data-ok-fullscreen`; popups `hidden` (HTML) and `data-ok-current-anchor`;
markers `data-ok-dragging`; controls `aria-disabled` (zoom limits), `aria-pressed` (fullscreen,
globe, terrain, tracking), `data-ok-state` (geolocate); attribution `open`, `data-ok-narrow`.
sections.title: States

sections.body:
- The controller mounts MapLibre on the view (attribution, logo and MapLibre controls off), labels
  the canvas, links the description and re-adds the owner's sources and layers after each style
  load. Without WebGL (or when MapLibre fails to start) it sets `data-ok-fallback` instead.
- `mapStyleDark` applies while the map's `color-scheme` is dark (a `data-ok-theme` scope or the
  system setting); scheme changes switch styles and re-read token colors.
- Markers and popups are positioned on every camera change through CSSOM (`--_ok-map-x|y`,
  rotations). Popups without `anchor` pick the side where they fit.
- Popups ask to close on their close button, Escape, a map click (`closeOnClick`) and camera moves
  (`closeOnMove`); the owner removes them (React) or the runtime hides them (HTML, cancelable).
  Opening moves focus into the popup (unless `focusAfterOpen` is off), closing returns it.
- Draggable markers follow the pointer (3px tolerance) or move 10px (Shift: 50px) per arrow key;
  the click that ends a drag is ignored. HTML stores the position in the marker's attributes; React
  reports `onDragEnd` (the marker stays where dropped until the props change).
- Controls: zoom buttons disable at the limits; the compass resets north (and the tilt with
  `visualizePitch`) and turns the map when dragged; geolocate flies to the location (tracking mode
  toggles a watch), shows a dot and accuracy circle and announces results and errors; fullscreen
  uses the Fullscreen API or a fixed fallback; globe toggles the projection; terrain toggles 3D
  terrain from a `raster-dem` source; scale and attribution follow the camera and the sources.
- HTML: `data-ok-map-popup-open="<id>"` toggles a popup (one open at a time),
  `[data-ok-map-fly-to="<map id>"][data-ok-view="lng,lat[,zoom[,pitch[,bearing]]]"][data-ok-duration]?`
  flies a map (click; `change` for checked radios), root and declaration attributes are observed.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body:
| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| Arrow keys (map) | Pan (MapLibre) |
| + / − (map) | Zoom (MapLibre) |
| Shift + arrows (map) | Rotate / tilt (MapLibre) |
| Enter / Space (button marker) | Click it |
| Arrow keys (draggable marker) | Move 10px; Shift: 50px |
| Escape | Close the focused popup; leave the fullscreen fallback |
| Tab | Map, markers, popups, panels, controls in DOM order |
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
The canvas is a `region` named by `aria-label` (default "Map"), `aria-roledescription="map"` and
described by `[data-ok-map-description]`, which is shown when the map can't draw. Interactive
markers are buttons with names. Popups are dialogs (or tooltips for hover readouts) that take and
return focus. Control buttons are labelled (`labels`), report `aria-pressed` / `aria-disabled`, and
geolocation results are announced in the status region. Draggable markers can also be moved with
the keyboard; stories also let a click place them (WCAG 2.5.7). Animations respect reduced motion
(MapLibre's camera and the stories' animated point, which can be paused, WCAG 2.2.2).
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML (on the root unless noted): `ok:map:load|error|idle|movestart|move|moveend|zoomend|rotateend|
pitchend|click|dblclick|contextmenu|mousemove|mouseenter|mouseleave` (detail: the core `MapEvent`),
`ok:map:popupopen` / `ok:map:popupclose` (on the popup; `detail.reason`, cancelable),
`ok:map:markerdragstart|markerdrag|markerdragend` (on the marker; `detail.lngLat`),
`ok:map:fullscreen` (`{ fullscreen }`), `ok:map:geolocate` (`{ coords }`),
`ok:map:geolocateerror` (`{ code, message }`), `ok:map:trackuserlocation` (`{ tracking }`),
`ok:map:fallback` (`{ reason }`). Instance: `{ controller, map, viewState, flyTo, easeTo, jumpTo,
fitBounds, setSourceData(id, data), getClusterExpansionZoom(source, clusterId), openPopup(popup),
closePopup(popup), fullscreen, setFullscreen(on) }`. Worker: `setMapWorkerUrl(url)` from
`@owlky/core/map` (bundlers: `@owlky/core/map-worker.js`; `owlky-map.js` finds
`owlky-map-worker.js` next to itself).
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Style, data and tile URLs go through `safeMapUrl` (`http(s)` only, relative resolved). Declarations
are read through an allowlist; JSON values only reach MapLibre's validated style. Attributions are
split into text and `http(s)` links (`target=_blank rel="noopener noreferrer"`), never parsed as
HTML. No `innerHTML`, no inline styles in markup (CSSOM only). CSP: MapLibre's worker needs
`worker-src 'self'` (`blob:` for a cross-origin worker URL); Trusted Types pages need a policy for
the worker URL (MapLibre calls `new Worker(url)`).
sections.title: Security

sections.body:
- React `Source` / `Layer` render no DOM; HTML writes `hidden` declarations (parity skips `hidden`).
- React renders a popup while it is open; HTML keeps closed popups `hidden` in the markup.
- HTML-only hooks ignored by parity: `data-ok-map-popup-open`, `data-ok-map-fly-to`, `data-ok-view`,
  `data-ok-duration`.
- React portals controls into the corners after mount (none in server markup); HTML writes them in
  the corners.
- Pixel parity masks the WebGL canvas and the panels and credits drawn over it: two page loads can
  render tiles at different moments. The DOM (including MapLibre's canvas container) is compared.
- Stories: Controls are not offered (stateful demos, like the Editor); options are covered by unit
  tests and the docs' Options tables.

sections.body:
Render Markdown (GitHub Flavored by default) as styled content, safely: no HTML strings, unsafe
URLs removed, raw HTML shown as text unless `rawHtml` (then sanitized by an allow list). One
pipeline in core (`@owlky/core/markdown`): remark-parse + remark-gfm → remark plugins →
remark-rehype → (rehype-raw → sanitizer) → rehype plugins → Owlky's last step (react-markdown's:
raw HTML as text or dropped, element filters, URL transform, cell alignment, external links,
highlighting, task labels). React maps the tree to elements; the HTML runtime builds DOM with
`createElement` / `setAttribute` / CSSOM.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
div[data-ok-markdown][data-ok-images]?[data-ok-images-ratio]?[data-ok-gfm="false"]?[data-ok-raw-html]?[data-ok-skip-html]?[data-ok-unwrap-disallowed]?[data-ok-external-links]?[data-ok-allowed-elements]?[data-ok-disallowed-elements]?
  …rendered content: h1–h6, p, a, strong, em, del, code, ul / ol › li, blockquote, hr, img (or
    span[data-ok-image] › span[data-ok-image-placeholder] + img with `images="image"`), br,
    table › thead / tbody › tr › th / td (style text-align from the column alignment),
    pre › code[class="hljs language-x"] › span.hljs-* (with a highlighter),
    li.task-list-item › label › input[type=checkbox][disabled][checked]? + text,
    section[data-footnotes].footnotes › h2.sr-only + ol › li[id] (GFM footnotes)
  pre[data-ok-markdown-source][hidden]      (HTML only: the Markdown text, escaped; last child)
```
Elements never rendered, whatever the options and plugins: `script style iframe frame frameset
object embed applet base link meta template noscript`. Attributes never written: `on*`, invalid
names, `srcdoc`, `is`; `style` only through CSSOM.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `markdown`: listed under "options".)

Other props (react-markdown's): `children` (string), `remarkPlugins`, `rehypePlugins`,
`remarkRehypeOptions` (`allowDangerousHtml` forced on), `allowedElements` /
`disallowedElements` (HTML `data-ok-allowed-elements` / `data-ok-disallowed-elements`, space
separated; both → error), `allowElement(element, index, parent)`, `urlTransform(url, key, node)`
(default `defaultUrlTransform`; `""`, `null`, `undefined` remove the attribute), `components`
(React: tag → component or tag name; components get `node`). Owlky's: `sanitizeSchema` (default
`markdownSanitizeSchema`), `highlighter` (lowlight-compatible, as the Editor). JavaScript-only
options in HTML go to `createMarkdown({ … })`, plus `async: true`.
Exports: React `Markdown`, `MarkdownAsync` (async server component), `MarkdownHooks` (`fallback`,
`onError`), `defaultUrlTransform`, `markdownSanitizeSchema`, types `MarkdownComponents`,
`MarkdownExtraProps`, `AllowElement`, `UrlTransform`, `MarkdownOptions`. HTML `markdown`,
`createMarkdown`. Core `markdownTree`, `markdownTreeAsync`, `createMarkdownProcessor`,
`finishTree`, `markdownElementAttributes`, `markdownElementStyle`, `childSpace`, `parseStyle`.

API mapping (react-markdown): kept `children`, `remarkPlugins`, `rehypePlugins`,
`remarkRehypeOptions`, `allowedElements`, `disallowedElements`, `allowElement`,
`unwrapDisallowed`, `skipHtml`, `urlTransform`, `components`, `Markdown`, `MarkdownAsync`,
`MarkdownHooks` (+ `fallback`), `defaultUrlTransform`. Added (reference, HTML parity, security):
`gfm` (on: the reference renders GFM, and HTML can't pass remark-gfm through attributes),
`rawHtml` + `sanitizeSchema` (the reference renders HTML; rehype-raw + allow list built in),
`externalLinks` (the reference's links open in a new tab), `highlighter` (the reference highlights
code), `onError` (MarkdownHooks), `images` + `imageRatio` (the reference renders pictures through
its Image, 16/9: `image` composes Owlky's Image, ADR-0038; React maps `img` to `Image` unless
`components.img` is set, HTML builds the Image markup and the Image runtime mounts it). Not applicable: `className` (v9, removed in v10; the root div
takes every div prop).
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Root: body1, `text-primary`, `overflow-wrap: break-word`; first child no top margin, last
rendered child no bottom margin. Headings: typography h1–h6 tokens, margins 40px (h1, h2) / 24px
top, 8px bottom. Paragraphs 0 0 20px. Links `primary-main` (brand, ADR-0014), no underline,
underline on hover, focus, and inside quotes and footnotes (secondary text: link-in-text-block).
Lists: padding-left 16px, margin-bottom 12px, items line-height 2. Task boxes 16px, radius xs,
`grey-500 / 0.24`, checked `primary-main` with a check of two gradient strokes in
`primary-contrast-text` (no image: CSP). Blockquote: padding 24 24 24 64px, 8px left border
`grey-500 / 0.08`, `text-secondary`, 24px / 1.5, a 72px “ in `text-disabled`. Hr: 32px margins,
`divider`. Images: max-width 100%, radius xl (as Image: the Image's root has the radius). Inline code: `grey-500 / 0.2`, text primary, mono
0.875em, radius xs. Code blocks: `grey-900`, white mono body2 / 1.5, padding 24px, radius md,
lines wrap; syntax colors as the Editor (palette `*-light`, ≥ 4.5:1 on grey-900). Tables: width
100%, body2, 1px `divider` borders, cells 8px, header bold, odd body rows `bg-neutral`.
Footnotes: top rule, body2 `text-secondary`; `.sr-only` visually hidden. Source `pre`: mono body2,
pre-wrap.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
- Raw HTML (`html` nodes): default text (escaped, react-markdown); `skipHtml` drops it (wins over
  `rawHtml`); `rawHtml` parses it (rehype-raw), then `sanitizeSchema` (GitHub's + `u`, `mark`,
  `style` limited to `text-align` / `text-transform`); ids get `user-content-` (clobbering) and
  `#id` links to prefixed ids follow.
- URLs (`href` on any element, `xlink:href`, and html-url-attributes' list: `src`, `cite`,
  `action`, `formAction`, `poster`…) go through `urlTransform`; `srcset` with an unsafe candidate
  is dropped. Default: relative or `http`, `https`, `mailto`, `irc`, `ircs`, `xmpp`.
- `externalLinks`: absolute `http(s)` links get `target="_blank"`; every `target="_blank"` link
  gets `rel` `noopener noreferrer`.
- Table cell `align` → `style="text-align: …"` (react-markdown's default); whitespace text in
  table parts is dropped (React and the DOM agree).
- Highlighting: `pre > code` holding only text, with a `language-` / `lang-` class the
  highlighter knows (not `no-highlight`): children replaced by the highlighter's tree, `hljs`
  class added; a throwing grammar leaves the text.
- Task list boxes (and raw-HTML `input[type=checkbox]` first in a `li` / `p`) are wrapped with the
  phrasing content after them in a `label` (axe `label`; after the filters, so they can't drop it).
- HTML runtime: reads the source `pre`'s text, renders before it, hides it; re-renders when the
  text or an option attribute changes; no source → leaves the markup alone (server-rendered).
  Errors (both element lists) → `ok:markdown:error`, source shown again. `async: true` uses
  `markdownTreeAsync` and writes only the latest result (nothing after destroy).
- React `Markdown` is synchronous and hook-free (server components); `MarkdownHooks` processes
  in an effect.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body: None of its own: links are native tab stops; checkboxes are disabled.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
Headings keep their levels (shift them with `components` or plugins). Images keep their `alt`.
Task boxes are disabled checkboxes named by their label. Code blocks wrap (no scroll region, 320px
reflow). Footnote label `h2.sr-only` is read but hidden. Brand-colored links exempt from
`color-contrast` (ADR-0014), underlined where the surrounding text is secondary.
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML `ok:markdown:render` (`{ value }`), `ok:markdown:error` (`{ error }`). Instance
`{ value, setValue(markdown), render() }`. Registration is opt-in: `@owlky/html/markdown`,
`owlky-markdown.js`, or `createMarkdown({ … })`. React `MarkdownHooks` `onError(error)`.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Content flows at every width: images and tables are 100% wide at most, cells and code wrap
(`overflow-wrap`), headings use the responsive typography tokens. The story puts its card full
width; no breakpoint of its own.
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
React renders `data-ok-runtime="off"` on the root; HTML keeps the hidden source `pre` (parity
skips `[hidden]`). Both renderers write the same attributes (`markdownElementAttributes`) and the
same inline styles through CSSOM (parity ignores `style`). React writes `checked` / `value` of
inputs as `defaultChecked` / `defaultValue` (the attributes match).
