sections.body:
Choices on a temporary surface: a Popover holding a WAI-ARIA menu. Keyboard logic: core
`menuKeyTarget` / `initialMenuItem` / `createTypeahead`.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
button[data-ok-popover-open="id"][aria-haspopup=menu][aria-expanded]
div[data-ok-popover][popover=manual][id][data-ok-placement=bottom-start]
  › span[data-ok-popover-arrow]
  › ul[data-ok-menu][role=menu][aria-labelledby][data-ok-dense]?
      › li[data-ok-menu-item][role=menuitem][tabindex=-1][data-ok-selected]?[aria-disabled]?…
```
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `menu`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `menu-item`: listed under "options".)

React: `Menu` `open` / `anchorEl` / `onOpenChange(open, reason)` (escape | backdrop | select |
tab), `placement` (default `bottom-start`), `paperProps`; `MenuItem` `onClick` (choosing closes
the menu unless `preventDefault()`). Renamed: `onClose` → `onOpenChange`; `MenuListProps` →
props on `Menu` (they go to the list); `PaperProps` / `slotProps.paper` → `paperProps`.
Kept: `variant="selectedMenu"` behavior (focus the selected item) as the only behavior; MUI
`autoFocusItem` always on. Deferred: `variant="menu"`, nested menus. Not applicable:
`TransitionComponent`, `sx`, `classes`, `component`.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Items: padding 6px 8px, radius `--ok-radius-sm`, body2, 4px between items, min height 34px;
hover `--ok-action-hover`, focus `--ok-action-focus` (+ 2px inner outline on focus-visible),
selected `--ok-action-hover` + semibold, disabled opacity 0.48; dense 4px block; divider 1px.
Paper: see popover.md (scrolls when its max height is set).
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body: The paper stays 16px inside the viewport; long menus scroll inside it.
sections.title: Responsive behavior

sections.body:
Entrance and exit animations for any content (Motion), staggered groups (MotionGroup), letter by
letter text (MotionText), looping backgrounds (Ken Burns, pan, color change), SVG stroke drawing,
hover / press scaling, counters (CountUp) and turning gradient borders (MotionBorder). The CSS plays
the animations; core decides when (`createMotionTrigger`: mount, in view, manual) and counts
(`createCountUp`). Without JavaScript nothing is hidden: the start state needs `data-ok-state`.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
[data-ok-motion][data-ok-variant][data-ok-trigger][data-ok-once="false"]?[data-ok-amount]?[data-ok-in]?
  [data-ok-duration]?[data-ok-delay]?[data-ok-distance]?[data-ok-paused]?[data-ok-state=initial|enter|exit]
  › content (draw: an svg whose shapes have pathLength="1")
[data-ok-motion-group][trigger options][data-ok-stagger]? › [data-ok-motion]…   (direct children staggered)
span[data-ok-motion-text][data-ok-variant][trigger options][data-ok-stagger]?[data-ok-state]
  › span[data-ok-motion-text-label] (visually hidden text)
  + span[aria-hidden=true] › span[data-ok-motion-text-word] › span[data-ok-motion-char]…
span[data-ok-count-up][data-ok-end][data-ok-start]?[data-ok-decimals]?[data-ok-duration]?[trigger options]
  › span[data-ok-count-up-label] (visually hidden end value) + span[aria-hidden=true] › prefix,
    span[data-ok-count-up-value], suffix
div[data-ok-motion-border][data-ok-shape][data-ok-color][data-ok-secondary-color]?[data-ok-width]?[data-ok-duration]?
  [data-ok-paused]? › content
Dialog: div[data-ok-dialog-paper][data-ok-motion][data-ok-variant][data-ok-trigger=mount]   (`transition`)
```
Private properties (React `style`, HTML CSSOM): `--_ok-motion-duration | -delay | -distance |
-stagger | -index`, `--_ok-motion-border-width | -duration | -fill`; CSS-only
`--_ok-motion-border-light | -light-channel | -light-2 | -light-2-channel` (reset to `initial` on
every root so nested borders don't inherit them).
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `motion`: listed under "options".)

MotionGroup:
(Options of `motion-group`: listed under "options".)

MotionText:
(Options of `motion-text`: listed under "options".)

CountUp:
(Options of `count-up`: listed under "options".)

MotionBorder:
(Options of `motion-border`: listed under "options".)

Content: `children` (MotionText: a string), CountUp `prefix` / `suffix`. API mapping (Framer
Motion): variants → `variant` (the reference's 48 entrance / exit names, its background and its
other effects); `whileInView` + `viewport.once` / `amount` → `trigger="inView"`, `once`, `amount`;
`animate` / `exit` / `AnimatePresence` → `trigger="manual"` + `in` (exits play the entrance
backwards); `transition.duration` / `delay` → `duration`, `delay`; `staggerChildren` → MotionGroup /
MotionText `stagger`; `whileHover` / `whileTap` → `variant="interactive"`; `pathLength` → `draw`.
MotionBorder (the reference's own animated border): `slotProps.primaryBorder` → `color`, `width`;
`slotProps.secondaryBorder` → `secondaryColor` (the two lights share one ring); per-side `padding` /
per-corner radius → the root's CSS `border-width` / `border-radius` (zero specificity, so author
rules win). Beyond the reference: `paused` (WCAG 2.2.2). Deferred: `component` (Motion always renders a
`div`), spring physics, custom keyframes, layout animations, scroll-linked progress (Scroll
progress page), exit of a Dialog, the reference's logo rings (shape-morphing,
custom keyframes: Motion full version, phase 1). Not applicable: `motion.*` element factories, `useAnimate`.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Entrances: `--ok-duration-enter` (640ms), exits `--ok-duration-exit` (480ms),
`--ok-easing-expressive`. Distances: 160px (`--ok-spacing` × 40) slides, 120px fades, 360px
directional zoom / bounce. Loops: `--ok-duration-enter` × 8 (≈ 5 s). Draw: × 3. Interactive:
scale 1.09 on hover, 0.97 pressed, `--ok-duration-shorter`. Color change: a gradient of primary,
warning, secondary and error `main`, 2–5 times the text width (the element shrinks to its content).
MotionBorder: 2px, `--ok-radius-lg` (circle: 50%), three layers: the fill on the padding box
(`--ok-bg-paper`, `--_ok-motion-border-fill`), a conic gradient on the border box (multi: the same
four colors all around; `inherit` / a palette color: a light about 90° long, symmetric; with
`secondaryColor`: a second light 180° away) and a faint track under it (135°, first light's channel
at 8% → second light's at 24%; `inherit` and `multi` use `--ok-palette-grey-500-channel`). CountUp: tabular figures, ease-out cubic, 2000ms.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
`initial` holds in-variants at their start (paused animation) and out-variants as themselves;
`enter` plays; `exit` plays the other way (other keyframe name, so it restarts). An entered
in-variant drops the animation at its end (`animation-fill-mode: backwards`): no transform is left.
`inView` (IntersectionObserver; none → shown at once): plays when `amount` is visible; `once=false`
exits when it leaves. `mount`: at once. `manual`: follows `in` / `data-ok-in`. Changing `variant`,
`duration` or `distance` replays an entered Motion (React too). MotionGroup drives every Motion
whose closest group it is. Loops run while entered, `paused` stops them. Reduced motion: entrances
and exits take 1ms, loops and the border don't run, interactive doesn't transition, CountUp shows
the end at once.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body: Not interactive. Content inside keeps its own keyboard behavior.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
Content never depends on the animation (no JavaScript → shown; reduced motion → shown at once).
MotionText and CountUp hide the moving copy (`aria-hidden`) and expose a visually hidden label with
the whole text / end value. Loops need a pause control (WCAG 2.2.2): `paused`. Directional
entrances start outside the box: clip containers that could widen the page.
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML: `ok:motion:end` (`{ state }`) on a Motion. Instances: motion / motion-group / motion-text
`{ state, replay() }`, count-up `{ replay() }`, motion-border `{}` (width and duration only).
React: native `onAnimationEnd`; change the `key` to replay.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body: Nothing changes per breakpoint. Stories clip their stages (`overflow: clip`).
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
React renders `data-ok-runtime="off"` and writes `data-ok-state` itself (SSR: `initial`); snippets
carry no state (the runtime writes it). React 19's `<link rel="preload">` hints next to images are
skipped by parity. Private properties go through `style` (ignored by parity).
sections.title: Parity notes

sections.body:
A hierarchy (people of a company, parts of a product) as a top-down tree of nodes joined by
connector lines. Node content is free (cards in the stories). CSS only; a small runtime turns the
length options into private custom properties in HTML.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
ul[data-ok-organization-chart][data-ok-line-color][data-ok-line-style]
  [data-ok-line-height]? [data-ok-line-width]? [data-ok-line-border-radius]? [data-ok-node-padding]?
  [aria-label | aria-labelledby]
  li[data-ok-organization-chart-node]                     (the root node: React `label`)
    div[data-ok-organization-chart-label]                 (any content)
    ul[data-ok-organization-chart-children]?              (only when there are children)
      li[data-ok-organization-chart-node]                 (OrganizationChartNode, any depth)
        div[data-ok-organization-chart-label]
        ul[data-ok-organization-chart-children]?
```
Wide charts scroll by composition: `Scrollbar › OrganizationChart` (stories, docs).
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `organization-chart`: listed under "options".)

Content: `label` (ReactNode) on `OrganizationChart` and `OrganizationChartNode`; `children`
(`OrganizationChartNode` elements). Rest props go to the root `ul` (chart) or the `li` (node);
`style` is merged after the length properties.

API mapping (`react-organizational-chart`): `Tree` → **renamed** `OrganizationChart` (a generic
`Tree` would collide with Tree view), `TreeNode` → **renamed** `OrganizationChartNode`; kept
`label`, `children`, `lineHeight`, `lineWidth`, `lineColor`, `lineStyle`, `lineBorderRadius`,
`nodePadding`. Defaults follow the reference (the Minimals wrapper), not the upstream:
`lineHeight` 40 (upstream 20px), `lineBorderRadius` 24 (5px), `nodePadding` 4 (5px), `lineColor`
`divider` (`black`). `lineColor` is an allowlist (`divider`, `inherit`, palette colors at their
light tone) instead of any CSS color: `inherit` + the root's `color` covers custom colors without
untrusted CSS. `lineStyle` keeps `solid` / `dashed` / `dotted` (other border styles look like
`solid` at 1px). Lengths: a number (px) or a non-negative length in `px`, `rem` or `em`.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
- Root: `display: flex`, centered, `inline-size: max-content`, `min-inline-size: 100%` (centered
  when it fits, otherwise as wide as its widest level and starting at the container's start, so a
  scroll container reaches every node). List reset, `--ok-text-primary`, `--ok-font-family`.
- Node: flex column, centered, `text-align: center`; child nodes `padding: lineHeight nodePadding 0`.
- Children list: flex row, centered, `padding-block-start: lineHeight`; `::before` draws the line
  down from the parent (`lineHeight` tall, on the list's center).
- Child node `::before` / `::after`: the two halves of the bar above it (`lineHeight` tall, 50%
  wide); `::after` also draws the line down to the label. First child: no start half, rounded
  start corner (`lineBorderRadius`); last child: no end half, the start half turns down with the
  rounded end corner (shifted by `lineWidth` onto the same pixels); only child: a straight line.
- Lines: `lineWidth lineStyle lineColor`; default 1px solid `--ok-divider`; palette colors
  `--ok-palette-<color>-light`; `inherit` = `currentColor` of the chart.
- Private properties: `--_ok-org-line-height` (default `--ok-spacing` × 10 = 40px),
  `--_ok-org-line-width` (1px), `--_ok-org-line-radius` (`--ok-spacing` × 6 = 24px),
  `--_ok-org-node-padding` (`--ok-spacing` = 4px), `--_ok-org-line-color`, `--_ok-org-line-style`,
  `--_ok-org-line`; all declared on every root, so nested charts don't inherit them.
- Logical properties throughout: right-to-left charts mirror.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body: None (static).
sections.title: States

sections.body:
No interaction. HTML runtime (`organization-chart`): reads `data-ok-line-height`,
`data-ok-line-width`, `data-ok-line-border-radius`, `data-ok-node-padding` through the schema
(invalid → left out) and writes the private properties through CSSOM; follows changes to those
attributes (`MutationObserver`); `destroy()` removes what it wrote. Without JavaScript the
stylesheet defaults apply. React writes the same properties in `style` and renders
`data-ok-runtime="off"`.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body: None of its own. Controls in labels follow DOM order: a node, then its children.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
Nested lists: screen readers announce each level, its size and positions. Name the root `ul`
(`aria-label` / `aria-labelledby`). Lines are decorative (borders on pseudo-elements). Wide
charts go in a named, focusable Scrollbar (keyboard scrolling).
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body: None. HTML instance: `destroy()` only (runtime-managed).
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Same layout at every breakpoint: the chart never wraps (a tree keeps its shape). Narrower than its
container: centered. Wider: overflows to the inline end; the Scrollbar wrapper scrolls it from the
first node (the reference centers with `justify-content: center` and cuts off the start on phones).
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
None: the same markup; React's `style` and the runtime's CSSOM properties are equal (parity
ignores `style`).

```
    HTML: [data-ok-count][data-ok-page][data-ok-sibling-count]?[data-ok-boundary-count]?[data-ok-label-page]?[data-ok-label-current]?
    React: + data-ok-runtime="off"
  ul
    li › button[type=button][data-ok-pagination-item][data-ok-type=first|previous|next|last][aria-label][disabled]? › svg[aria-hidden] (or your icon)
    li › button[type=button][data-ok-pagination-item][data-ok-type=page][value=<n>][aria-label][aria-current=page]?[disabled]? › n
    li › span[data-ok-pagination-ellipsis][aria-hidden=true] › …
```
Paging a table (HTML): `data-ok-pagination="<table id>"` + `data-ok-rows-per-page` (default 10)
without `data-ok-count`. React has no equivalent prop: the app slices its rows for `page`.

`PaginationItem` with `href` renders `a[data-ok-pagination-item]` (links; React).
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `pagination`: listed under "options".)

Range and labels (React prop ↔ HTML attribute): `count` (default 1) ↔ `data-ok-count`; `page` /
`defaultPage` (1-based, default 1) ↔ `data-ok-page`; `siblingCount` (1) ↔ `data-ok-sibling-count`;
`boundaryCount` (1) ↔ `data-ok-boundary-count`; `showFirstButton`, `showLastButton`,
`hidePrevButton`, `hideNextButton` ↔ which buttons the markup contains;
`getItemAriaLabel(type, page, selected)` ↔ `data-ok-label-page` (default `"Go to page {page}"`) and
`data-ok-label-current` (default `"page {page}"`) for the page items the runtime builds; previous /
next / first / last keep their markup labels. `icons={{ previous, next, first, last }}` ↔ the SVG in
the markup. `renderItem(item)` + `PaginationItem` (React) for custom items or links.

Values from attributes are validated: non-integers and out-of-range values fall back to defaults.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
- Items: `--ok-spacing` × 8 (32px; `sm` 26px, `lg` 40px), padding 6px, margin 3px between items,
  body2 (`lg`: `--ok-font-size-lg`), current page weight 600; icons 20px (18 / 22).
- Shape: `circular` = `--ok-radius-full`, `rounded` = `--ok-radius-md`.
- Hover (hover-capable devices): `--ok-action-hover`. Focus-visible: 2px `--ok-text-primary` outline.
- Current page — `text`: `main` fill, `contrast` text (`standard`: `--ok-inherit-main` /
  `--ok-inherit-contrast`); `outlined`: grey 32 % borders, current `main` border and text, 8 % fill
  (`standard`: inherit main, grey 8 %); `soft`: 16 % fill, `-text` tone (`standard`: grey 16 %,
  primary text).
- Disabled: `--ok-action-disabled` text; current page `--ok-action-disabled-bg`.
- Items wrap onto more lines when the row is too narrow.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
- React: controlled (`page` + `onChange(page)`) or uncontrolled (`defaultPage`); `onChange` fires
  with the requested page; a controlled owner refuses by not updating `page`.
- HTML runtime (`pagination`): an item click → cancelable `ok:pagination:change` `{ page }` → the
  page items and ellipses are rebuilt (DOM APIs, no HTML strings), the buttons' disabled states
  and `data-ok-page` updated; focus stays on the clicked button (or the new current page).
  Instance: `page`, `count`, `setPage(page)`, `refresh()`.
- Linked to a table (`data-ok-pagination="<table id>"`, no `data-ok-count`): `count` = row groups
  ÷ `data-ok-rows-per-page`; row groups outside the page get `hidden` (open detail rows follow
  their row); the table's `sort()` refreshes it.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body: Native buttons: Tab / Shift+Tab move between items, Enter / Space activate.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
- `nav` with an `aria-label` (default "pagination navigation"); the current page has
  `aria-current="page"`; every item has a name (`getItemAriaLabel` / label templates).
- Ellipses are `aria-hidden`. Disabled items are native `disabled`.
- Brand-colored current pages (`text`, `outlined` with a color) follow the reference (ADR-0014);
  `standard` and `soft` meet AA.
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body: `ok:pagination:change` (cancelable, `detail.page`).
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body: Mobile first: items keep their size (≥ 24px targets) and wrap; the page never overflows.
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
- Labels: React builds them with `getItemAriaLabel`; HTML uses the `data-ok-label-page` and
  `data-ok-label-current` templates. Defaults are identical.
- HTML only: `data-ok-pagination="<table id>"` pages a table's rows (see Behavior); in React the app
  slices its rows for `page`.
- React only: `renderItem` + `PaginationItem` (links, custom items).

sections.body:
A surface: the paper background, the primary text color, rounded corners and an elevation
shadow (or a 1px outline). CSS only; the base other surfaces (Card) are built on.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
<element>[data-ok-paper][data-ok-variant][data-ok-elevation][data-ok-square]?   any content
```
The element is the author's: `div` by default (React `component`, HTML any element such as
`section`, `article`, `li`). Paper adds no role: it is a visual surface only.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `paper`: listed under "options".)

React: `component` (the element, default `div`), `children`, `ref` and every HTML attribute
(passed to the element). Not applicable: `sx`, `classes`.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
`--ok-bg-paper` background, `--ok-text-primary` text, `--ok-radius-md` corners (`square`: 0).
`elevation` 0–24 → `box-shadow: var(--ok-elevation-<n>)` (0: none), changes animate over
`--ok-duration-standard` / `--ok-easing-standard` (none with reduced motion). `outlined`: no
shadow, `1px solid rgb(var(--ok-palette-grey-500-channel) / 0.16)` (Minimals' theme), elevation
ignored. No size, padding or display of its own: the content and the author's layout decide.
Dark mode: the same `--ok-bg-paper` at every elevation (Minimals' theme drops MUI's lightening
gradient; the dark paper already differs from the dark page background).
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
- **Card** (`specs/components/card.md`, next) is a Paper root: its element carries
  `paperAttributes()` *and* `data-ok-card` (React: `<Paper {...props} data-ok-card="">` or the
  same attributes on its own element; HTML: `data-ok-paper … data-ok-card` on one element). It
  reuses Paper's `variant`, `elevation` and `square` options (spread `paperOptions.options` into
  its schema) and adds its own.
- `paper.css` is imported **first** among the components in `styles/src/index.css`: every rule is
  a zero-specificity `:where()`, so a composing component's CSS (loaded later) overrides Paper's
  radius, shadow or background by source order — e.g. `:where([data-ok-card]) { border-radius:
  var(--ok-radius-2xl); box-shadow: var(--ok-shadow-card) }`. Such a component restates what must
  still win over its own rule: `:where([data-ok-card][data-ok-variant="outlined"])` (no shadow),
  `:where([data-ok-card][data-ok-square])` (no radius).
- Paper sets only `background-color`, `color`, `border-radius`, `box-shadow`, `border`
  (outlined) and `transition`: no `display`, `overflow`, padding or size, so a composer adds them
  without undoing anything. No private variables (they would inherit into nested papers).
- Existing surfaces (Popover, Menu, Dialog, Drawer, TableContainer) paint the same tokens
  themselves today; they can move onto `data-ok-paper` later without a visual change by keeping
  their own shadow / radius rules after `paper.css`.

Stories: the labels are Typography `body2` (`textSecondary` on the Elevation levels, as in the
reference); `sb-paper-*` classes give sizes and centering only.
sections.title: Composition contract (Card and other surfaces)

sections.body: Fluid: no width or height of its own; nothing changes per breakpoint.
sections.title: Responsive behavior

sections.body:
Not focusable, no role. Content on paper uses `--ok-text-primary` / `--ok-text-secondary`
(AA on `--ok-bg-paper` in both schemes). The shadow and outline are decorative: don't convey
meaning by elevation alone.

sections.body:
Content next to an anchor, in the top layer. Runtime behavior: core `createPopoverController`
(positioning, flip, shift, Escape / outside press, focus, layer stack), shared by Menu and Tooltip.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
button[data-ok-popover-open="id"][aria-haspopup][aria-expanded][aria-controls]   (HTML trigger; or data-ok-popover-hover)
div[data-ok-popover][popover=manual][id][data-ok-placement][data-ok-arrow]?[role=dialog]?
  › span[data-ok-popover-arrow][aria-hidden]       (always rendered; shown with data-ok-arrow)
  › content
```
States written by the controller: `data-ok-open`, `data-ok-current-placement` (after a flip),
`data-ok-fallback` (no Popover API), CSSOM `--_ok-popover-x|y|arrow`.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `popover`: listed under "options".)

React: `open` + `anchorEl` (element or function) + `onOpenChange(open, reason)`, `initialFocus`,
`children`. Renamed: `anchorOrigin` / `transformOrigin` → `placement` (one vocabulary for
Popover, Menu and Tooltip: side + start/center/end; the controller flips and shifts);
`onClose(event, reason)` → `onOpenChange(false, reason)` with `escape` | `backdrop`; the
Minimals arrow (`slotProps.arrow.placement`) → `arrow` (it follows the placement).
Deferred: `anchorPosition` / `anchorReference` (anchoring to a point), `marginThreshold` (16px
fixed), `container` (top layer). Not applicable: `TransitionComponent`, `slots`, `slotProps`,
`sx`, `elevation` (one dropdown shadow), `disableScrollLock` (non-modal: the page stays scrollable;
the popover follows its anchor), `disablePortal` (top layer).
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Paper: radius `--ok-radius-md` × 1.25 (10px), padding 4px, `rgb(var(--ok-bg-paper-channel) / 0.9)`,
blur 20px, two glows (info top-right, error bottom-left, 12%), `--ok-shadow-dropdown`, max size
viewport − 32px, scrolls without an arrow. Gap 8px (12px with the arrow); 16px from the viewport
edges. Arrow 14px, `--ok-bg-paper`, 1px grey-500/12% border. Opening: fade + scale 0.96,
`--ok-duration-shorter` (none with reduced motion). Fallback: `position: fixed`, `--ok-z-dropdown`.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
Stays 16px inside the viewport at every width (shift on the cross axis, flip on the main axis,
clamp when neither side fits).
sections.title: Responsive behavior

sections.body:
Focus moves into the popover on open (first tabbable, else the popover) and back to the anchor on
close (`disableAutoFocus` / `disableRestoreFocus` turn this off; hover triggers do). Escape
closes the top layer only. Interactive popovers: `role="dialog"` + a name; triggers
`aria-haspopup` + `aria-expanded` (synced by the HTML runtime).
sections.title: Keyboard / Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML: `ok:popover:beforeopen` (cancelable, `detail.anchor`), `ok:popover:open`,
`ok:popover:beforeclose` (cancelable, `detail.reason`: escape | backdrop | trigger | select | tab |
api), `ok:popover:close`. Instance: `{ isOpen, open(anchor), close(reason?), toggle(anchor) }`.

sections.body:
Give or show a score as icons. A native radio group carries the value, keyboard and labels;
the owner (React state, HTML runtime `rating`) marks filled icons.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
span[data-ok-rating][data-ok-size][data-ok-color][data-ok-highlight-selected-only]?[data-ok-disabled]?
  span[data-ok-rating-item]                                       (one per whole value)
    label[data-ok-rating-icon][for][data-ok-value][data-ok-fraction]?[data-ok-filled]?[data-ok-hover]?
      svg[aria-hidden] | span[data-ok-rating-icon-filled] + span[data-ok-rating-icon-empty]
      span[data-ok-rating-label-text]                              (visually hidden: "2 Stars")
    input[type=radio][data-ok-rating-input][id][name][value]       (visually hidden)
  label[data-ok-rating-empty][for] + input[type=radio][data-ok-rating-input][value=""]   ("Empty")
read-only: span[data-ok-rating][data-ok-read-only][role=img][aria-label] › items › span[data-ok-rating-icon]
```
Fractions (precision 0.5 / 0.25) come first in their item, absolutely positioned over the whole
icon and clipped to `data-ok-fraction` × the size.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `rating`: listed under "options".)

Other props: `value` / `defaultValue` / `onChange(value | null)`, `onChangeActive(value | null)`,
`max` (5), `precision` (1 · 0.5 · 0.25), `name`, `icon`, `emptyIcon`, `renderIcon(value)`
(MUI `IconContainerComponent`, renamed: a function of the value), `getLabelText(value)` (default
"2 Stars"), `emptyLabelText` ("Empty"). HTML: markup per value, labels as text.

API mapping (MUI): kept `value`, `defaultValue`, `onChange` (value-first), `onChangeActive`, `max`,
`precision`, `readOnly`, `disabled`, `highlightSelectedOnly`, `name`, `icon`, `emptyIcon`,
`getLabelText`, `emptyLabelText`, `size` (+ the reference's `xSmall`, `xxSmall`). Beyond MUI:
`color` (the reference's custom color). Not applicable: `classes`, `sx`, `slotProps`.

options.description: The thumb shows on hover and focus only; `false` keeps it visible.
options.name: autoHide

sections.body:
A scroll area with themed, thin scrollbars that stay out of the way until needed. Table, Drawer
and Sortable scroll through it (see Anatomy).
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
section[data-ok-scrollbar][aria-label][tabindex=0][data-ok-auto-hide="false"]?   (named section = region)
  …content (the root itself scrolls: overflow: auto)
```
Used by other components by composition (their CSS adapts when it wraps a Scrollbar):
`TableContainer › Scrollbar › Table`, `DrawerContent › Scrollbar › …`, `Scrollbar › Sortable`.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `scrollbar`: listed under "options".)

Name and focus: `aria-label` (default `"scrollable content"`, as upstream `ariaLabel`; skipped
when `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` is given) and `tabIndex` (default `0`). Upstream
`forceVisible`, `clickOnTrack`, `scrollbarMinSize` / `scrollbarMaxSize`, `direction`, `timeout`,
`classNames`, `recalculate()` and `getScrollElement()` don't apply: the scrollbars are native
(`overflow`, `dir` and the browser cover them) and the root is the scroll element (React `ref`).
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
- Thumb: `text.disabled` at 48 % — `rgb(--ok-palette-grey-500-channel / 0.48)` (light),
  grey 600 (dark, via `light-dark()`; light tone without it); track transparent.
- Standard path (`@supports (scrollbar-color: auto)`): `scrollbar-width: thin`,
  `scrollbar-color: <thumb> transparent`.
- Fallback (`::-webkit-scrollbar`, Safari and Chrome < 121): 11px track
  (`--ok-spacing` × 2.75), thumb inset 2px (× 0.5) with `--ok-radius-full`, min 10px (× 2.5).
- Focus-visible: 2px `--ok-text-primary` outline, inset.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
- Auto-hide (default): thumb transparent at rest; visible on `:hover` (hover-capable devices)
  and `:focus-within`. Touch screens (`hover: none`): always visible.
- `data-ok-auto-hide="false"`: always visible.
sections.title: States

sections.body: CSS only, no runtime. Scrolling is native (wheel, touch momentum, keyboard, find-in-page).
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body: Tab focuses the area; arrow keys, Page Up / Page Down, Home / End and Space scroll it (native).
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
- A named `<section>` (role `region`), focusable (axe `scrollable-region-focusable`).
- The thumb shows while focus is inside, so keyboard users see the position.
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body: None. React: `ref` is the scroll element.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body: None: React renders the same element and attributes as the snippets.
sections.title: Parity notes

sections.body:
1. Native scrollbars take layout space where the OS uses classic scrollbars (Windows, Linux);
   simplebar overlays them.
2. On the standard path (Firefox, Chrome 121+) the browser draws the thin thumb's shape and width.
3. No "visible while scrolling, fade out after 0.5s": CSS can't detect scrolling; the thumb shows
   on hover and focus instead.
4. iOS / Android show the system's overlay scrollbars.
sections.title: Intentional differences from the reference

sections.body:
Mobile first, no breakpoints: the area fills its container (`min-width: 0`); content wraps or
scrolls inside. The Layout story stacks Top / Left / content / Right / Bottom below 900px and uses
three columns from 900px (story-only demo CSS).
sections.title: Responsive

stories.html:
Scroll areas keep long content inside a fixed frame while the rest of the page stays where it is. The thumb follows the theme, stays thin, and appears when the pointer rests on the area or when the keyboard focus is inside it.

Every scroll area is a named region that can take focus, so keyboard users reach it with Tab and scroll it with the arrow keys, Page Up and Page Down, Home and End. Screen readers announce its name before the content.

The browser does the scrolling itself: momentum on touch screens, smooth wheel scrolling, find-in-page and scroll anchoring all keep working. Only the look of the bar changes, and it falls back to the native bar where styling is not supported.

Wide content scrolls sideways the same way. Tables, drawers and sortable lists in this library use the same thumb, so every scroll area on a page looks and behaves alike.

sections.body:
Choose one or more values from a list. The field shows the value; the list opens in a Popover
(Menu's paper and items) under it. `native` uses the browser's `<select>` instead.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
[data-ok-form-control][data-ok-variant]?[data-ok-size]?[data-ok-hidden-label]?…   (FormControl, optional)
  label[data-ok-form-label][data-ok-input-label][id][for]?[data-ok-shrink]?[data-ok-disable-animation]?
  div[data-ok-select][data-ok-variant][data-ok-size][data-ok-color][data-ok-error]?[data-ok-full-width]?
                     [data-ok-multiple]?[data-ok-auto-width]?[data-ok-display-empty]?
    template[data-ok-select-chip]?          (HTML: a Chip per value, multiple)
    template[data-ok-select-placeholder]?   (HTML: what an empty value shows, displayEmpty)
    div[data-ok-select-display][role=combobox][tabindex=0|-1][id][aria-haspopup=listbox]
       [aria-expanded][aria-controls=<id>-listbox][aria-labelledby]?[aria-label]?[aria-describedby]?
       [aria-disabled]?[aria-readonly]?[aria-invalid]?[aria-required]?   › the value's content
    input[data-ok-select-input][aria-hidden=true][tabindex=-1][name]?[value][placeholder=" "][disabled]?[required]?
    svg[data-ok-select-icon][aria-hidden]
    fieldset[data-ok-select-outline][aria-hidden] › legend › span (label + " *")   (outlined)
    div[data-ok-popover][popover=manual][id=<id>-menu][data-ok-placement=bottom-start][tabindex=-1]
      span[data-ok-popover-arrow]
      ul[data-ok-select-listbox][role=listbox][id=<id>-listbox][aria-labelledby]?[aria-multiselectable]?
        li[data-ok-menu-item][role=option][tabindex=-1][aria-selected][data-ok-selected]?[data-ok-value][aria-disabled]?
        li[data-ok-list-subheader][role=presentation]   (grouping)
  p[data-ok-form-helper-text][id]?
Native: div[data-ok-select][…] › select[data-ok-select-native][id] › option | optgroup, svg[data-ok-select-icon] (not multiple), fieldset
Composed (no field box of its own): TextField's control `div[data-ok-text-field-control][data-ok-select]`
  around the same parts (trigger also `data-ok-text-field-input`, icon also
  `data-ok-text-field-select-icon`); TablePagination's `div[data-ok-select]` (bare, styled by table.css).
```
React renders `data-ok-runtime="off"` on the field box (and the paper). The field box always
writes its variant / size / color (resolved: own prop, else the FormControl's, else the default).
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `select`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `input-label`: listed under "options".)

FormControl gains `hiddenLabel` (`data-ok-hidden-label`, see form-control.md): a filled Select
without a label (also automatic when the FormControl has no InputLabel).

React: `value` / `defaultValue` / `onChange(value)` (the options' own values: numbers stay
numbers; multiple → a list), `open` / `defaultOpen` / `onOpenChange(open, reason)` (reasons
`escape` · `backdrop` · `select` · `tab` · `toggle`), `renderValue(value)`, `label` (the notch),
`labelId`, `id` (the trigger), `name`, `readOnly`, `native`, `inputProps` / `inputRef` (hidden
input or native select), `displayProps` (MUI `SelectDisplayProps`), `menuProps`
(`{ placement, paperProps, listProps }`, MUI `MenuProps`), `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` /
`aria-describedby` (to the trigger), children `MenuItem` (+ `ListSubheader`) or `<option>`
(native). `ref` → the field box. `InputLabel`: FormLabel's props + `shrink`, `disableAnimation`.
TextField: `selectProps` (`{ native: false, … }` → listbox; TextField's `select` stays native by
default for compatibility; MUI's default is the listbox). TablePagination: `selectProps`
(`{ native: false, menuProps }` → listbox; native by default).

API mapping (MUI → Owlky): kept `autoWidth`, `children`, `defaultOpen`, `defaultValue`,
`displayEmpty`, `id`, `inputProps`, `inputRef`, `label`, `labelId`, `multiple`, `native`, `open`,
`renderValue`, `value`, `variant`, `size`, `color`, `error`, `disabled`, `required`, `fullWidth`,
`name`, `readOnly`. Renamed: `onChange(event, child)` → `onChange(value)`; `onOpen` / `onClose` →
`onOpenChange(open, reason)`; `MenuProps` → `menuProps`; `SelectDisplayProps` → `displayProps`;
`NativeSelect` → `Select native` (with `variant="standard"` for its look); `IconComponent` → not
applicable (the arrow is part of the anatomy). Not applicable: `input` (the field box is the
Select), `sx`, `classes`, `slotProps`, `slots`, `component`. InputLabel `variant` / `size` /
`margin`: not applicable (CSS reads the Select's), `focused` / `error` / `disabled` / `required`
come from FormLabel.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
The field box mirrors TextField (text-field.md): outlined 1px `grey-500` at 0.2 → hover
`text-primary` → focus 2px accent; filled tint `grey-500` 0.08 (hover / focus 0.16, disabled
0.24) with a 2px inset focus ring; standard underline growing from the middle; radius
`--ok-radius-md`; text 15 / 24px; padding 16 / 14px (small 8 / 14px), filled 24 12 8 (small
20 12 4; no label 16 12 / 8 12), standard 4px 0 (small 2px 0); 32px (standard 24px) at the end
for the arrow (20px, `text-secondary`, turns 180° while open). InputLabel: TextField's label
positions per variant and size, floated with focus (`:focus-within` on the FormControl), a value
(the hidden input `:not(:placeholder-shown)`), a native select or `shrink`; colors: focus
`--_ok-form-focus-own`, error `--ok-palette-error-text`, disabled `--ok-text-disabled`, filled
rest `grey-700` (AA on the tint). Menu: Popover paper (`--ok-shadow-dropdown`), at least the
field's width (`--_ok-select-width`, CSSOM) unless `autoWidth`; options are MenuItems (selected
semibold + `--ok-action-hover`). Chips: the trigger wraps them (`display: flex`, 4px gap).
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
Intrinsic: the field takes its value's width (a FormControl `fullWidth` stretches it); the value
truncates with an ellipsis (chips wrap and the field grows). The menu stays 16px inside the
viewport and scrolls when long (Popover).
sections.title: Responsive behavior

sections.body:
Core `createSelectController(root, { isOpen, isInert?, autoWidth?, onOpen(focus), onClose(reason),
onPick(option) })` reports intent; owners keep the value and the open state. Single: a pick
replaces the value and closes (`select`), focus returns to the trigger. Multiple: a pick toggles,
the list stays open. Escape / outside press close through the popover controller. Disabled
(`aria-disabled`) and read-only (`aria-readonly`) triggers don't open. HTML runtime `select`:
renders the trigger's content on change (single: a copy of the option's content; multiple:
chips from `template[data-ok-select-chip]` or the options' texts joined with ", "; empty +
`data-ok-display-empty`: the empty option or `template[data-ok-select-placeholder]`), writes
`aria-selected` / `data-ok-selected`, a checkbox's `checked` inside an option, and the hidden
input. A button `[data-ok-select-open="<trigger id>"]` opens it.
sections.title: States / Behavior

sections.body:
| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| ArrowDown / ArrowUp / Enter / Space / Alt+ArrowDown (closed) | Open on the selected option (else the first) |
| Home / End (closed) | Open on the first / last option |
| Printable character (closed) | Open on the first option after the selected one that starts with it |
| ArrowDown / ArrowUp (open) | Next / previous option, wrapping (MUI MenuList) |
| Home / End (open) | First / last option |
| Printable characters (open) | Typeahead (500 ms buffer; a repeated letter cycles) |
| Enter / Space (open) | Pick (multiple: toggle) |
| Escape | Close; focus to the trigger |
| Tab | Close (prevented, MUI); focus to the trigger |
Disabled options and subheaders are skipped.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
Select-only combobox (WAI-ARIA APG) with MUI's roving focus: the trigger is
`role=combobox` + `aria-haspopup=listbox` + `aria-expanded` + `aria-controls`; the list is
`role=listbox` (`aria-multiselectable` with multiple) of `role=option` with `aria-selected`.
Name: `labelId` (`aria-labelledby`) or `aria-label`. States on the trigger: `aria-invalid`,
`aria-required`, `aria-disabled` (tabindex -1), `aria-readonly`. Subheaders are
`role=presentation`. Checkboxes inside options are `inert` (the option is the control). A disabled
Select's InputLabel is inactive text (exempt from contrast, like TextField's).
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML: `ok:select:change` (cancelable, `{ value }`: string, or string[] with multiple) before the
value changes; `ok:select:open`; `ok:select:close` (`{ reason }`: `escape` · `backdrop` · `select` ·
`tab` · `toggle` · `api`). Instance: `{ value, setValue(value), isOpen, open(), close() }` (a native
select's instance reads and writes the `<select>`). React: `onChange(value)`,
`onOpenChange(open, reason)`.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Snippets are generated from the React stories
(`apps/storybook/scripts/select-snippets.mjs`), which also adds the HTML-only templates
(`SELECT_TEMPLATES`) and triggers (`data-ok-select-open`, `data-ok-dialog-open` / `-close`;
parity ignores `data-ok-select-open`). `renderValue` is React-only: HTML covers chips, the
placeholder and joined texts. The width of the menu (`--_ok-select-width`) is CSSOM.

sections.body:
Pick a value or a range on a track. Each thumb holds a native `input[type=range]` (keyboard
events, screen readers, forms); core `createSliderController` handles pointer drags and keys and
reports intent; the owner (React state, HTML runtime `slider`) applies values.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
span[data-ok-slider][data-ok-color][data-ok-size][data-ok-orientation][data-ok-track][data-ok-value-label-display]
    [data-ok-min]?[data-ok-max]?[data-ok-step]?[data-ok-disabled]?[data-ok-disable-swap]?[data-ok-label-value]?
  span[data-ok-slider-rail]
  span[data-ok-slider-track]                                 (--_ok-slider-start / -end)
  span[data-ok-slider-mark][data-ok-value][data-ok-active]?   (--_ok-slider-at)
  span[data-ok-slider-mark-label][data-ok-value][aria-hidden]
  span[data-ok-slider-thumb][data-ok-index][data-ok-active]?   (--_ok-slider-at)
    input[type=range][min][max][step][value][aria-label|aria-labelledby][aria-valuetext]?[aria-orientation]?[name]?
    span[data-ok-slider-value-label][aria-hidden]?
```
Positions are private custom properties (React `style`; HTML runtime CSSOM). Snippets carry none.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `slider`: listed under "options".)

Other props: `value` / `defaultValue` (number or `[a, b]`), `onChange(value, activeThumb)`,
`onChangeCommitted(value)`, `marks` (`true` · `{ value, label? }[]`; HTML: mark parts), `step`
`null` (HTML `data-ok-step="0"`), `valueLabelFormat(value, index)`, `getAriaValueText(value,
index)` (HTML `data-ok-label-value="{value}°C"` for both), `getAriaLabel(index)`, `aria-label`,
`aria-labelledby`, `name`.

API mapping (MUI): kept `value`, `defaultValue`, `onChange`, `onChangeCommitted`, `min`, `max`,
`step`, `marks`, `orientation`, `size`, `color` (+ `inherit` and every palette color, as on the
reference), `track`, `valueLabelDisplay`, `valueLabelFormat`, `getAriaValueText`, `getAriaLabel`,
`disabled`, `disableSwap`, `name`. Deferred: `scale`, `shiftStep`, `tabIndex`, `slots`.
Not applicable: `classes`, `sx`, `component`.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Root: 26px vertical padding area (13px), width 100% (vertical: height 100%, min 100px). Rail:
10 / 6px (`spacing` × 2.5 / 1.5), `rgb(grey-500 / 0.12)`, `--ok-radius-lg`. Track: `main`.
Thumb: 20 / 16px, `--ok-palette-common-white`, 1px `rgb(grey-500 / 0.08)` border, shadow
`0 1px 2px rgb(grey-500 / 0.16)`, inner dot 62.5% `rgb(grey-500 / 0.16)`; hover / active /
focus-visible: 8px halo `rgb(main / 0.16)`; focus-visible adds a 2px outline. Marks: 1px ticks,
`rgb(grey-500 / 0.48)` (on the track: white 64%). Mark labels `--ok-font-size-sm`,
`--ok-text-secondary`. Value label: `--ok-palette-grey-800`, white, 12px semibold, `--ok-radius-md`,
4px 8px, arrow; scales in over `--ok-duration-shortest`. Disabled: grey, no pointer.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
Press on the rail moves the closest thumb there and starts a drag (Pointer Events, captured);
`onCommit` on release. Thumbs swap when crossing (`disableSwap`: stop at the neighbour). Keys
(on the focused input, handled by the controller): arrows ± step (marks only: next mark),
Page Up / Down ± 10 steps, Home / End; RTL mirrors Left / Right. Native `input` events
(assistive technologies) are applied too.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body:
| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| → / ↑, ← / ↓ | ± one step (or to the next mark) |
| Page Up / Page Down | ± ten steps |
| Home / End | min / max |
sections.title: Keyboard
Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML `ok:slider:change` (cancelable, `{ value: number[], activeThumb }`), `ok:slider:commit`
(`{ value }`). Instance `{ value, setValue(value) }`.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Horizontal sliders fill their container; vertical ones its height. Pressing the track (any
width) moves a thumb, so the 20px thumb isn't the only target.
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
React renders `data-ok-runtime="off"` and positions in `style`; HTML computes the same through
CSSOM on mount (parity ignores `style`).

options.description: Toasts shown at once; newer ones push out older.

options.description: Every toast shows a close button.
options.name: closeButton

sections.body:
Brief messages at the edge of the viewport that close by themselves. Queue and API: core
`createToastStore` / `createToastApi` / `createToastTimer` (module-scoped per implementation,
ADR-0007). HTML runtime: `toaster` (behavior-only folder; markup in `snackbar/examples`).
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
section[data-ok-toaster][data-ok-position][aria-label]
  › ol[data-ok-toaster-list][aria-live=polite]
      › li[data-ok-toast][data-ok-type][data-ok-custom]?
          › span[data-ok-toast-icon][aria-hidden]? › svg | CircularProgress
          › div[data-ok-toast-content] › div[data-ok-toast-title] + div[data-ok-toast-description]?
          › button[data-ok-toast-cancel]? + button[data-ok-toast-action]? | div[data-ok-toast-actions]
          › button[data-ok-toast-close][aria-label]?
template[id] › li[data-ok-toast][data-ok-duration]?[data-ok-then]?        (HTML)
button[data-ok-toast-open="template id"][data-ok-toaster-position]?        (HTML)
```
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `toaster`: listed under "options".)

React: `toast(title, options)`, `toast.message|info|success|warning|error|loading|promise|custom`,
`toast.dismiss(id?)`; options `id`, `description`, `action` (`{ label, onClick }` or your nodes),
`cancel`, `duration`, `icon`, `dismissible`, `onDismiss`, `onAutoClose`; `<Toaster store>`.
Kept from Sonner: `position`, `duration` (4000), `visibleToasts` (3), `closeButton`. Deferred:
`expand` / stacked collapse (always expanded, like the reference), swipe to dismiss, `hotkey`,
`richColors`, `theme` (follows the page scheme), `offset` / `gap`, per-toast `position`,
`toast.getHistory`. Not applicable: `className` / `style` / `unstyled` per toast (CSS).
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Toaster fixed 16px from the edges, width min(300px, 100% − 32px), gap 12px; bottom positions stack
newest nearest the edge. Default toast: inverted (grey-800 / white, dark scheme reversed via
`light-dark()`), padding 8px 8px 8px 12px. Typed toasts: `--ok-bg-paper`, padding 4px 8px 4px 4px,
icon box 48px radius `--ok-radius-lg` tinted with the status channel / 0.08, icon 24px in the
status main color. Radius `--ok-radius-lg`, `--ok-shadow-z8`, 13px (`--ok-font-size-sm`), title
500. Close button 24px circle at the top-left corner, shown on hover / focus (always on touch).
Entry: slide 50% + fade (`--ok-duration-short`); no exit animation.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body: Never wider than the viewport minus 32px; centered positions stay centered.
sections.title: Responsive behavior

sections.body:
Polite live region; toasts never take focus. Time pauses while the toaster is hovered or focused.
Escape closes a focused toast (unless not dismissible). The loading toast has a named progress.
sections.title: Keyboard / Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML: `ok:toaster:show`, `ok:toaster:dismiss` (`detail.reason`), `ok:toaster:action` (cancelable).
Instance: `{ show(options), showTemplate(template), promise(promise, messages), dismiss(id?) }` —
`show()` builds nodes from text only.
sections.title: Events / API

components.name: sortable

options.description: Grid, one column or one scrolling row.
options.name: layout

options.description: Item order (`items` + `onReorder`).
options.name: items

sections.body:
A list whose items the user reorders — by dragging, by keyboard, or by two taps — and optionally
removes.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
ul[data-ok-sortable][data-ok-layout][aria-label]                React: + data-ok-runtime="off"
  li[data-ok-sortable-item][data-ok-dragging | data-ok-grabbed]?
    … content (yours)
    div[data-ok-sortable-actions]
      button[data-ok-icon-button][data-ok-size="sm"][data-ok-sortable-remove][aria-label]?  (optional)
      button[data-ok-icon-button][data-ok-size="sm"][data-ok-sortable-handle][aria-label][aria-pressed]
  template[data-ok-sortable-template]?                          HTML only: markup of new items
[add trigger] button[data-ok-sortable-add="<list id>"]          HTML only
div[data-ok-sortable-announcer][aria-live="polite"]             created once per document (visually hidden)
```
Scrolling (vertical / horizontal): wrap the list in a Scrollbar — `section[data-ok-scrollbar] ›
ul[data-ok-sortable]`. The Scrollbar then scrolls and carries the dashed frame; the list grows
freely (`:has(> [data-ok-sortable])`). A list without a Scrollbar still scrolls itself (as before).
Handles and remove buttons are Icon buttons (`default`, `sm`), so they share its CSS.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `sortable`: listed under "options".)

Other props (not options):

| HTML | React | Values |
|---|---|---|
| item markup | `items` + `getKey` + `renderItem` | your data |
| move handling | `onReorder(items)` (controlled) | |
| `data-ok-sortable-remove` buttons | `onRemove(item, index)` (renders the buttons) | none |
| handle / remove names | `getItemLabel(item, index)` → `Reorder …` / `Remove …` | `Item <n>` |
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
- Items: background `channel(grey-500)` 4 %, 1px border 16 %, radius `--ok-radius-lg`; actions at the
  top end. Remove buttons appear on item hover / focus-within, always on touch (`hover: none`).
- `grid`: columns of at least 160px (`auto-fill`), gap 20px.
- `vertical`: one column, at most 480px wide and 560px tall (scrolls), dashed frame, padding 20px.
- `horizontal`: one row of 144px items that scrolls horizontally, dashed frame, padding 20px.
- Dragging: the item follows the pointer above the others (`--ok-shadow-z16`); grabbed (keyboard /
  tap): `--ok-shadow-z8` and a 2px outline in `--ok-text-secondary`.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
The controller reports intent (`onMove(from, to)`, `onRemove(index)`); the owner reorders its state
(React) or the DOM (HTML runtime). It re-reads the DOM on every step, so async owners work.
- **Pointer drag** (mouse, touch, pen) on the handle: starts after 4px; the item follows the pointer;
  moving over another item moves it there. Release drops; `pointercancel` / Escape restore the start
  position.
- **Keyboard / taps** on the handle: Space / Enter / click grabs; Arrow keys move it (vertical: ↑↓,
  horizontal: ←→, grid: ←→ ±1 and ↑↓ ± one row); Space / Enter / click drops; Escape cancels;
  focus leaving the list drops. Clicking another item's handle while one is grabbed moves it there.
  Focus stays on the moved handle.
- **Remove:** reported for the item; focus moves to the next item's handle (or the previous one).
- **Announcements** (polite live region): grabbed, moved, dropped, cancelled, removed — with
  positions ("position 3 of 12").
sections.title: Behavior (`core` `createSortableController`)

sections.body:
| Key (handle focused) | Action |
|---|---|
| Space / Enter | grab · drop |
| Arrow keys (grabbed) | move by one (grid: ↑↓ by a row) |
| Escape (grabbed) | cancel, back to the start position |
| Tab (grabbed) | drop, then move focus |
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
Handles and remove buttons need names (`aria-label`); the handle is `aria-pressed="true"` while
grabbed. Dragging has single-pointer and keyboard alternatives (WCAG 2.5.7, 2.1.1). The list needs a
name (`aria-label`).
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML: `ok:sortable:move` (cancelable, `detail: { from, to, item }`), `ok:sortable:remove`
(cancelable, `detail: { index, item }`), `ok:sortable:add` (after a template clone is inserted,
`detail: { item, index }` — fill its content here). Instance: `move(from, to)`, `remove(index)`.
React: `onReorder`, `onRemove`; helper `arrayMove(items, from, to)`; `messages?:
Partial<SortableMessages>` localizes the announcements (`grabbed`, `moved`, `dropped`, `cancelled`,
`removed`, each `(position, total) => string`; defaults from `defaultSortableMessages`).
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Grid columns follow the width (one column at 320px). Vertical and horizontal lists scroll inside the
Scrollbar around them (which carries the frame); the page never scrolls horizontally.
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
- "Add item" is app logic: React adds to `items`; HTML clones `template[data-ok-sortable-template]`
  on `[data-ok-sortable-add]` and emits `ok:sortable:add`.
- Announcements: React accepts `messages`; the HTML runtime uses the English defaults.

sections.title: Purpose

```
ol[data-ok-stepper][data-ok-orientation][data-ok-variant][data-ok-alternative-label]?[data-ok-active-step][aria-label]

        (custom: the icon node)
      span[data-ok-step-label-text]
        span[data-ok-step-label-title] span[data-ok-step-label-optional]?
    div[data-ok-collapse][data-ok-timeout="auto"][data-ok-step-content][hidden]?           (vertical; a Collapse)
[data-ok-stepper-panel="<id>"][data-ok-stepper-panel-step]?   (HTML: shown at its step)
button[data-ok-stepper-next | -back | -reset="<id> …"]       (HTML triggers)

div[data-ok-mobile-stepper][data-ok-variant][data-ok-position][data-ok-steps][data-ok-active-step]
  (back button) · span[data-ok-mobile-stepper-text] | span[data-ok-mobile-stepper-dots][role="img"][aria-label]
  › span[data-ok-mobile-stepper-dot][data-ok-active]? | span[data-ok-linear-progress][data-ok-mobile-stepper-progress] · (next button)
```
The connector sits inside the `li` (an `ol` may only hold `li`; MUI puts it between them unless
`alternativeLabel`).
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `stepper`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `step`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `step-label`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `mobile-stepper`: listed under "options".)

Other props (not options):

| HTML | React | Values |
|---|---|---|
| `div[data-ok-step-connector]` | `Stepper connector` (default `<StepConnector />`, `null`: none) | node |
| `span[data-ok-step-label-title]` | `StepLabel children` | node |
| `span[data-ok-step-label-optional]` | `StepLabel optional` | node |
| `span[data-ok-step-icon]` content (+ `data-ok-custom` for a node) | `StepLabel icon` | text, number or node |
| `div[data-ok-collapse][data-ok-timeout="auto"][data-ok-step-content][hidden]?` | `StepContent` | node (a Collapse, `hidden` off the active step) |
| buttons in the bar (`data-ok-mobile-stepper-back` / `-next`) | `backButton` / `nextButton` | node |
| `data-ok-label-step` (`{step}`, `{steps}`) | `getStepLabel(step, steps)` | default "Step 2 of 3" |

API mapping (MUI): kept Stepper `activeStep`, `alternativeLabel`, `orientation`, `connector`;
Step `active`, `completed`, `disabled`, `index`; StepLabel `error`, `optional`, `icon`;
StepContent; MobileStepper `steps`, `activeStep`, `variant`, `position`, `backButton`,
`nextButton`. Beyond MUI (reference "Customized stepper"): Stepper `variant` (`dot`, `circle`);
`getStepLabel` (accessible name of dots / bar, MUI has none). Deferred (roadmap backlog):
`nonLinear`, `StepButton`, Step `expanded` / `last`, StepContent `TransitionComponent` /
`transitionDuration` / `TransitionProps` (it is always a Collapse with `timeout="auto"`, MUI's defaults),
MobileStepper `LinearProgressProps`. Not applicable: `component`, `slots`, `slotProps`, `classes`,
`sx`, `StepIconComponent` / `StepIconProps` (use `icon`).
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Horizontal: flex row; steps padding-inline 8px; steps after the first grow and start with their
connector (shrinks to 0 like MUI, 8px before the icon). Icon 24px circle, `--ok-font-size-xs` white number;
not reached `--ok-palette-grey-600` (AA for the white number), active / completed
`--ok-palette-primary-main` (completed shows a check), error `--ok-palette-error-main` with "!".
Title body2, `--ok-text-secondary` / weight regular; active and completed `--ok-text-primary`,
medium; error `--ok-palette-error-text`. Optional caption `--ok-text-secondary`. Line 1px
`--ok-divider`. Alternative label: steps share the width (`flex: 1 1 0`), titles 16px below the
icon, connector absolute at the icon's middle, 8px from each icon. Vertical: label padding 8px 0;
connector 24px tall, 12px in; content 12px in, padding 0 8px 0 20px, 1px line (not on the last
step). `dot`: 22px icon box with an 8px dot, completed check, 3px lines, active / completed lines
primary. `circle`: 50px circles, `rgb(grey-500 / 0.24)`, active / completed gradient
`warning-main → error-main` (active `--ok-shadow-z8`), 3px lines with the gradient.
Mobile: flex, space-between, 8px padding and gap, `--ok-bg-paper`; `bottom` / `top` fixed at
`--ok-z-mobile-stepper` (new token, 1000 like MUI); dots 8px, 2px apart, `grey-500 / 0.8`, active
primary; progress bar 50% wide (LinearProgress `inherit`).
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
Step flags `data-ok-active`, `data-ok-completed`, `data-ok-disabled` (linear: before / at / after
the active step; explicit Step props win), `aria-current="step"` on the active one; StepLabel
`data-ok-error`; StepContent shows on the active step only: it carries `hidden` on the others
(React from the step context, HTML runtime on every step change) and the Collapse animates its
height (collapse.md); the CSS rule on inactive steps stays for markup without the runtime.
sections.title: States

sections.body:
React: `Stepper` clones its direct `Step` children with `index`; each step reads `activeStep`
from context. `activeStep === steps.length` → all completed. HTML runtime `stepper`: derives the
flags from `data-ok-active-step` on mount and on every move; triggers (`data-ok-stepper-next` /
`-back` / `-reset`, several space-separated ids move several steppers) move it; panels
`data-ok-stepper-panel="<id>"` show at their index (or `data-ok-stepper-panel-step`); Back
triggers are disabled on the first step. `mobile-stepper`: updates text, dots (count from
`data-ok-steps`), progress value (`mobileStepperProgress`, MUI rounding) and labels; Back / Next
inside the bar (empty value) or naming it; disabled at the ends; panels
`data-ok-mobile-stepper-panel="<id>"`.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body: Steps aren't interactive (MUI linear). The app's Back / Next buttons are native buttons.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
`ol` named by `aria-label`; `aria-current="step"`; icons `aria-hidden` (the title names the step);
mobile dots `role="img"` and the bar named "Step n of m" (`getStepLabel` / `data-ok-label-step`).
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML `ok:stepper:change` and `ok:mobile-stepper:change` (cancelable) — `detail: { activeStep,
previous }`. Instances → `{ activeStep, setActiveStep(step), go(step) }` (`setActiveStep` emits
nothing). React: no callbacks (the app owns `activeStep`).
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Same sizes at every breakpoint. On narrow screens titles wrap inside their steps, and a word
breaks only when it can't fit on its own line (`overflow-wrap: anywhere`), so a horizontal stepper
never overflows; `vertical` or `MobileStepper` read better on phones.
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
MobileStepper renders `data-ok-runtime="off"` in React. HTML-only hooks (triggers, panels,
`data-ok-label-step`) are ignored by parity; React demos render the same buttons with handlers.
Stories compose the reference's surfaces: step text in a flat Paper (`elevation={0}`, tinted by
demo CSS), the mobile demos in an outlined Paper with a Divider above the MobileStepper.

sections.body:
Turn one setting on or off, with immediate effect. A native checkbox with `role="switch"`; CSS
only. Labels come from `FormControlLabel`. Used by Table's "Dense" toggle.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
span[data-ok-switch][data-ok-color][data-ok-size][data-ok-edge]?
  input[type=checkbox][role=switch][data-ok-switch-input]   (covers the target, opacity 0)
  span[data-ok-switch-track][aria-hidden="true"]
  span[data-ok-switch-thumb][aria-hidden="true"]
```
React `ref` and the remaining props go to the **input**; `className` / `style` to the root.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `switch`: listed under "options".)

React only: `onChange(checked)`. Deferred: `icon` / `checkedIcon` (thumb content; not on the
reference — backlog). Upstream `disableRipple`, `sx`, `classes`, `slots`, `slotProps` don't apply.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
- Medium: track 34 × 20px (`--ok-spacing` × 8.5 × 5), thumb 14px (× 3.5), inset 3px (× 0.75),
  root padding 9px 12px → 58 × 38px. Small: track 26 × 16px, thumb 10px, padding 4px 7px → 40 × 24px.
- Track off: `rgb(--ok-palette-grey-500-channel / 0.48)`; on: `--ok-c-main` (`default` =
  `--ok-text-primary`; its thumb is `grey-800` in dark schemes via `light-dark()`).
- Thumb white, `--ok-shadow-z1`; moves `track − thumb − 2 × inset` (14px / 10px);
  `--ok-duration-shortest` `--ok-easing-standard`.
- Hover: a 9px halo (main channel at 0.08, off: `--ok-action-hover`). Focus-visible: 2px
  `--ok-text-primary` ring around the track, offset 2px. Disabled: track opacity 0.48.
- `edge`: −8px margin on that side.

sections.body:
Native `<table>` markup with the Minimal look, plus the interactive parts tables need: sortable
headers, row selection, collapsible detail rows and pagination. React leaves data to the app (like
MUI); the HTML runtime sorts, selects and pages the rows already in the DOM.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
section[data-ok-table-container]                          holds the table (overflow: visible with a Scrollbar)
  section[data-ok-scrollbar][aria-label][tabindex=0]       scrolls — the Scrollbar component (set a max-height for a sticky header)
    table[data-ok-table][data-ok-size][data-ok-padding][data-ok-sticky-header]?[id]   React: + data-ok-runtime="off"
      thead › tr › th[scope=col][aria-sort]?[data-ok-align]?[data-ok-padding]?
        button[type=button][data-ok-table-sort-label][data-ok-direction][data-ok-active]?[data-ok-hide-sort-icon]?
          … label, span[data-ok-table-sort-icon][aria-hidden=true] › svg (arrow down; rotated when ascending)
        span[data-ok-checkbox][data-ok-size="small"] › input[type=checkbox][data-ok-checkbox-input][data-ok-table-select-all][aria-label]   selection column (a Checkbox; a bare input still works)
      tbody
        tr[data-ok-hover]?[data-ok-selected]?
          td | th[scope=row] [data-ok-align]?[data-ok-padding]?[data-ok-size]?
          span[data-ok-checkbox][data-ok-size="small"] › input[…][data-ok-table-select][aria-label]   in a selection cell
          button[data-ok-icon-button][data-ok-table-expand=<detail id>][aria-expanded][aria-controls][aria-label]
        tr[data-ok-table-detail][id][hidden]? › td[colspan]                 detail row of the row above
      tfoot? › tr › td
div[data-ok-table-pagination=<table id>]                                   React: value "" + data-ok-runtime="off"
  label[data-ok-table-pagination-rows] › "Rows per page:" select          (only with 2+ options)
  span[data-ok-table-pagination-displayed][aria-live=polite] "1–5 of 12"
  div[data-ok-table-pagination-actions] › button[data-ok-icon-button][data-ok-table-pagination-action=first|previous|next|last][aria-label][title][disabled]?
```
Sort labels go in the last header row (one header cell per column). Detail rows follow the row
they belong to; sorting and paging move and hide them together with it.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `table`: listed under "options".)

Sort label:
(Options of `table-sort-label`: listed under "options".)

Cell overrides (`TableCell` props ↔ attributes, absent = inherit the table's): `align`
(`left` `center` `right` `justify`; numbers are right-aligned) → `data-ok-align`, `padding` →
`data-ok-padding`, `size` → `data-ok-size`, `sortDirection` (`asc` `desc` `false`) → `aria-sort`,
`scope`. Row: `hover` → `data-ok-hover`, `selected` → `data-ok-selected`.

Pagination (`TablePagination` ↔ HTML): `count` (`-1` = unknown) ↔ number of row groups or
`data-ok-count`; `page` (0-based) ↔ `data-ok-page`; `rowsPerPage` ↔ the selected `<option>`;
`rowsPerPageOptions` (default `[10, 25, 50, 100]`, `-1` = all) ↔ the `<option>`s;
`onPageChange(page)` / `onRowsPerPageChange(rowsPerPage)` ↔ `ok:table-pagination:change`;
`labelRowsPerPage`, `labelDisplayedRows({ from, to, count, page })`, `getItemAriaLabel(type)`,
`showFirstButton`, `showLastButton`, `disabled` ↔ markup.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
- Cells: body2, `--ok-text-primary`, padding 16px (`small`: 6px / 16px), bottom border `1px dashed
  --ok-divider`; `checkbox` padding: 48px wide, 8px start; `none`: 0.
- Header: `--ok-bg-neutral` band, `--ok-text-secondary`, weight 600, 24px line (56px row); sticky:
  `--ok-bg-paper`, z-index 2, a second header row sticks below the first.
- Footer: caption, secondary text.
- Rows: hover `--ok-action-hover` (hover-capable devices); selected primary channel 8 % (12 % hovered).
- Sort label: arrow 18px, hidden when inactive (50 % on hover / focus), shown when active; text
  primary when active or hovered. `hideSortIcon`: no arrow while inactive.
- Detail row: `--ok-bg-neutral`; the expand button's chevron turns 180° when open.
- Pagination: flex, wraps, right-aligned, 16px gaps, min-height 64px; prev/next are small icon
  buttons; the rows-per-page `<select>` is native by default. `selectProps={{ native: false }}`
  (MUI `SelectProps`) composes a bare listbox Select instead (additive):
  `div[data-ok-table-pagination-rows] › span[id] (the label) + div[data-ok-select]` (no variant:
  table.css draws it, 32px, no line, a focus ring); the HTML runtime listens to its
  `ok:select:change` (refused when `ok:table-pagination:change` is prevented) and reads the
  hidden input for the first rows per page. Story "Table pagination with API" (search TextField
  + category Select; HTML: a page script filters the rows the runtime pages).
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
- React: data is the app's (sort, select, page in state; `compareCellValues`, `nextSortDirection`,
  `pageRange`, `selectAllState` from `@owlky/core` help). `TableExpandButton` (`expanded`,
  `controls` = the detail row's `id`, `aria-label`) and `TableDetailRow` (`id`, `open`,
  `colSpan: number` — required, the number of columns to span) take their state from the app.
- HTML runtime (`table`, `table-pagination`):
  - sort label click → cancelable `ok:table:sort` `{ column, direction }` → rows (with their detail
    rows) reordered by `data-ok-sort-value` or the cell text (numbers numerically), `aria-sort` and
    the labels updated, pagination refreshed;
  - row checkbox → `data-ok-selected` on its row, the select-all checkbox updated (checked /
    indeterminate); select-all → every row (all pages); then `ok:table:select` `{ rows }`;
  - `input[data-ok-table-dense="<table id>"]` (a Switch under the table, story "Sorting &
    selecting") → the table's `data-ok-size` becomes `small` when checked, `medium` otherwise;
  - expand button → cancelable `ok:table:expand` `{ row, expanded }` → `hidden` and `aria-expanded`;
  - pagination → cancelable `ok:table-pagination:change` `{ page, rowsPerPage }` → rows outside the
    page get `hidden`, the label and buttons are updated. With `data-ok-count` (server-side) rows
    aren't touched: the app replaces them.
- With `Pagination` (story "Pagination with API"): React slices the rows for `page`; in HTML
  `nav[data-ok-pagination="<table id>"][data-ok-rows-per-page]` pages the rows the same way (see
  specs/components/pagination.md). Sorting refreshes either kind of pagination.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body:
Sort labels, checkboxes, expand and page buttons are native buttons / inputs (Tab, Enter / Space).
The Scrollbar inside the container is the focusable scroll region (arrow keys scroll it).
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
- `aria-sort` on the sorted header cell; checkboxes and icon buttons need names (`aria-label`).
- Name the Scrollbar (`aria-label`): it is the focusable region; the container stays unnamed and
  unfocusable. Without a Scrollbar, name the container instead: it scrolls natively (as before).
- The displayed-rows label is `aria-live="polite"`.
- Header text (`--ok-text-secondary` on `--ok-bg-neutral`) meets AA in both schemes.
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
`ok:table:sort` (cancelable), `ok:table:select`, `ok:table:expand` (cancelable),
`ok:table-pagination:change` (cancelable). Instances: table `sort(column, direction?)`,
`expand(row, open?)`; pagination `page`, `rowsPerPage`, `setPage(page)`,
`setRowsPerPage(rows)`, `refresh()`.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Mobile first: the container scrolls horizontally when the table is wider than the screen (the page
never overflows); pagination wraps onto two lines below ~420px. No breakpoint changes otherwise.
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
- Data: React renders the rows the app gives it (one page); the HTML runtime sorts, selects and
  pages the rows already in the DOM, hiding the others (`hidden`). Parity compares visible rows.
- `data-ok-table-pagination` holds the table `id` in HTML and is empty in React (the app links them).
- Scrolling: both wrap the table in a Scrollbar inside the container (`TableContainer › Scrollbar ›
  Table`); a named container without a Scrollbar still scrolls itself.
sections.title: Parity notes

sections.body:
Switch between related views on one page (WAI-ARIA tabs pattern). A sliding indicator marks the
selected tab. Behavior is core `createTabsController` (keyboard, indicator, scroll buttons),
shared by React and the HTML runtime `tabs`; the owner applies the selection.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
div[data-ok-tabs][data-ok-variant][data-ok-orientation][data-ok-text-color][data-ok-indicator-color][data-ok-scroll-buttons]…
  div[data-ok-tabs-scroll-button="start"][aria-hidden="true"] › svg      (scrollable, scrollButtons ≠ false)
  div[data-ok-tabs-scroller]
    div[role="tablist"][data-ok-tabs-list][aria-label | aria-labelledby][aria-orientation="vertical"]?
      button[type="button"][role="tab"][data-ok-tab][data-ok-icon-position]?[data-ok-wrapped]?
            [value][aria-selected][tabindex][id]?[aria-controls]?[disabled]?
        svg[aria-hidden="true"]? span[data-ok-tab-label]?
    span[data-ok-tabs-indicator]                     (--_ok-tabs-indicator-start / -size via CSSOM)
  div[data-ok-tabs-scroll-button="end"][aria-hidden="true"] › svg
div[role="tabpanel"][data-ok-tab-panel][id][aria-labelledby][tabindex="0"][hidden]?   (one per tab)
```
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `tabs`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `tab`: listed under "options".)

Other props (not options):

| HTML | React | Values |
|---|---|---|
| `aria-selected="true"` on one tab | `value` / `defaultValue` / `onChange(value)` | tab value or `false` (none) |
| `value` on the tab | `Tab value` | string; default the position (`"0"`, `"1"`, …) |
| `span[data-ok-tab-label]` | `Tab label` | node |
| `svg` in the tab | `Tab icon` | element (icon-only tabs need `aria-label`) |
| `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` on the tablist | same props on `Tabs` | string |
| `div[role="tabpanel"]` | `TabPanel` (DOM props; app sets `hidden`) | — |

API mapping (MUI): kept `value`, `onChange` (value-first: `onChange(value)`), `orientation`,
`variant`, `centered`, `textColor`, `indicatorColor` (+ `inherit`, the reference default),
`scrollButtons` (`"auto" | true | false`), `allowScrollButtonsMobile`, `visibleScrollbar`,
`selectionFollowsFocus`, `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`; Tab `value`, `label`, `icon`,
`iconPosition`, `wrapped`, `disabled`. Beyond MUI (reference "Custom" section): `segmented`;
`defaultValue` (uncontrolled, like the other components). Not applicable: `action`,
`TabIndicatorProps`, `TabScrollButton`, `ScrollButtonComponent`, `slots`, `slotProps`,
`classes`, `sx`, `component`, `disableRipple`, `disableFocusRipple` (no ripple).
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Tabs: `min-height` 48px (`spacing × 12`), `min-width` 48px, padding 12px 0, gap 40px
(`spacing × 10`; `fullWidth`, vertical and segmented: 0), `subtitle2` size / line height, weight
`--ok-font-weight-medium`, selected `--ok-font-weight-semibold`. Colors: unselected
`--ok-text-secondary`, selected `--ok-text-primary` (or primary / secondary `main`). Icon 24px;
top / bottom: 72px tall, 9px padding, 6px gap; start / end: row, 8px gap. Disabled: opacity 0.48.
Indicator: 2px (`--ok-text-primary` or palette `main`), slides over `--ok-duration-standard`
(after the first measure: `data-ok-ready`). Segmented: bar `--ok-bg-neutral`, `--ok-radius-md`,
list padding 0 8px (vertical 8px 0), tabs 52px tall, padding-inline 16px; indicator `::after` pill
inset 6px, `--ok-bg-paper`, `--ok-shadow-z1`, `--ok-radius-md`. Scroll buttons 40px wide,
opacity 0.8 (0 at an edge).
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
`aria-selected="true"` (selected), `:focus-visible` (2px `--ok-text-primary` outline, inset),
`:disabled`. Controller flags: `data-ok-can-scroll-start` / `-end` on the root (scroll buttons),
`data-ok-ready` on the indicator.
sections.title: States

sections.body:
- Click / Enter / Space on an unselected, enabled tab → `onSelect` intent; the owner selects
  (React: `onChange`; HTML: `ok:tabs:change`, then `aria-selected`, `tabindex`, panels' `hidden`).
- Arrow keys move focus only (manual activation, MUI default); `selectionFollowsFocus` selects on
  focus. Disabled tabs are skipped.
- Indicator: measured from the selected tab's offset box (ResizeObserver + `document.fonts.ready`
  re-measure). No selection → zero size.
- Scrollable: the scroller scrolls (scrollbar hidden unless `visibleScrollbar`); scroll buttons
  page by the scroller's size (smooth unless reduced motion); a newly selected tab scrolls into
  view (scroller only). `scrollButtons="auto"`: hidden without overflow and below 600px (unless
  `allowScrollButtonsMobile`); `true`: always; `false`: not rendered.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body:
| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| Tab | Into the list (selected tab, else the first enabled one), then to the panel |
| → / ← (vertical ↓ / ↑) | Next / previous enabled tab, wrapping (mirrored in RTL) |
| Home / End | First / last enabled tab |
| Enter / Space | Select the focused tab |
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
`role="tablist"` named by `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby`; `aria-orientation="vertical"` when
vertical; tabs `role="tab"` with `aria-selected` and roving `tabindex`; `aria-controls` ↔ panel
`aria-labelledby`; panels `tabindex="0"`. Scroll buttons are `aria-hidden` pointer aids (the arrow
keys reach every tab). Brand-colored selected text (primary / secondary) is exempt from
`color-contrast` (ADR-0014); unselected text is AA.
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML `ok:tabs:change` (cancelable) — `detail: { value, previous, tab }`. Instance
`runtime.get(el, "tabs")` → `{ value, setValue(value), select(tab) }` (`setValue` emits nothing).
React: `onChange(value)`; controlled and uncontrolled.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Same size at every breakpoint. Scrollable bars hide their scroll buttons below 600px (`auto`);
standard bars clip, so use `scrollable` for many tabs on phones.
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
React renders `data-ok-runtime="off"`. Controller-written state (`style`, `data-ok-ready`,
`data-ok-can-scroll-*`) is the same in both (same controller). Parity ignores `style`.
